entries.example: The chef prepared fresh abalone with garlic butter and herbs.
entries.exampleZh: 厨师用蒜蓉黄油和香草烹制了新鲜的鲍鱼。

entries.meaning: 放弃,遗弃；离弃，放弃；放纵，放任
entries.example: They had to abandon the car when the floodwaters rose.
entries.exampleZh: 洪水上涨时，他们不得不弃车而逃。

entries.example: Her sense of abandonment grew after months of total silence.
entries.exampleZh: 数月的全无音信之后，她的被遗弃感越来越强。

entries.example: The storm will abate by tomorrow morning, forecasters say.
entries.exampleZh: 预报员说，暴风雨到明天早晨会减弱。

entries.example: The old abbey stands on a hill above the village.
entries.exampleZh: 那座古老的修道院坐落在村庄上方的山丘上。

entries.meaning: 缩写, 简化；缩略，缩写
entries.example: Please abbreviate the long title to fit the narrow column.
entries.exampleZh: 请把冗长的标题缩写，以便放进狭窄的栏中。

entries.example: Scientists studied the aberrant behavior of the isolated birds.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家研究了这些隔离鸟类的异常行为。

entries.example: Many people abhor cruelty to animals in any form.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人憎恨任何形式的虐待动物行为。

entries.example: She has an abiding love for classical music and poetry.
entries.exampleZh: 她对古典音乐和诗歌怀有持久的爱。

entries.example: The young abigail helped her mistress dress for the ball.
entries.exampleZh: 年轻的贴身使女帮女主人打扮去参加舞会。

entries.example: Her ability to solve puzzles impressed the entire team.
entries.exampleZh: 她解谜的能力让整个团队印象深刻。

entries.meaning: 着火的，燃烧的；闪耀的；情绪激动的
entries.example: By midnight the warehouse was ablaze and firefighters rushed in.
entries.exampleZh: 到午夜时，仓库已燃起大火，消防员冲了进去。

entries.example: Will you be able to finish the report by Friday?
entries.exampleZh: 你星期五之前能完成报告吗？

entries.meaning: 反常的, 变态的；反常的，变态的
entries.example: The doctor noticed an abnormal heartbeat during the routine check.
entries.exampleZh: 医生在常规检查中注意到心跳异常。

entries.example: The scan revealed a slight abnormality in his left lung.
entries.exampleZh: 扫描显示他左肺有一处轻微的异常。

entries.example: All passengers must come aboard before the ferry departs.
entries.exampleZh: 所有乘客必须在渡轮开船前上船。

entries.meaning: 废止, 废除；废止，废除
entries.example: The government plans to abolish the outdated tax next year.
entries.exampleZh: 政府计划明年废除这项过时的税收。

entries.example: The abolition of slavery took decades of fierce struggle.
entries.exampleZh: 废除奴隶制经历了数十年的激烈斗争。

entries.meaning: 土著的,原来的；原始的；土著的，土生土长的；土著
entries.example: The museum displays aboriginal art from the northern region.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出北部地区的土著艺术。

entries.example: An aborigine guided us through the desert trails.
entries.exampleZh: 一位土著居民带我们穿过沙漠小径。

entries.example: The crew decided to abort the launch when the weather worsened.
entries.exampleZh: 由于天气恶化，机组人员决定中止发射。

entries.example: Their abortive attempt to climb the peak ended in defeat.
entries.exampleZh: 他们那次登顶尝试以失败告终。

entries.meaning: 富于, 充满；富于；大量存在；充满
entries.example: Rumours abound that the factory will close before the end of the year.
entries.exampleZh: 有传言说这家工厂将在年底前关闭。

entries.meaning: 在…上方,多(大,高)于；在上面
entries.example: The instructions above apply only to full-time employees.
entries.exampleZh: 上述说明只适用于全职员工。

entries.example: The aboveground parking area fills up quickly on weekdays.
entries.exampleZh: 地面停车场在工作日很快就满了。

entries.example: The hiker's boots showed signs of abrasion after the long trek.
entries.exampleZh: 长途跋涉后，这位徒步者的靴子出现了磨损痕迹。

entries.meaning: 并肩地, 并排地；并列地，并排地
entries.example: The two runners stayed abreast for most of the race.
entries.exampleZh: 两名跑步者在比赛的大部分时间里并排前进。

entries.example: The publisher plans to abridge the novel for younger readers.
entries.exampleZh: 出版社计划为年轻读者删节这部小说。

entries.example: She spent two years abroad before returning to her hometown.
entries.exampleZh: 她在国外待了两年才回到家乡。

entries.meaning: 突然的,陡峭的,生硬的；突然的，意外的；唐突的，鲁莽的
entries.example: The meeting came to an abrupt end when the fire alarm rang.
entries.exampleZh: 火警响起时，会议突然结束了。

entries.example: The conversation ended abruptly when he mentioned the unpaid debt.
entries.exampleZh: 当他提到那笔未偿债务时，谈话突然中断了。

entries.example: The abruptness of his reply surprised everyone at the table.
entries.exampleZh: 他回答的唐突让在座的每个人都感到意外。

entries.meaning: 不在, 缺席, 缺乏, 没有；缺席；缺乏
entries.example: The absence of clear evidence made the trial drag on.
entries.exampleZh: 缺乏明确证据使审判拖了很久。

entries.example: Three students were absent from class on Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 星期一上午有三名学生缺课。

entries.meaning: 旷课, 旷工；旷课；旷工
entries.example: High absenteeism at the factory forced managers to hire temporary staff.
entries.exampleZh: 工厂旷工率高，迫使管理者雇用临时工。

entries.meaning: 完全的, 绝对的；完全的，绝对的；地道的；无疑的，确凿的；不受限制的，不受约束的
entries.example: The new ruler demanded absolute loyalty from every citizen.
entries.exampleZh: 新统治者要求每个公民绝对忠诚。

entries.example: I am absolutely certain that I locked the door.
entries.exampleZh: 我完全确定我锁了门。

entries.example: The court decided to absolve him of all charges.
entries.exampleZh: 法庭决定免除他的所有指控。

entries.meaning: 吸收,吸引；吸收；理解，掌握；吸引…的注意，使全神贯注；使并入，同化
entries.example: Plants absorb water and nutrients through their roots.
entries.exampleZh: 植物通过根部吸收水分和养分。

entries.meaning: 吸收；吸收；全神贯注，专心致志
entries.example: The absorption of sunlight by dark surfaces raises temperatures.
entries.exampleZh: 深色表面对阳光的吸收会提高温度。

entries.meaning: 摘要,抽象；抽象的；抽象派的；摘要，梗概；做…的摘要；提取
entries.example: The abstract concept of justice puzzles many first-year law students.
entries.exampleZh: 正义这一抽象概念让许多法学一年级学生感到困惑。

entries.example: Her essay moves from concrete detail to pure abstraction too quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 她的文章从具体细节转向纯粹抽象，速度太快了。

entries.meaning: 荒谬的, 可笑的；可笑的，荒唐的
entries.example: It seems absurd to blame the weather for our poor planning.
entries.exampleZh: 因为规划不周而责怪天气，这似乎很荒唐。

entries.example: The region enjoys an abundance of fresh water and fertile soil.
entries.exampleZh: 该地区拥有丰富的新鲜水源和肥沃土壤。

entries.meaning: 丰富的,充裕的；大量的，充足的，丰富的
entries.example: Abundant rainfall makes this valley ideal for growing rice.
entries.exampleZh: 充沛的降雨使这个山谷非常适合种植水稻。

entries.example: The report makes abundantly clear that urgent action is required.
entries.exampleZh: 报告非常清楚地表明，必须采取紧急行动。

entries.example: Several workers reported abuse at the hands of their supervisor.
entries.exampleZh: 几名工人举报遭到主管的虐待。

entries.meaning: 邻接, 毗邻；邻接，毗邻
entries.example: The new library will abut the old town hall on its north side.
entries.exampleZh: 新图书馆将毗邻旧市政厅的北侧。

entries.meaning: 深不可测的；极坏的，糟透的
entries.example: His performance in the final was abysmal, and the crowd booed.
entries.exampleZh: 他在决赛中的表现糟透了，观众发出了嘘声。

entries.meaning: 学院的, 理论的；学术的；学校的，学院的；纯理论的；大学教师
entries.example: She balances her academic duties with a busy family life.
entries.exampleZh: 她在学术职责与忙碌的家庭生活之间取得平衡。

entries.example: He struggled academically at first but soon found his stride.
entries.exampleZh: 他起初在学业上很吃力，但很快找到了状态。

entries.example: The old academician still lectures at the national research institute.
entries.exampleZh: 这位老院士仍在国家研究所讲课。

entries.meaning: 学院,学会,专科学校；学会，研究院；专科院校
entries.example: The young violinist won a place at the royal academy.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻的小提琴手获得了皇家学院的入学名额。

entries.example: The government finally agreed to accede to the treaty terms.
entries.exampleZh: 政府最终同意接受该条约的条款。

entries.example: New investment could accelerate the growth of the local economy.
entries.exampleZh: 新的投资可能会加快当地经济的增长。

entries.example: The car's acceleration impressed everyone who rode in it.
entries.exampleZh: 这辆车的加速性能让每个乘坐过的人都印象深刻。

entries.meaning: 重音；口音；重音符号；重读
entries.example: Her soft Scottish accent makes the interview pleasant to listen to.
entries.exampleZh: 她柔和的苏格兰口音让这次面试听起来很愉快。

entries.example: I accept your apology, though the delay caused real trouble.
entries.exampleZh: 我接受你的道歉，尽管那次延误确实带来了麻烦。

entries.example: Loud music at midnight is hardly acceptable in a quiet building.
entries.exampleZh: 在安静的楼里半夜放很大声的音乐几乎不可接受。

entries.example: Her acceptance of the offer surprised everyone in the department.
entries.exampleZh: 她接受了那份邀约，这让系里所有人都感到意外。

entries.meaning: 入口,通道；进入；通道；接近，进入；机会；进入；使用；存取
entries.example: Students can access the online library from any campus computer.
entries.exampleZh: 学生可以从任何一台校园电脑访问在线图书馆。

entries.example: The new ramp greatly improves accessibility for visitors in wheelchairs.
entries.exampleZh: 新的坡道大大方便了坐轮椅的游客通行。

entries.meaning: 可得到的,易接近的；易接近的；可得到的；可进入的
entries.example: Our research data is now accessible to every student in the department.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的研究数据现在系里每位学生都可以获取。

entries.meaning: 附件；辅助的；附件，零件；配饰；从犯，同谋
entries.example: She bought a matching scarf as an accessory for her new coat.
entries.exampleZh: 她买了一条相配的围巾，作为新大衣的配饰。

entries.meaning: 意外事件, 事故；意外事件，事故
entries.example: The accident on the highway delayed our journey by two hours.
entries.exampleZh: 高速公路上那起事故使我们的行程延误了两个小时。

entries.example: The fire was purely accidental and nobody was blamed for it.
entries.exampleZh: 那场火灾纯属意外，没有人因此受到责罚。

entries.example: I accidentally deleted the file before saving a copy of it.
entries.exampleZh: 我不小心在保存副本之前把文件删掉了。

entries.meaning: 喝采, 欢呼；喝彩，称赞
entries.example: Her first novel won wide acclaim from critics across Europe.
entries.exampleZh: 她的第一部小说赢得了全欧洲评论家的广泛赞誉。

entries.meaning: 容纳,提供(住处),适应；提供；容纳；适应，顺应
entries.example: The new hall can accommodate up to eight hundred guests.
entries.exampleZh: 新礼堂可容纳多达八百位客人。

entries.example: She sang the old folk song with a simple piano accompaniment.
entries.exampleZh: 她用简单的钢琴伴奏唱了那首老民歌。

entries.meaning: 陪伴,伴奏；为…伴奏；陪伴，陪同；伴随，和…一起发生
entries.example: My brother will accompany me to the interview on Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我哥哥会陪我去参加周一上午的面试。

entries.meaning: 完成,实现；达到；完成；实现
entries.example: We can accomplish far more as a team than alone.
entries.exampleZh: 作为一个团队，我们能完成的事情远多于单打独斗。

entries.meaning: 成就, 完成；成就；完成；才艺，技艺
entries.example: Finishing the marathon was a real accomplishment for my father.
entries.exampleZh: 跑完马拉松对我父亲来说是一项真正的成就。

entries.meaning: 一致, 协定；与…一致，符合；协议，条约
entries.example: Both sides finally reached an accord after long nightly talks.
entries.exampleZh: 经过漫长的夜间会谈，双方终于达成了一项协议。

entries.meaning: 因此, 相应地, 于是
entries.example: The rules changed, so we adjusted our plan accordingly.
entries.exampleZh: 规则变了，因此我们相应地调整了计划。

entries.example: An old man played the accordion on the corner of the street.
entries.exampleZh: 一位老人在街角拉着手风琴。

entries.meaning: 记述,帐(户),解释；说明,占；说明，解释；占；解释，描述，叙述；账目；账户
entries.example: Please give a brief account of what happened that rainy night.
entries.exampleZh: 请简要叙述那个雨夜发生的事情。

entries.example: Our accountant checks every invoice before the monthly report is sent.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的会计在寄出月度报告前会核对每一张发票。

entries.example: She studied accounting for four years before joining a small firm.
entries.exampleZh: 她在加入一家小公司之前学了四年会计。

entries.meaning: 委任，授权；把…归于；正式认可
entries.example: The board will accredit the new training center next spring.
entries.exampleZh: 董事会将于明年春天正式认可这家新的培训中心。

entries.meaning: 共生, 附着, 增加
entries.example: Over time, small particles accrete to form larger bodies in space.
entries.exampleZh: 随着时间推移，微小颗粒在太空中附着形成更大的天体。

entries.meaning: 积聚,堆积；积累，积聚，堆积
entries.example: Dust and dirt accumulate quickly behind the refrigerator in our kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 灰尘和污垢很快在我们厨房的冰箱后面积聚起来。

entries.example: The accumulation of snow blocked the mountain road for several days.
entries.exampleZh: 雪的堆积堵塞了山路好几天。

entries.example: The old car needs a new accumulator before it can start again.
entries.exampleZh: 那辆旧车在能再次启动前需要一个新的蓄电池。

entries.meaning: 精确性, 正确度；准确，精确
entries.example: The accuracy of these measurements depends on careful calibration.
entries.exampleZh: 这些测量的准确性取决于仔细的校准。

entries.meaning: 准确的,精确的；正确无误的，精确的
entries.example: Her description of the event was surprisingly accurate and detailed.
entries.exampleZh: 她对事件的描述出奇地准确而详细。

entries.example: He denied the accusation and demanded a formal public apology.
entries.exampleZh: 他否认了这项指控，并要求正式公开道歉。

entries.meaning: 控告, 谴责；谴责；指责，归咎；指控，控告
entries.example: Do not accuse anyone without clear evidence and careful thought.
entries.exampleZh: 没有明确证据和仔细思考，不要指责任何人。

entries.example: You must accustom yourself to the cold weather here gradually.
entries.exampleZh: 你必须逐渐使自己去适应这里的寒冷天气。

entries.example: The chemist added sodium acetate to the clear solution.
entries.exampleZh: 化学家向透明溶液中加入了醋酸钠。

entries.meaning: 做得成的, 可完成的
entries.example: This target is achievable if we work together and plan carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 如果我们齐心协力并仔细规划，这个目标是可以实现的。

entries.example: She worked hard to achieve her goal before the deadline.
entries.exampleZh: 她在截止日期前努力工作以实现目标。

entries.example: Winning that award was a major achievement for the young team.
entries.exampleZh: 赢得那个奖项对这支年轻队伍来说是一项重大成就。

entries.example: The song sounded achingly beautiful in the quiet concert hall.
entries.exampleZh: 这首歌在安静的音乐厅里听起来美得令人心痛。

entries.example: The museum displayed a rare achondrite found in the desert.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了一块在沙漠中发现的罕见无球粒陨石。

entries.meaning: 酸；酸的；酸的，酸味的；尖刻的，刻薄的；酸，酸性物质
entries.example: The acid in the lemon juice can damage a sensitive tooth.
entries.exampleZh: 柠檬汁里的酸会损伤敏感的牙齿。

entries.example: This acidic soil is unsuitable for most vegetables and flowering plants.
entries.exampleZh: 这种酸性土壤不适合大多数蔬菜和开花植物。

entries.meaning: 酸度, 酸性, [医]酸过多, 胃酸过多；酸度；酸性
entries.example: The acidity of the wine affects its taste and color.
entries.exampleZh: 葡萄酒的酸度影响其味道和颜色。

entries.meaning: 承认, 答谢；承认，确认；对…表示感谢
entries.example: She refused to acknowledge the mistake during the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 她拒绝在会议期间承认那个错误。

entries.example: A squirrel buried a small acorn beneath the old oak tree.
entries.exampleZh: 一只松鼠把一颗小橡子埋在老橡树下。

entries.meaning: 有关声音的, 声学的；非电声乐器的，原声的；听觉的，声音的
entries.example: The theatre's acoustic design allows even whispers to reach the back rows.
entries.exampleZh: 剧院的声学设计使即使耳语也能传到后排。

entries.example: Proper acoustical treatment of the room reduced the echo dramatically.
entries.exampleZh: 对房间进行适当的声学处理大大减少了回声。

entries.meaning: 使熟知, 通知；使认识；使熟悉
entries.example: The induction day helped acquaint new staff with the company's safety rules.
entries.exampleZh: 入职介绍日帮助新员工熟悉公司的安全规定。

entries.example: An old acquaintance from university called me unexpectedly last night.
entries.exampleZh: 一位大学时代的旧相识昨晚突然给我打电话。

entries.example: She chose to acquiesce rather than argue with the committee.
entries.exampleZh: 她选择默许，而不是与委员会争论。

entries.example: Children acquire language skills faster when they hear it daily.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们如果每天听到这种语言，掌握语言技能会更快。

entries.meaning: 获得(物)；习得，获得；收购，购置
entries.example: The firm announced its acquisition of a smaller rival yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 该公司昨天宣布收购一家规模较小的竞争对手。

entries.example: The jury voted to acquit the defendant after brief deliberation.
entries.exampleZh: 陪审团经过简短商议后投票判定被告无罪。

entries.example: They grow organic wheat on every acre of the family farm.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在家庭农场的每一英亩土地上都种植有机小麦。

entries.example: The total acreage of the estate exceeds two thousand hectares.
entries.exampleZh: 这座庄园的总面积超过两千公顷。

entries.meaning: 只取首字母的缩写词；首字母缩写词
entries.example: NATO is an acronym formed from the alliance's full name.
entries.exampleZh: 北约是由该联盟全名首字母构成的缩写词。

entries.meaning: 穿过,在对面；横过；到对面，向对面；穿过，越过；在对面
entries.example: A narrow bridge runs across the river near the old mill.
entries.exampleZh: 一座窄桥横跨河流，就在老磨坊附近。

entries.example: Her generous act of kindness surprised everyone in the office.
entries.exampleZh: 她那慷慨的善举让办公室里的每个人都感到惊讶。

entries.example: The acting was superb, though the plot felt rather thin.
entries.exampleZh: 表演非常出色，尽管情节有些单薄。

entries.example: Quick action by the crew prevented a serious accident.
entries.exampleZh: 船员们的迅速行动避免了一场严重的事故。

entries.meaning: 激活, 使活动；刺激，使活动
entries.example: Press this button to activate the alarm system instantly.
entries.exampleZh: 按下这个按钮即可立即启动警报系统。

entries.meaning: 积极的,活跃的,起作用的
entries.example: She remains active in local politics despite her busy career.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管工作繁忙，她仍然活跃于当地政坛。

entries.example: The group actively campaigns against plastic waste in rivers.
entries.exampleZh: 该组织积极反对河流中的塑料垃圾。

entries.meaning: 激进主义分子, 行动主义分子
entries.example: A young activist organised the protest outside city hall.
entries.exampleZh: 一位年轻的行动主义者组织了市政厅外的抗议活动。

entries.example: The lead actor forgot his lines during the final scene.
entries.exampleZh: 男主角在最后一场戏中忘了台词。

entries.example: The actress won a major award for her role in the film.
entries.exampleZh: 这位女演员因在这部电影中的角色获得了一项重要奖项。

entries.example: The actual cost of the trip was much lower than expected.
entries.exampleZh: 这次旅行的实际费用比预期低得多。

entries.example: Her business acumen helped the company survive a difficult year.
entries.exampleZh: 她的商业敏锐帮助公司度过了艰难的一年。

entries.meaning: 敏锐的, 急性的；严重的；极度的，激烈的；敏锐的
entries.example: Dogs have an acute sense of smell and hearing.
entries.exampleZh: 狗有敏锐的嗅觉和听觉。

entries.meaning: 坚定不移的，坚决的；固执的
entries.example: She remained adamant that the decision was fair and final.
entries.exampleZh: 她坚持认为这个决定公平且最终有效。

entries.meaning: 适应,改编；适合；适应；调整；改编，改写
entries.example: Many newcomers quickly adapt to the local climate and customs.
entries.exampleZh: 许多新来者很快适应了当地的气候和习俗。

entries.example: Her adaptability makes her valuable in fast-changing workplaces.
entries.exampleZh: 她的适应能力使她在快速变化的工作场所中很有价值。

entries.meaning: 能适应的,适应性强的；能适应的；可改编的
entries.example: The adaptable design suits both small flats and large offices.
entries.exampleZh: 这种适应性强的设计既适合小公寓，也适合大办公室。

entries.meaning: 适应, 改编, 改写本
entries.example: The film adaptation of the novel received mixed reviews.
entries.exampleZh: 这部小说的电影改编版收到了褒贬不一的评价。

entries.meaning: 适合的, 适应的；适合的，有适应性的
entries.example: The adaptive learning software adjusts lessons to each student's pace.
entries.exampleZh: 这种自适应学习软件会根据每个学生的进度调整课程。

entries.meaning: 使人上瘾的；使人沉醉的，醉心的
entries.example: Social media can be highly addictive for young users.
entries.exampleZh: 社交媒体对年轻用户来说可能极易上瘾。

entries.meaning: 加,增加,附加物；加，加法；添加，增加
entries.example: In addition to tea, the shop sells handmade cakes and cookies.
entries.exampleZh: 除了茶，这家店还卖手工蛋糕和饼干。

entries.example: We need additional staff to handle the holiday rush.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要额外的人手来应对假日高峰。

entries.example: The hotel additionally offers free breakfast and evening snacks.
entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店还提供免费早餐和晚间小吃。

entries.meaning: 附加的；添加剂；〔食品的〕添加剂，添加物
entries.example: This food additive gives the sauce a brighter color.
entries.exampleZh: 这种食品添加剂使酱汁颜色更鲜亮。

entries.meaning: 地址,演说 vt写地址,演说；作讲话；写姓名地址；地址；讲话
entries.example: Please write your address clearly on the envelope before mailing it.
entries.exampleZh: 寄信前请把你的地址清楚地写在信封上。

entries.meaning: 熟练的, 老练的 n老手, 擅长者；熟练的，精通的，内行的；行家，熟手
entries.example: She is adept at solving difficult problems under pressure.
entries.exampleZh: 她善于在压力下解决难题。

entries.example: Critics questioned the adequacy of the safety measures at the plant.
entries.exampleZh: 批评者质疑工厂安全措施是否充分。

entries.meaning: 足够的,适当的；适当的；足够的；适当的，胜任的
entries.example: The room was small but adequate for a short stay.
entries.exampleZh: 房间虽小，但短暂停留足够用。

entries.example: The instructions were not adequately explained to the new employees.
entries.exampleZh: 这些说明没有向新员工充分解释清楚。

entries.meaning: 粘附,遵守；黏附，附着；坚持；遵守
entries.example: All members must adhere strictly to the safety rules during every experiment.
entries.exampleZh: 所有成员在每次实验中都必须严格遵守安全规则。

entries.example: This strong adhesive works best on clean, dry surfaces.
entries.exampleZh: 这种强力黏合剂在清洁干燥的表面上效果最好。

entries.meaning: 邻近的,毗连的；邻近的，毗连的
entries.example: The library stands adjacent to a small park and a busy cafe.
entries.exampleZh: 图书馆紧邻一个小公园和一家繁忙的咖啡馆。

entries.meaning: 邻接, 毗连；贴近，紧挨，毗连
entries.example: The two gardens adjoin each other along a low stone wall.
entries.exampleZh: 两个花园沿着一道矮石墙彼此毗连。

entries.meaning: 附件, 助手；附属的；附加物，附件；附加语，修饰语
entries.example: Online practice is a useful adjunct to regular classroom lessons.
entries.exampleZh: 在线练习是常规课堂课程的有益补充。

entries.meaning: 调整,校准；调整，调节；适合，适应；校正，校准
entries.example: You may need to adjust the seat before starting the car.
entries.exampleZh: 启动汽车前，你可能需要调整座椅。

entries.example: A small adjustment to the recipe made the soup taste better.
entries.exampleZh: 对食谱做一点小调整就让汤的味道更好了。

entries.meaning: 管理, 给予, 执行；管理；执行；给予，提供
entries.example: The nurse will administer the medicine after checking your blood pressure.
entries.exampleZh: 护士会在检查你的血压后给你用药。

entries.example: The hospital administration announced new visiting hours for all patients.
entries.exampleZh: 医院管理部门宣布了所有病人的新探视时间。

entries.example: She handles administrative tasks while the manager attends client meetings.
entries.exampleZh: 经理会见客户时，她负责处理行政事务。

entries.example: The new administrator promised to review every department's budget carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 新任管理者承诺仔细审查每个部门的预算。

entries.meaning: 令人钦佩的,令人赞赏的
entries.example: Her decision to help the stranded family was truly admirable.
entries.exampleZh: 她帮助受困家庭的决定确实令人钦佩。

entries.meaning: 海军上将, 舰队司令
entries.example: The admiral ordered the fleet to return to port before nightfall.
entries.exampleZh: 海军上将命令舰队在夜幕降临前返回港口。

entries.meaning: 钦佩, 赞美, 羡慕；钦佩，赞赏，羡慕
entries.example: Her courage during the crisis filled everyone with deep admiration.
entries.exampleZh: 她在危机中的勇气让每个人都深感钦佩。

entries.meaning: 赞美,钦佩,羡慕；钦佩，仰慕；欣赏
entries.example: I admire the patience she shows when teaching young children.
entries.exampleZh: 我钦佩她教小孩子时表现出的耐心。

entries.meaning: 允许进入, 承认, 许可；准许进入；入场费；承认
entries.example: The museum offers free admission to students with valid cards.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆对持有效证件的学生免费开放。

entries.meaning: 承认,准许；承认；准许…进入，接纳
entries.example: He refused to admit that his mistake caused the delay.
entries.exampleZh: 他拒绝承认自己的错误导致了延误。

entries.meaning: 不可否认的, 公认地
entries.example: The plan, admittedly, sounds risky, but we have few alternatives.
entries.exampleZh: 诚然，这个计划听起来有风险，但我们几乎没有其他选择。

entries.example: The villagers built their homes from adobe and local wood.
entries.exampleZh: 村民们用土坯和当地木材建造房屋。

entries.example: Her interest in science began during adolescence and never faded.
entries.exampleZh: 她对科学的兴趣始于青春期，而且从未消退。

entries.example: As an adolescent, she found the rules at home unusually strict.
entries.exampleZh: 作为一个青少年，她觉得家里的规矩异常严格。

entries.meaning: 采用,收养；采用；收养，领养；正式通过，批准
entries.example: The council decided to adopt a stricter policy on waste disposal.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会决定对垃圾处理采取更严格的政策。

entries.example: The adoption of new safety measures was welcomed by most workers.
entries.exampleZh: 新安全措施的采用受到了大多数工人的欢迎。

entries.example: Fresh flowers adorn the tables in the little cafe every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 每天早上鲜花装饰着这家小咖啡馆的桌子。

entries.example: The room's only adornment was a faded painting above the fireplace.
entries.exampleZh: 这房间唯一的装饰是壁炉上方一幅褪色的画。

entries.meaning: 肾上腺素(使激动兴奋等)
entries.example: The sudden noise sent a rush of adrenaline through his body.
entries.exampleZh: 突如其来的响声让他体内涌起一阵肾上腺素。

entries.example: After the storm, the small boat was left adrift near the shore.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，那条小船在岸边附近漂流。

entries.meaning: 精明的，干练的；熟练的，灵巧的
entries.example: Her adroit handling of the complaint impressed the entire team.
entries.exampleZh: 她对这起投诉的巧妙处理给整个团队留下了深刻印象。

entries.example: Every adult in the room understood what the teacher meant.
entries.exampleZh: 房间里的每个成年人都明白老师的意思。

entries.example: He spent most of his adulthood working in a small coastal town.
entries.exampleZh: 他成年后的大部分时间都在一个海滨小镇工作。

entries.meaning: 前进，向前移动；发展，进步；促进；预付；预先的；先头的；前进；进展；预付
entries.example: Please advance the deadline by two days if possible.
entries.exampleZh: 如果可能的话，请把截止日期提前两天。

entries.meaning: 先进的；高级的，高等的；晚期的，后期的
entries.example: This hospital uses advanced equipment to treat rare heart conditions.
entries.exampleZh: 这家医院使用先进的设备治疗罕见的心脏疾病。

entries.example: Hard work alone does not guarantee advancement in this company.
entries.exampleZh: 仅靠努力工作并不能保证在这家公司得到晋升。

entries.meaning: 优势,有利条件；有利于；优点；优势，有利条件；有益于
entries.example: Living near the station gives her a clear advantage over other commuters.
entries.exampleZh: 住在车站附近让她比其他通勤者有明显优势。

entries.example: The early start proved highly advantageous for the whole research group.
entries.exampleZh: 提早开始对整个研究小组来说非常有利。

entries.example: The new road places the factory advantageously close to the port.
entries.exampleZh: 这条新路使工厂处于靠近港口的有利位置。

entries.meaning: 出现，到来；到来，来临；出现
entries.example: The advent of cheap flights changed travel habits across Europe.
entries.exampleZh: 廉价航班的出现改变了整个欧洲的旅行习惯。

entries.example: His success was largely adventitious rather than the result of planning.
entries.exampleZh: 他的成功在很大程度上是偶然的，而非计划的结果。

entries.meaning: 冒险；冒险,大胆说出来；奇遇；冒险活动
entries.example: Their trip to the mountains turned into a real adventure.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的山区之行变成了一次真正的冒险。

entries.example: The old sailor was a famous adventurer in his younger days.
entries.exampleZh: 这位老水手年轻时是个著名的冒险家。

entries.example: She is far too adventurous to settle for a quiet office job.
entries.exampleZh: 她太爱冒险了，不会满足于一份安静的办公室工作。

entries.example: He treated every rival as a worthy adversary rather than an enemy.
entries.exampleZh: 他把每个对手都当作值得尊敬的敌手，而不是敌人。

entries.meaning: 不利的，有害的；负面的；不利的；逆的
entries.example: The new policy had an adverse effect on small local businesses.
entries.exampleZh: 新政策对本地小企业产生了不利影响。

entries.example: Her health was adversely affected by years of night shifts.
entries.exampleZh: 多年的夜班对她的健康造成了不良影响。

entries.example: She faced real adversity with courage and never complained to anyone.
entries.exampleZh: 她勇敢地面对真正的逆境，从未向任何人抱怨过。

entries.meaning: 登广告,宣传；为…做广告，宣传；公告，公布
entries.example: They plan to advertise the new product on several popular websites.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划在几个热门网站上为新产品做广告。

entries.example: A bright advertisement for coffee covered the whole side of the bus.
entries.exampleZh: 一则明亮的咖啡广告占满了公交车的整个侧面。

entries.example: The advertiser paid a huge sum for a spot during the final.
entries.exampleZh: 广告客户花了一大笔钱买下决赛期间的一个广告时段。

entries.example: My mentor gave me useful advice about choosing a career path.
entries.exampleZh: 我的导师就选择职业道路给了我有用的建议。

entries.example: It is advisable to book your tickets well before the holiday begins.
entries.exampleZh: 最好在假期开始前尽早订票。

entries.meaning: 劝告, 忠告, 警告, 建议
entries.example: Doctors advise patients to reduce salt and walk every day.
entries.exampleZh: 医生建议病人少吃盐并每天散步。

entries.example: Her financial adviser warned her against investing in that risky scheme.
entries.exampleZh: 她的财务顾问警告她不要投资那个高风险的方案。

entries.meaning: 顾问的，咨询的；劝告的；警报
entries.example: The government issued an advisory warning travellers about the heavy storms.
entries.exampleZh: 政府发布了一份警报，提醒旅客注意强风暴。

entries.example: Many doctors advocate a balanced diet and regular exercise for everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 许多医生提倡人人饮食均衡、经常锻炼。

entries.meaning: 空中的，地表以上的；从飞行器上的；天线
entries.example: We fixed a new aerial to the roof to improve reception.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在屋顶装了一根新天线以改善信号接收。

entries.example: The museum displays early aero engines and old flying machines.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出早期的航空发动机和古老的飞行器。

entries.example: She teaches aerobics at the local gym three evenings a week.
entries.exampleZh: 她每周有三个晚上在当地健身房教有氧运动。

entries.example: Engineers redesigned the car's body to make it more aerodynamic.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师重新设计了车身，使其更具空气动力学性能。

entries.meaning: 美学的,审美的；审美的，美学的；美的，艺术的
entries.example: The building's aesthetic appeal matters as much as its strength.
entries.exampleZh: 这座建筑的美学吸引力与它的坚固同样重要。

entries.example: The two rooms are functionally similar but aesthetically very different.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个房间在功能上相似，但在审美上差别很大。

entries.example: From afar, the old lighthouse looked like a lonely sentinel.
entries.exampleZh: 从远处看，那座老灯塔像一位孤独的哨兵。

entries.meaning: 和蔼可亲的，易于交谈的，友善的
entries.example: Her affable manner made strangers feel welcome at every meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 她亲切和蔼的举止让陌生人在每次会面中都感到受欢迎。

entries.example: The whole affair was handled quietly by the family lawyer.
entries.exampleZh: 整件事由家庭律师悄悄处理了。

entries.example: Loud traffic outside can affect your ability to concentrate.
entries.exampleZh: 外面的喧闹交通会影响你集中注意力的能力。

entries.meaning: 影响, 感情；喜爱，钟爱；
entries.example: She felt deep affection for the small village where she grew up.
entries.exampleZh: 她对那个自己长大的小村庄怀有深厚的感情。

entries.example: Psychologists study affectional bonds between parents and their young children.
entries.exampleZh: 心理学家研究父母与年幼子女之间的情感纽带。

entries.meaning: 使隶属于；附属机构；分公司
entries.example: The local radio station is an affiliate of a national network.
entries.exampleZh: 这家本地广播电台是一家全国性网络的附属机构。

entries.meaning: 密切关系,类同；密切关系；吸引力；喜爱
entries.example: He has a natural affinity for languages and learns them quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 他对语言有一种天生的亲近感，学得很快。

entries.meaning: 断言, 确认；断言，坚持声称；证实，确认
entries.example: I can affirm that the report is completely accurate.
entries.exampleZh: 我可以确认这份报告完全准确。

entries.meaning: 使附于, 粘贴 n[语]词缀
entries.example: Please affix a stamp to the envelope before mailing it.
entries.exampleZh: 请在寄出前把邮票贴在信封上。

entries.meaning: 使痛苦, 折磨；使苦恼，折磨
entries.example: Chronic pain can afflict people for many years without relief.
entries.exampleZh: 慢性疼痛可能折磨人多年而得不到缓解。

entries.meaning: 丰富的, 富裕的；丰富的；富裕的
entries.example: They moved to an affluent suburb with large houses and good schools.
entries.exampleZh: 他们搬到了一个拥有大房子和好学校的富裕郊区。

entries.meaning: 提供,给予；买得起，担负得起；冒险做；提供，给予
entries.example: We cannot afford to waste any more time on this.
entries.exampleZh: 我们不能再在这件事上浪费任何时间了。

entries.example: The city needs more affordable housing for young working families.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市需要为年轻工薪家庭提供更多负担得起的住房。

entries.example: His rude remark was a clear affront to everyone at the table.
entries.exampleZh: 他粗鲁的话对在座的每个人都是明显的冒犯。

entries.example: She spent two years teaching English in Afghanistan after college.
entries.exampleZh: 大学毕业后她在阿富汗教了两年英语。

entries.meaning: 远离着(家乡), 去远处
entries.example: Journalists traveled far afield to report on the remote conflict.
entries.exampleZh: 记者们远赴他乡报道那场偏远的冲突。

entries.meaning: 飘浮的, 传播的；漂浮地；漂浮的；有偿债能力的，能维持下去的
entries.example: The small boat stayed afloat despite the rough waves.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管波浪汹涌，小船仍然漂浮着。

entries.example: The company fell afoul of strict new environmental regulations.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司触犯了严格的新环保法规。

entries.example: She was afraid to speak up during the heated discussion.
entries.exampleZh: 在那场激烈的讨论中，她害怕发言。

entries.example: Many visitors travel to Africa to see its remarkable wildlife and landscapes.
entries.exampleZh: 许多游客前往非洲观赏其非凡的野生动物和风景。

entries.example: The African delegates shared their experiences during the international conference in Geneva.
entries.exampleZh: 非洲代表们在日内瓦的国际会议上分享了他们的经历。

entries.example: Some ancient cultures believed the afterlife would reward the virtuous with eternal peace.
entries.exampleZh: 一些古代文化相信来世会以永恒安宁奖赏有德之人。

entries.example: The community struggled to rebuild in the aftermath of the devastating flood.
entries.exampleZh: 在毁灭性洪水过后，社区艰难重建。

entries.example: We spent the entire afternoon discussing the proposal in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在花园里花了整个下午讨论该提案。

entries.example: She finished her lecture and afterward answered questions from the audience.
entries.exampleZh: 她结束讲座后，随后回答了听众的问题。

entries.example: We watched the film and afterwards walked home under the quiet stars.
entries.exampleZh: 我们看完电影，之后在静谧的星空下走回家。

entries.example: The teacher asked us to review the difficult chapter once again.
entries.exampleZh: 老师让我们把这个难章节再复习一遍。

entries.example: The local residents voted against the proposed factory near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 当地居民投票反对在河边拟建的工厂。

entries.example: The company introduced new policies to combat ageism in hiring and promotion.
entries.exampleZh: 公司出台了新政策，以打击招聘和晋升中的年龄歧视。

entries.meaning: 代理处, 中介；代理处，经销机构；专门机构
entries.example: She works for a travel agency that specializes in adventurous group tours.
entries.exampleZh: 她在一家专门经营探险团体游的旅行社工作。

entries.example: The chair added several urgent items to the meeting agenda.
entries.exampleZh: 主席在会议议程中增加了几个紧急事项。

entries.example: The real estate agent showed us three houses near the city center.
entries.exampleZh: 房地产经纪人带我们看了市中心附近的三栋房子。

entries.meaning: 使恶化, 加重；恶化，加重；激怒
entries.example: Lack of sleep can aggravate the symptoms of this chronic illness.
entries.exampleZh: 缺乏睡眠会加重这种慢性病的症状。

entries.example: The new policy aims to ameliorate the housing crisis in rural areas.
entries.exampleZh: 新政策旨在改善农村地区的住房危机。

entries.meaning: 顺从的；对…负有责任(义务)的；顺从的，服从劝导的；有服从义务的
entries.example: The manager seemed amenable to changing the schedule after our request.
entries.exampleZh: 在我们提出请求后，经理似乎愿意调整日程。

entries.example: The committee voted to amend the rules before the next season.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会投票决定在下个赛季前修订规则。

entries.example: Lawmakers approved an amendment that protects workers from unfair dismissal.
entries.exampleZh: 立法者通过了一项保护工人免遭不公平解雇的修正案。

entries.meaning: 宜人, 礼仪；生活设施；便利设施
entries.example: The hotel offers every amenity needed for a comfortable business trip.
entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店提供舒适商务旅行所需的一切便利设施。

entries.meaning: 有关美国的文物, 史料
entries.example: The museum displays rare americana from the nineteenth century.
entries.exampleZh: 这家博物馆展出十九世纪罕见的美国文物。

entries.meaning: 美国所创, 美国风俗, 美国精神
entries.example: The essay examines americanism as a cultural force in global cinema.
entries.exampleZh: 这篇文章探讨美国精神如何成为全球电影中的一种文化力量。

entries.meaning: 可爱的；友好的，和蔼的，亲切的
entries.example: Our new neighbor seems amiable and always greets everyone warmly.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的新邻居看起来很和蔼，总是热情地问候每个人。

entries.example: The rescue team worked amid heavy rain and strong wind.
entries.exampleZh: 救援队在暴雨和强风之中工作。

entries.example: Scientists studied one amino compound under strict laboratory conditions last week.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家上周在严格的实验室条件下研究了一种氨基化合物。

entries.example: The cleaning fluid gave off a sharp smell of ammonia.
entries.exampleZh: 清洁液散发出刺鼻的氨味。

entries.example: After the accident, he suffered temporary amnesia for several days.
entries.exampleZh: 事故后，他患上了持续数日的暂时性健忘症。

entries.example: The doctor examined the amniotic fluid to check the baby's health.
entries.exampleZh: 医生检查了羊水以确认婴儿的健康状况。

entries.example: A large amount of rainwater flooded the basement after the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨后，大量雨水淹没了地下室。

entries.example: The army used amphibious vehicles to cross the wide river.
entries.exampleZh: 军队使用两栖车辆渡过宽阔的河流。

entries.meaning: 充足的, 丰富的；富足的，充足的，丰富的；宽敞的
entries.example: We had ample time to finish the report before lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 我们有充足的时间在午饭前完成报告。

entries.example: The engineer adjusted the amplification to improve the concert hall's sound.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师调整了放大倍数以改善音乐厅的音效。

entries.example: He turned down the amplifier before the guests arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 他在客人到达前调低了扩音器。

entries.meaning: 放大,详述；放大；增强；详述，充实
entries.example: The new microphone can amplify quiet voices across the large hall.
entries.exampleZh: 新麦克风能在大厅里放大轻微的声音。

entries.example: My cousin will visit Amsterdam during the spring holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 我表弟将在春假期间游览阿姆斯特丹。

entries.example: The clown tried to amuse the children with simple tricks.
entries.exampleZh: 小丑试图用简单的戏法逗孩子们开心。

entries.meaning: 娱乐, 消遣；可笑；娱乐，消遣
entries.example: The park offers rides and games for family amusement.
entries.exampleZh: 公园提供游乐设施和游戏供家庭娱乐。

entries.example: These anaerobic bacteria survive only in oxygen-free environments.
entries.exampleZh: 这些厌氧细菌只在无氧环境中存活。

entries.example: The teacher drew an analogous case from recent history.
entries.exampleZh: 老师从近代史中举了一个类似的案例。

entries.meaning: 类似, 类推；类比，类推
entries.example: She explained the idea through a clever analogy.
entries.exampleZh: 她通过一个巧妙的类比解释了这个想法。

entries.meaning: 分析,解析；分析；分析报告；分解
entries.example: The final analysis revealed several weaknesses in our plan.
entries.exampleZh: 最终分析揭示了我们的计划中的几个弱点。

entries.example: The financial analyst predicted a slow recovery next year.
entries.exampleZh: 这位金融分析师预测明年经济将缓慢复苏。

entries.example: Researchers analyze the data carefully before drawing any firm conclusions.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员在得出任何确切结论之前会仔细分析这些数据。

entries.example: The young anarchist rejected every form of government authority.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻的无政府主义者拒绝接受任何形式的政府权威。

entries.example: Such wasteful spending is anathema to the new finance director.
entries.exampleZh: 这种铺张浪费对新任财务主管来说简直不可接受。

entries.meaning: 剖析, 解剖学；解剖；解剖构造；剖析
entries.example: Medical students spend years studying human anatomy before surgery.
entries.exampleZh: 医学生在做手术之前要花数年时间学习人体解剖学。

entries.meaning: 祖先,祖宗；祖先，祖宗；原种；原型
entries.example: Her distant ancestor arrived here by ship in the eighteenth century.
entries.exampleZh: 她的远祖在十八世纪乘船来到这里。

entries.example: They returned to their ancestral village to visit distant relatives.
entries.exampleZh: 他们回到祖先的村庄探望远房亲戚。

entries.example: He traced his ancestry back to a small farming community.
entries.exampleZh: 他把自己的血统追溯到一个小农耕社群。

entries.meaning: 锚 v抛锚；抛锚；使固定；扎根，基于；主持；锚；给人安全感的物，精神支柱
entries.example: The ship dropped anchor in a quiet bay near the island.
entries.exampleZh: 那艘船在岛附近一个安静的海湾抛了锚。

entries.example: Archaeologists uncovered ancient pottery beneath the ruined temple floor.
entries.exampleZh: 考古学家在破败的庙宇地面下发现了古代陶器。

entries.meaning: 埃塞俄比亚的公主, 仙女座
entries.example: Astronomers often photograph the andromeda galaxy on clear winter nights.
entries.exampleZh: 天文学家常在晴朗的冬夜拍摄仙女座星系。

entries.meaning: 轶事的,趣闻的；轶话的，逸闻趣事的
entries.example: The evidence remains anecdotal and hardly convinces serious researchers.
entries.exampleZh: 这些证据仍属轶闻，很难让严谨的研究者信服。

entries.example: She opened her speech with a funny anecdote about travel.
entries.exampleZh: 她以一则关于旅行的有趣轶事开始了演讲。

entries.example: A sea anemone clung to the rock in the tide pool.
entries.exampleZh: 一只海葵紧紧附着在潮池里的岩石上。

entries.example: After the scandal, the committee examined the proposal anew.
entries.exampleZh: 丑闻发生后，委员会重新审查了这项提案。

entries.example: His anger faded once he heard the full explanation.
entries.exampleZh: 他听完完整的解释后，怒气就消退了。

entries.example: A rose is a familiar angiosperm found in many gardens.
entries.exampleZh: 玫瑰是一种常见的被子植物，许多花园里都有。

entries.example: Doctors measured angiotensin levels in the patient's blood sample.
entries.exampleZh: 医生测量了病人血液样本中的血管紧缩素水平。

entries.meaning: [数]角,角落；把…放置成一角度；使带上倾向性；角；角度，立场，观点
entries.example: The photographer chose a low angle to emphasize the tower.
entries.exampleZh: 摄影师选择了低角度来突出这座塔。

entries.meaning: 盎格鲁, 英裔美国人
entries.example: The anglo settlers gradually changed the region's language and customs.
entries.exampleZh: 盎格鲁移民逐渐改变了该地区的语言和风俗。

entries.example: The angry customer demanded a full refund from the manager.
entries.exampleZh: 那位愤怒的顾客要求经理全额退款。

entries.example: Physicists often measure atomic distances in angstrom units when describing crystal structures.
entries.exampleZh: 物理学家在描述晶体结构时，常用埃为单位来测量原子间距。

entries.example: Her face showed deep anguish as she listened to the terrible news.
entries.exampleZh: 听到那个可怕的消息时，她脸上流露出深深的痛苦。

entries.meaning: [生物] 有角的,生硬的,笨拙的；有角的，尖角的；消瘦的，瘦骨嶙峋的
entries.example: His angular face and sharp features made him easy to recognize.
entries.exampleZh: 他棱角分明的脸和锐利的五官让他很容易被认出来。

entries.meaning: 鼓舞；生气勃勃的；活的，有生命的；赋予生命，使有活力
entries.example: The speaker tried to animate the crowd with a passionate speech.
entries.exampleZh: 演讲者试图用一段充满激情的讲话让听众活跃起来。

entries.example: She spoke with such animation that everyone forgot the time.
entries.exampleZh: 她讲得如此生气勃勃，以至于大家都忘了时间。

entries.example: He twisted his ankle while running down the steep hill.
entries.exampleZh: 他跑下陡峭的山坡时扭伤了脚踝。

entries.meaning: 附件；并吞, 附加；兼并；附加
entries.example: The country decided to annex the neighboring territory after a long dispute.
entries.exampleZh: 经过长期争端，该国决定兼并邻国的领土。

entries.example: The storm could annihilate the small village within a few hours.
entries.exampleZh: 这场风暴可能在几小时内摧毁这个小村庄。

entries.example: The professor added a brief annotation beside each difficult line of the poem.
entries.exampleZh: 教授在诗中每一行难懂的句子旁加了一条简短的注解。

entries.meaning: 宣布,宣告；宣布；通知；声称，宣称；广播，播音
entries.example: The company will announce its new product next Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 公司将在下周一上午宣布其新产品。

entries.example: She looked annoyed when her colleague interrupted the meeting again.
entries.exampleZh: 当同事再次打断会议时，她显得很生气。

entries.meaning: 年度的；每年的，一年一度的；年报，年刊，年鉴；一年生植物
entries.example: The annual report summarizes the company's performance over the past year.
entries.exampleZh: 这份年度报告总结了公司过去一年的业绩。

entries.example: The festival is held annually in the old town square.
entries.exampleZh: 这个节庆每年都在老城广场举行。

entries.example: The court decided to annul the contract because of a serious error.
entries.exampleZh: 由于存在严重错误，法院决定取消这份合同。

entries.example: Scientists noticed an anomalous reading in the temperature data last night.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家昨晚在温度数据中发现了一个异常的读数。

entries.meaning: 不规则, 异常的人或物；反常，异常；异常的人
entries.example: The researchers could not explain the strange anomaly in their results.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员无法解释他们结果中那个奇怪的异常现象。

entries.meaning: 社会道德沦丧，失范；混乱
entries.example: Rapid social change often produces a sense of anomie among young people.
entries.exampleZh: 急剧的社会变迁常常在年轻人中造成一种失范感。

entries.meaning: 无名的；匿名的；匿名的，不具名的；无特色的，无个性特征的
entries.example: The donation was made by an anonymous supporter of the school.
entries.exampleZh: 这笔捐款是由一位不愿透露姓名的学校支持者捐赠的。

entries.example: A single ant can carry food many times its own weight.
entries.exampleZh: 一只蚂蚁能搬运比自身重量重许多倍的食物。

entries.example: There was clear antagonism between the two rival departments.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个相互竞争的部门之间存在着明显的对立。

entries.example: His antagonistic remarks during the meeting made cooperation almost impossible.
entries.exampleZh: 他在会议上的敌对言论使合作几乎无法进行。

entries.example: Scientists studying Antarctica have recorded alarming changes in its ice sheets.
entries.exampleZh: 研究南极洲的科学家记录到其冰盖令人担忧的变化。

entries.example: A hungry anteater used its long tongue to catch insects.
entries.exampleZh: 一只饥饿的食蚁兽用长舌头捕捉昆虫。

entries.example: Oral traditions often antecede written records in many ancient cultures.
entries.exampleZh: 在许多古代文化中，口头传统往往先于书面记录。

entries.example: The family kept a portrait of an antecedent from the eighteenth century.
entries.exampleZh: 这家人保存着一幅十八世纪祖先的画像。

entries.example: A young antelope sprinted across the open grassland before disappearing.
entries.exampleZh: 一只年轻的羚羊冲过开阔的草地，随后消失了。

entries.example: The old radio antenna swayed dangerously during the violent storm.
entries.exampleZh: 旧无线电天线在猛烈的暴风雨中危险地摇晃。

entries.example: Researchers found anthocyanin in the skin of these dark grapes.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员在这些深色葡萄的果皮中发现了花青素。

entries.example: Her anthropological research focused on marriage customs in rural communities.
entries.exampleZh: 她的人类学研究关注乡村社区的婚姻习俗。

entries.example: The ritual can be interpreted anthropologically as a communal response to uncertainty.
entries.exampleZh: 这一仪式可以从人类学上解释为对不确定性的一种集体回应。

entries.example: The anthropologist spent two years living with a remote mountain tribe.
entries.exampleZh: 这位人类学家花了两年时间与一个偏远山区的部落生活在一起。

entries.example: She studied anthropology before beginning a career in public health.
entries.exampleZh: 她在开始从事公共卫生工作之前学习了人类学。

entries.example: Assigning human emotions to robots is a common form of anthropomorphism.
entries.exampleZh: 把人类情感赋予机器人是一种常见的拟人化。

entries.example: Many voters remain anti toward the proposed tax increase this year.
entries.exampleZh: 许多选民今年仍反对拟议的增税方案。

entries.example: The doctor prescribed a strong antibiotic for the persistent bacterial infection.
entries.exampleZh: 医生为持续性的细菌感染开了一种强效抗生素。

entries.meaning: 预期(料),期望；预见，预期；先于…行动
entries.example: We anticipate a sharp rise in demand during the holiday season.
entries.exampleZh: 我们预计假日期间需求会大幅上升。

entries.meaning: 抗真菌的, 杀真菌的
entries.example: The gardener applied an antifungal treatment to protect the young seedlings.
entries.exampleZh: 园丁施用了抗真菌药剂来保护幼苗。

entries.example: His open antipathy toward modern art surprised his cultured friends.
entries.exampleZh: 他对现代艺术公开的反感令他有教养的朋友们感到惊讶。

entries.example: Their antiquate views on marriage seem strange to younger generations.
entries.exampleZh: 他们对婚姻的过时看法在年轻一代看来很奇怪。

entries.example: She bought an antique wooden cabinet at a local auction.
entries.exampleZh: 她在当地一场拍卖会上买了一个古董木柜。

entries.example: Scholars still debate how such huge stones were moved in antiquity.
entries.exampleZh: 学者们至今仍在争论古代人是如何搬运这些巨石的。

entries.example: In basic English lessons, hot is a common antonym of cold.
entries.exampleZh: 在基础英语课上，热是冷的常见反义词。

entries.example: The anvil passes sound vibrations from the eardrum toward the inner ear.
entries.exampleZh: 砧骨把声音振动从鼓膜传递到内耳。

entries.example: Her anxiety before the interview kept her awake most of the night.
entries.exampleZh: 面试前的焦虑让她半夜大半时间都睡不着。

entries.meaning: 渴望的, 忧虑的；渴望的；担忧的；令人焦虑的
entries.example: The parents grew anxious when their son missed the last train home.
entries.exampleZh: 儿子错过最后一班回家的火车，父母开始担忧起来。

entries.example: She waited anxiously by the phone for news from the hospital.
entries.exampleZh: 她在电话旁焦急地等待医院的消息。

entries.example: We do not go hiking in these mountains anymore during winter.
entries.exampleZh: 冬天我们不再去这些山里徒步了。

entries.example: Did anyone notice the small mistake on the final page of the report?
entries.exampleZh: 有人注意到报告最后一页上的那个小错误了吗？

entries.example: I would rather stay home tonight than go anyplace crowded and noisy.
entries.exampleZh: 今晚我宁愿待在家里，也不愿去任何拥挤吵闹的地方。

entries.example: She refused to say anything about the quarrel until everyone had calmed down.
entries.exampleZh: 在大家平静下来之前，她拒绝对那场争吵说任何话。

entries.meaning: 任何时候, 无论何时
entries.example: Feel free to call me anytime if you need help with the move.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你搬家需要帮忙，随时给我打电话。

entries.example: The forecast looked awful, but we decided to visit the beach anyway.
entries.exampleZh: 天气预报看起来很糟，但我们还是决定去海滩。

entries.example: You can sit anywhere you like in this spacious, well-lit reading room.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以随意坐在这个宽敞明亮的阅览室的任何地方。

entries.example: Construction of the new bridge is proceeding apace despite the heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管大雨不断，新桥的施工仍在快速推进。

entries.example: The two brothers live apart now, but they speak on the phone weekly.
entries.exampleZh: 兄弟俩现在分开住了，但他们每周都通电话。

entries.meaning: 公寓住宅；公寓套房；房间
entries.example: They rented a small apartment near the station with a lovely balcony.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在车站附近租了一套带漂亮阳台的小公寓。

entries.example: A large ape swung through the trees above the startled group of tourists.
entries.exampleZh: 一只大猿在受惊的游客头顶的树间荡过。

entries.example: A single aphid can multiply into a huge colony within a few weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 一只蚜虫在几周内就能繁殖成一大群。

entries.example: The tickets cost forty pounds apiece, which seemed rather steep to us.
entries.exampleZh: 每张票要四十英镑，对我们来说似乎相当贵。

entries.example: He called to apologize for arriving late at the dinner party.
entries.exampleZh: 他打电话为晚宴迟到而道歉。

entries.example: Many Appalachian families have preserved their traditional music for several generations.
entries.exampleZh: 许多阿帕拉契家庭把他们的传统音乐保存了好几代。

entries.meaning: 器械, 设备, 仪器；器械，器具，设备，装置；机构，组织；器官
entries.example: The laboratory apparatus must be cleaned carefully after every experiment.
entries.exampleZh: 每次实验之后都必须仔细清洗实验室的器械。

entries.meaning: 明显的,表面上的；显然的，明显的；表面上的，貌似的
entries.example: It soon became apparent that the manager had ignored our warnings.
entries.exampleZh: 很快就明显看出，经理无视了我们的警告。

entries.meaning: 呼吁,上诉；上诉，起诉；呼吁，恳求；吸引；上诉，申诉；呼吁，恳求；感染力，吸引力
entries.example: The charity launched an urgent appeal for food and warm clothing.
entries.exampleZh: 该慈善机构发起紧急呼吁，募集食物和保暖衣物。

entries.example: Her sudden appearance at the party surprised everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 她突然出现在聚会上，让屋里的每个人都感到惊讶。

entries.example: The government tried to appease the protesters with vague promises.
entries.exampleZh: 政府试图用含糊的承诺安抚抗议者。

entries.example: Please append your signature to the bottom of the contract.
entries.exampleZh: 请在合同底部附上你的签名。

entries.meaning: 食欲,欲望；胃口，食欲；欲望
entries.example: Walking in the cold air gave me a huge appetite for dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 在冷空气中散步让我晚饭时胃口大开。

entries.example: The whole audience stood up to applaud the young pianist.
entries.exampleZh: 全场观众站起来为这位年轻钢琴家鼓掌。

entries.example: She sliced an apple and shared it with her little brother.
entries.exampleZh: 她切了一个苹果，和弟弟一起分着吃。

entries.example: This small appliance makes it easy to prepare fresh soup.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小电器让做新鲜汤变得很容易。

entries.example: Researchers questioned the applicability of these findings to rural schools.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员质疑这些发现对乡村学校的适用性。

entries.meaning: 合适的, 适用的,；可应用的，可实施的；适当的，合适的
entries.example: These rules are not applicable to students studying part-time.
entries.exampleZh: 这些规定不适用于非全日制学习的学生。

entries.example: Every applicant must submit two letters of recommendation by Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 每位申请者必须在周五前提交两封推荐信。

entries.meaning: 请求,申请,应用；请求，申请；应用，运用；敷用
entries.example: Her application for a research grant was approved last month.
entries.exampleZh: 她的研究经费申请上个月获得了批准。

entries.meaning: 申请,应用；申请，请求；适用；应用，运用；涂，敷，施
entries.example: You should apply for the scholarship before the deadline.
entries.exampleZh: 你应该在截止日期前申请这项奖学金。

entries.example: The board will appoint a new director at next week's meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 董事会将在下周的会议上任命一位新董事。

entries.meaning: 约会, 指定；约会，约定；任命，委派；职位
entries.example: I have a dentist appointment tomorrow morning at nine.
entries.exampleZh: 我明天上午九点有牙医预约。

entries.example: The committee will apportion the funds among the three villages.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会将把这笔资金分配给三个村庄。

entries.example: Fair apportionment of seats remains a sensitive issue in parliament.
entries.exampleZh: 席位的公平分配在议会中仍是一个敏感问题。

entries.example: The manager gave a fair appraisal of the team's performance last quarter.
entries.exampleZh: 经理对团队上个季度的表现给出了公正的评估。

entries.example: Experts will appraise the painting before the auction begins tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 专家们将在明天拍卖开始前对这幅画进行估价。

entries.example: There was an appreciable rise in sales after the new campaign launched.
entries.exampleZh: 新活动推出后，销售额出现了可观的增长。

entries.example: The room became appreciably quieter once the children went to bed.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们上床睡觉后，房间明显安静了许多。

entries.meaning: 赏识, 感激；赏识；鉴赏，欣赏；感激
entries.example: I really appreciate your help with the report last week.
entries.exampleZh: 我非常感激你上周帮我处理那份报告。

entries.meaning: 感谢, 感激；欣赏；理解，体谅；感激；鉴定，评价
entries.example: She showed her appreciation by sending flowers to the whole staff.
entries.exampleZh: 她给全体员工送花以表达感谢。

entries.example: Police managed to apprehend the suspect near the train station.
entries.exampleZh: 警方在火车站附近成功逮捕了嫌疑人。

entries.example: The young apprentice learned to repair watches from a master.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻的学徒跟着一位师傅学习修理手表。

entries.meaning: 学徒的身份；学徒的年限
entries.example: He completed a four-year apprenticeship before opening his own workshop.
entries.exampleZh: 他完成四年学徒期后才开了自己的作坊。

entries.example: Please apprise the manager of any changes to the schedule.
entries.exampleZh: 请把日程的任何变动告知经理。

entries.meaning: 靠近,接近；途径,方法；接近；
entries.example: Her calm approach to the crisis impressed everyone at the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 她应对危机的冷静方式让会上所有人都印象深刻。

entries.example: It is not appropriate to wear shorts during a formal interview.
entries.exampleZh: 正式面试时穿短裤是不合适的。

entries.example: The children were dressed appropriately for the cold mountain weather.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们的穿着很适合寒冷的山区天气。

entries.example: The board gave final approval to the building plan on Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 董事会上周五最终批准了该建筑方案。

entries.meaning: 赞成, 批准；批准；赞成
entries.example: The committee will approve the budget only after a careful review.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会只有在仔细审查后才会批准预算。

entries.meaning: 近似的,大约的；近似,接近；大约的，近似的；接近，近似
entries.example: Please tell me the approximate cost of a return ticket.
entries.exampleZh: 请告诉我一张往返票的大致费用。

entries.example: The figures he gave were only a rough approximation of the truth.
entries.exampleZh: 他给出的数字只是对事实的粗略估计。

entries.example: The annual conference will take place in April next year.
entries.exampleZh: 年度会议将于明年四月举行。

entries.meaning: 适合，恰当；天资，才能，资质
entries.example: She showed a natural aptitude for languages at a very young age.
entries.exampleZh: 她很小就显示出语言方面的天赋。

entries.example: The village is aptly named, since a river runs through it.
entries.exampleZh: 这个村庄的名字很贴切，因为有一条河从中穿过。

entries.example: The aquarium near the harbor displays colorful fish from warm seas.
entries.exampleZh: 港口附近的水族馆展示着来自温暖海域的色彩斑斓的鱼。

entries.meaning: 水的,水生的；水生动物；水生的；水上的
entries.example: Many aquatic plants thrive in the shallow water of this lake.
entries.exampleZh: 许多水生植物在这片湖泊的浅水中茁壮生长。

entries.example: The ancient aqueduct carried fresh water to the city for centuries.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古老的渡槽曾为数百年间的城市输送淡水。

entries.meaning: 含水土层,蓄水层；含水土层
entries.example: Farmers depend on the underground aquifer during long periods without rain.
entries.exampleZh: 在长期无雨的日子里，农民依赖地下蓄水层。

entries.example: An Arab trader sold silk and spices in the busy market.
entries.exampleZh: 一位阿拉伯商人在热闹的市场上出售丝绸和香料。

entries.meaning: 阿拉伯人 a阿拉伯(人)的
entries.example: An Arabian guided us through the narrow streets of the old town.
entries.exampleZh: 一位阿拉伯人带我们穿过老城狭窄的街道。

entries.meaning: 可耕作的，适于耕作的；可耕地
entries.example: The valley contains rich arable land suitable for growing wheat.
entries.exampleZh: 这座山谷拥有适合种植小麦的肥沃耕地。

entries.example: Scientists found tiny aragonite crystals inside the ancient shell.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家在古老贝壳内发现了微小的霰石晶体。

entries.meaning: 任意的, 武断的；任意的；专制的，专断的
entries.example: The manager made an arbitrary decision without consulting the team.
entries.exampleZh: 经理没有咨询团队就做出了武断的决定。

entries.example: Several arboreal mammals spend most of their lives in tall trees.
entries.exampleZh: 几种树栖哺乳动物一生大部分时间都在高大的树木上度过。

entries.example: The rainbow formed a perfect arc above the quiet valley.
entries.exampleZh: 彩虹在宁静的山谷上方形成了一道完美的弧。

entries.example: We walked through a covered arcade lined with small shops.
entries.exampleZh: 我们穿过一条两旁有小商店的有顶拱廊。

entries.example: The stone arch frames the entrance to the old courtyard.
entries.exampleZh: 石拱门框住了旧庭院的入口。

entries.example: Researchers observed a single archaeocyte beneath the microscope's powerful lens.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员在显微镜的强大镜头下观察到一个原始生殖细胞。

entries.example: The archaeological team uncovered pottery fragments near the riverbank last summer.
entries.exampleZh: 去年夏天，考古团队在河岸附近发现了陶器碎片。

entries.example: A famous archaeologist explained how ancient tools were made and used.
entries.exampleZh: 一位著名考古学家解释了古代工具的制作和使用方法。

entries.example: She studied archaeology at university and later joined a field project.
entries.exampleZh: 她在大学学习考古学，后来加入了一个实地项目。

entries.example: The fossil of an archaeopteryx shows feathers and sharp teeth.
entries.exampleZh: 始祖鸟的化石显示出羽毛和锋利的牙齿。

entries.example: The contract uses archaic language that few modern readers understand.
entries.exampleZh: 这份合同使用了现代读者很少能理解的古旧语言。

entries.example: The country consists of a vast archipelago spread across the ocean.
entries.exampleZh: 这个国家由散布在海洋上的庞大群岛组成。

entries.meaning: 建筑师；建筑师；设计师，缔造者
entries.example: The architect designed a library that blends glass with traditional stone.
entries.exampleZh: 这位建筑师设计了一座将玻璃与传统石材融合的图书馆。

entries.example: She studied architecture in Rome before returning to her hometown.
entries.exampleZh: 她在罗马学习建筑学，之后回到了家乡。

entries.example: The museum keeps every letter in a digital archive.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆把每一封信都保存在一个数字档案库里。

entries.example: Few plants survive the arctic winter on that remote island.
entries.exampleZh: 那座偏远岛屿上几乎没有植物能熬过北极的冬天。

entries.example: She is an ardent supporter of local environmental campaigns.
entries.exampleZh: 她是本地环保运动的热情支持者。

entries.meaning: 费力的, 辛勤的；费力的，艰巨的
entries.example: Rebuilding the bridge proved an arduous task for the small team.
entries.exampleZh: 对这支小团队来说，重建这座桥是一项艰巨的任务。

entries.example: The concert filled the arena with thousands of excited fans.
entries.exampleZh: 演唱会吸引了数千名兴奋的粉丝，坐满了竞技场。

entries.example: Laboratory lamps often contain argon to protect the filament.
entries.exampleZh: 实验室的灯常充入氩气以保护灯丝。

entries.meaning: 说服,争论,辩论；争论，辩论；主张，论证；说服，劝说
entries.example: They argue about money almost every time they eat out.
entries.exampleZh: 他们几乎每次外出吃饭都会为钱争吵。

entries.example: Their argument lasted an hour but ended without any clear winner.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的争论持续了一个小时，却没有分出明确的胜负。

entries.example: The soprano closed the evening with a moving aria.
entries.exampleZh: 女高音以一首动人的咏叹调结束了当晚的演出。

entries.meaning: 干旱的,贫瘠的；干旱的；贫瘠的；无趣的
entries.example: Crops struggle to grow in this arid stretch of land.
entries.exampleZh: 在这片干旱的土地上，庄稼很难生长。

entries.example: The aridity of the desert surprised even experienced travelers.
entries.exampleZh: 沙漠的干旱程度连经验丰富的旅行者也感到惊讶。

entries.example: Problems often arise when nobody checks the final report.
entries.exampleZh: 如果没有人核对最终报告，问题常常会出现。

entries.example: The old aristocracy lost much of its influence after the revolution.
entries.exampleZh: 革命之后，旧贵族失去了大部分影响力。

entries.example: A young aristocrat funded the restoration of the ruined chapel.
entries.exampleZh: 一位年轻的贵族出资修复了那座破败的小教堂。

entries.meaning: 贵族政治的,贵族的；贵族的，有贵族气派的
entries.example: He spoke with an aristocratic accent that impressed the whole room.
entries.exampleZh: 他说话带着贵族口音，让满屋子的人都印象深刻。

entries.example: Simple arithmetic helps shoppers compare prices before buying anything.
entries.exampleZh: 简单的算术能帮助顾客在买东西前比较价格。

entries.example: She broke her arm while skiing down the steep slope.
entries.exampleZh: 她从陡坡滑雪下来时摔断了手臂。

entries.example: The knight wore heavy armor that slowed every single step.
entries.exampleZh: 那位骑士穿着沉重的盔甲，每走一步都很缓慢。

entries.example: The old armory now stores historical weapons for the local museum.
entries.exampleZh: 这座旧军械库现在为当地博物馆存放历史武器。

entries.example: The army built a temporary bridge across the flooded river.
entries.exampleZh: 军队在洪水泛滥的河上架起了一座临时桥。

entries.example: The aroma of fresh bread filled the entire kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。

entries.example: This aromatic tea comes from the mountains of southern China.
entries.exampleZh: 这种芬芳的茶来自中国南方的山区。

entries.example: The sudden arousal of public anger surprised many officials.
entries.exampleZh: 公众愤怒的突然激起让许多官员感到意外。

entries.meaning: 唤醒,鼓励；睡醒；唤醒，唤起；激起，引起
entries.example: The strange noise outside began to arouse suspicion among the guards.
entries.exampleZh: 外面奇怪的声响开始引起守卫们的怀疑。

entries.meaning: 安排,排列；布置；安排，筹备
entries.example: Please arrange the chairs in a circle before the guests come.
entries.exampleZh: 请在客人到来前把椅子摆成一圈。

entries.meaning: 展示,排列；一系列；阵列；布置，排列；部署
entries.example: The gallery displayed an impressive array of modern paintings.
entries.exampleZh: 画廊展出了一系列令人印象深刻的现代绘画。

entries.meaning: 逮捕, 拘留；逮捕，拘留；停止，阻止；吸引
entries.example: The police made an arrest after reviewing the security footage.
entries.exampleZh: 警方在查看安保录像后实施了一次逮捕。

entries.example: Her arrival at the party surprised everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 她到达聚会时让房间里的每个人都感到惊讶。

entries.example: We expect the train to arrive shortly after noon.
entries.exampleZh: 我们预计火车将在中午过后不久到达。

entries.example: His arrogant remarks offended almost everyone at the dinner table.
entries.exampleZh: 他傲慢的言辞冒犯了餐桌上几乎所有人。

entries.example: The arrow struck the target just above the red circle.
entries.exampleZh: 箭射中了红色圆圈正上方的目标。

entries.example: The country expanded its arsenal despite strong international criticism.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管国际社会强烈批评，该国仍扩大了其军械库。

entries.exampleZh: 检测显示村中水井里的砷含量达到危险水平。

entries.exampleZh: 这个农场在旱季依靠一口自流井。

entries.example: My grandmother's arthritis makes gardening difficult in cold weather.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖母的关节炎使她在寒冷天气里做园艺很困难。

entries.example: A crab is a common arthropod found along rocky coasts.
entries.exampleZh: 螃蟹是常见于岩石海岸的节肢动物。

entries.example: She published an article about climate change in a local magazine.
entries.exampleZh: 她在当地一本杂志上发表了一篇关于气候变化的文章。

entries.meaning: 有关节的, 发音清晰的 v用关节连接, 接合；善于表达的；发音清晰的，口齿清楚的；明确表达，清楚说明；清晰地吐，清晰地发；用关节连接

entries.exampleZh: 优秀的老师用简单的语言清晰表达复杂的观点。

entries.meaning: 人造物品；人工制品，手工艺品
entries.example: The museum displayed a rare artifact from the ancient tomb.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了一件来自古墓的稀有手工艺品。

entries.example: She saw through the artifice behind his charming smile.
entries.exampleZh: 她看穿了他迷人微笑背后的诡计。

entries.meaning: 人造的,虚伪的；人工的，人造的，假的；矫揉造作的，假装
entries.example: The flowers looked real, but they were artificial.
entries.exampleZh: 这些花看起来像真的，但它们是人工的。

entries.example: The lake was artificially heated to attract tourists in winter.
entries.exampleZh: 这个湖被人工加热，以在冬季吸引游客。

entries.example: A local artisan crafted this wooden chair by hand.
entries.exampleZh: 一位当地工匠手工制作了这把木椅。

entries.example: The young artiste performed a stunning dance on stage.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻艺人上台表演了一段令人惊艳的舞蹈。

entries.meaning: 艺术的；艺术的；富有艺术性的，精美的；有艺术天赋的
entries.example: Her artistic talent impressed everyone at the exhibition.
entries.exampleZh: 她的艺术天赋让展览上的每个人都印象深刻。

entries.example: The room was artistically arranged with fresh flowers and old paintings.
entries.exampleZh: 这个房间用鲜花和旧画布置得富有艺术感。

entries.example: Her artistry with colors turned the plain wall into a masterpiece.
entries.exampleZh: 她在色彩上的艺术才华把那面普通的墙变成了杰作。

entries.example: The gallery bought a modern artwork by a famous sculptor.
entries.exampleZh: 画廊买下了一位著名雕塑家的一件现代艺术品。

entries.meaning: 攀登, 上升；上升，升高；攀登
entries.example: The climbers began to ascend the icy slope at dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 登山者在黎明时分开始攀登结冰的斜坡。

entries.example: The steep ascent to the temple left us breathless.
entries.exampleZh: 通往寺庙的陡峭上坡让我们气喘吁吁。

entries.example: We need to ascertain the cause of the sudden failure.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要查明这次突然故障的原因。

entries.meaning: 归因于, 归咎于；把…归于；归咎于
