entries.exampleZh: 科学家将突然变暖归因于人类活动。

entries.example: A thin layer of ash covered the burnt forest floor.
entries.exampleZh: 一层薄薄的灰覆盖了烧焦的森林地面。

entries.example: He tossed the empty bottle into the rusty ashcan.
entries.exampleZh: 他把空瓶子扔进了生锈的垃圾桶。

entries.example: The sailors rowed ashore after the long storm.
entries.exampleZh: 水手们在漫长的风暴后划船上岸。

entries.example: She traveled across Asia during her summer break.
entries.exampleZh: 她暑假期间游历了亚洲。

entries.example: My Asian colleagues shared delicious dishes at the office party.
entries.exampleZh: 我的亚洲同事在办公室聚会上分享了美味菜肴。

entries.example: She stepped aside to let the elderly man pass.
entries.exampleZh: 她走到一旁，让那位老人过去。

entries.example: I will ask the manager about the new schedule this afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 今天下午我会向经理询问新的日程安排。

entries.example: The child was fast asleep before the storm reached our town.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨到达我们镇之前，那个孩子已经睡熟了。

entries.meaning: 方面,外观；方面；朝向，方向；外表，外观
entries.example: The most difficult aspect of this job is managing tight deadlines.
entries.exampleZh: 这份工作最困难的方面是应付紧迫的截止期限。

entries.example: Workers poured fresh asphalt along the narrow road before noon.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们在中午之前沿着狭窄的道路铺上了新沥青。

entries.example: Her greatest aspiration is to become a doctor in her home village.
entries.exampleZh: 她最大的愿望是在家乡当一名医生。

entries.meaning: 热望, 立志；有志于；热望，向往
entries.example: Many young artists aspire to exhibit their work in major galleries.
entries.exampleZh: 许多年轻艺术家渴望在大型画廊展出自己的作品。

entries.example: Critics assail the new policy for ignoring vulnerable communities.
entries.exampleZh: 批评者抨击这项新政策忽视了弱势群体。

entries.example: The rebels planned to assassinate the visiting minister during the parade.
entries.exampleZh: 叛乱者计划在游行期间暗杀来访的部长。

entries.example: The soldiers launched a sudden assault on the enemy camp at dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们在黎明时对敌营发动了突然袭击。

entries.example: A curious assemblage of old coins lay inside the wooden box.
entries.exampleZh: 木箱里放着一堆奇怪的旧硬币。

entries.meaning: 集合,聚集,装配；集合；装配
entries.example: The crew will assemble the stage before the concert begins tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 工作人员将在今晚音乐会开始前搭建舞台。

entries.meaning: 集会，集合;组装；集会；集会者；装配，安装；立法机构，议会
entries.example: The school assembly will begin promptly at eight in the main hall.
entries.exampleZh: 学校集会将于八点整在大礼堂准时开始。

entries.example: The committee gave its assent to the revised budget proposal.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会同意了修订后的预算提案。

entries.meaning: 断言, 声称；断言，声称
entries.example: She will assert her right to speak during the final debate.
entries.exampleZh: 她将在最后一场辩论中主张自己的发言权。

entries.example: Teachers assess students through written exams and practical projects each term.
entries.exampleZh: 教师每学期通过笔试和实践项目来评估学生。

entries.example: The final assessment will cover all the topics discussed this semester.
entries.exampleZh: 最终评估将涵盖本学期讨论过的所有主题。

entries.meaning: 资产；资产，财产；有价值的人；长处，优点
entries.example: Her fluent French is a valuable asset in this international company.
entries.exampleZh: 她流利的法语是这家国际公司的一项宝贵资产。

entries.meaning: 分配,指派；指派；指定；分配；布置
entries.example: The coach will assign each player a specific position before practice.
entries.exampleZh: 教练会在训练前给每名球员分配具体位置。

entries.meaning: 透彻理解，吸收，消化；同化
entries.example: Students must assimilate new concepts quickly during the intensive language course.
entries.exampleZh: 学生必须在密集语言课程中迅速吸收新概念。

entries.example: Cultural assimilation often takes several generations within a new society.
entries.exampleZh: 文化同化在一个新社会中往往需要几代人时间。

entries.example: Volunteers will assist the elderly residents with their weekly shopping trips.
entries.exampleZh: 志愿者们将协助老年居民完成每周的购物。

entries.meaning: 协助, 援助, 补助,；帮助，援助
entries.example: She offered practical assistance to the new staff during their training.
entries.exampleZh: 在新员工培训期间，她向他们提供了切实的帮助。

entries.meaning: 助手, 助教；辅助的，助理的；副的；助手，助教
entries.example: The research assistant organized the data before the professor's lecture.
entries.exampleZh: 研究助理在教授讲课前整理了数据。

entries.meaning: 联合,结交；伙伴；副的；结交；关联；副的；合伙的
entries.example: Most people associate that melody with their childhood summer holidays.
entries.exampleZh: 大多数人把那段旋律与童年的暑假联系在一起。

entries.example: The local housing association provides advice to tenants free of charge.
entries.exampleZh: 当地的住房协会免费向租户提供咨询。

entries.example: The study explores associative memory in children aged five to seven.
entries.exampleZh: 这项研究探讨五至七岁儿童的联想记忆。

entries.example: They assort the donated books by genre before shelving them.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在上架前把捐赠的书籍按体裁分类。

entries.meaning: 分类,混合物；分类；各种各样
entries.example: The bakery sells a wide assortment of fresh bread every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 这家面包店每天早上出售各式各样的新鲜面包。

entries.example: We should not assume that everyone agrees with the new policy.
entries.exampleZh: 我们不应假定每个人都同意这项新政策。

entries.example: His argument rests on the assumption that prices will stay stable.
entries.exampleZh: 他的论点建立在价格将保持稳定这一假设之上。

entries.meaning: 使确信, 确保；确保；使确信
entries.example: I can assure you that the repairs will be finished today.
entries.exampleZh: 我可以向你保证，维修工作今天就会完成。

entries.example: A large asteroid passed close to the earth last Tuesday night.
entries.exampleZh: 上周二夜里，一颗巨大的小行星近距离掠过地球。

entries.example: Scientists study the asthenosphere to understand how tectonic plates move.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家研究岩流圈以了解构造板块如何移动。

entries.example: Her asthma gets worse whenever the pollen season begins in spring.
entries.exampleZh: 每当春天花粉季开始，她的哮喘就会加重。

entries.example: The results of the experiment will astonish even experienced researchers.
entries.exampleZh: 实验结果甚至会让经验丰富的研究人员感到惊讶。

entries.meaning: 使惊骇, 使大吃一惊
entries.example: The sheer size of the cathedral will astound every first-time visitor.
entries.exampleZh: 大教堂的庞大规模会让每一位初次来访者震惊。

entries.example: She reads her astrological chart before making any important decision.
entries.exampleZh: 她做任何重要决定前都会看自己的占星图。

entries.example: The astronaut described weightlessness as both thrilling and slightly sickening.
entries.exampleZh: 这位宇航员把失重描述为既刺激又有点令人难受。

entries.example: An amateur astronomer discovered a faint comet from his garden last night.
entries.exampleZh: 一位业余天文学家昨晚在他的花园里发现了一颗暗淡的彗星。

entries.meaning: 天文学的, 巨大的；天文学的；极大的，庞大的
entries.example: The cost of restoring the old theatre proved astronomical for the town.
entries.exampleZh: 修复这座老剧院的花费对小镇来说大得惊人。

entries.example: She studied astronomy at a famous university before becoming a science journalist.
entries.exampleZh: 她在一所名牌大学学习天文学，之后成为了一名科学记者。

entries.meaning: 机敏的, 狡猾的；机敏的，精明的
entries.example: Her astute observations during the meeting impressed even the most senior managers.
entries.exampleZh: 她在会上机敏的观察连最资深的管理者都印象深刻。

entries.meaning: 不对称的,不均匀的；不均匀的，不对称的
entries.example: The old building has an asymmetrical facade that visitors often photograph.
entries.exampleZh: 这座老建筑有一面不对称的外墙，游客常常拍照。

entries.example: As a convinced atheist, he avoids religious ceremonies whenever possible.
entries.exampleZh: 作为一个坚定的无神论者，他尽可能避开宗教仪式。

entries.example: This museum displays pottery made by an athenian craftsman long ago.
entries.exampleZh: 这座博物馆展出着很久以前一位雅典工匠制作的陶器。

entries.example: Our flight to athens was delayed by several hours.
entries.exampleZh: 我们飞往雅典的航班延误了几个小时。

entries.example: The young athlete trained for hours before every important race.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻运动员在每场重要比赛前都训练好几个小时。

entries.example: They crossed the atlantic by boat in just under three weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 他们乘船横渡大西洋，用了不到三个星期。

entries.example: He opened the atlas to find the small island we wanted.
entries.exampleZh: 他翻开地图集，寻找我们想找的那座小岛。

entries.meaning: 大气,空气,气氛；大气，大气层；空气；气氛，氛围
entries.example: The relaxed atmosphere in the cafe helped us forget our troubles.
entries.exampleZh: 咖啡馆里轻松的氛围帮我们忘记了烦恼。

entries.example: Scientists measured atmospheric pressure throughout the entire flight.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家们在整段飞行过程中测量了大气压。

entries.example: Every atom in your body was formed inside a distant star.
entries.exampleZh: 你身体里的每一个原子都形成于一颗遥远的恒星内部。

entries.meaning: 原子的,原子能的；原子的；原子能的
entries.example: The treaty limited the number of atomic tests in the region.
entries.exampleZh: 该条约限制了该地区的原子试验数量。

entries.example: The atomization of the liquid into fine droplets speeds up drying.
entries.exampleZh: 液体雾化成细小液滴可以加快干燥速度。

entries.example: Muscle atrophy is a serious risk for patients confined to bed.
entries.exampleZh: 肌肉萎缩对卧床患者来说是一个严重风险。

entries.meaning: 缚上, 配属,隶属于；连接；依附于；系，贴，连接；使依恋，使喜爱；认为有
entries.example: Please attach your receipt to the form before mailing it.
entries.exampleZh: 寄出之前请把收据附在表格上。

entries.example: He opened the attachment and found a detailed budget report.
entries.exampleZh: 他打开附件，发现是一份详细的预算报告。

entries.example: The sudden attack on the village surprised the local guards.
entries.exampleZh: 对村庄的突然袭击让当地守卫措手不及。

entries.example: The attacker fled before the police could reach the scene.
entries.exampleZh: 袭击者在警察赶到现场之前就逃走了。

entries.meaning: 达到, 获得；达到；获得
entries.example: She worked hard to attain the goals she had set herself.
entries.exampleZh: 她努力工作以实现自己设定的目标。

entries.example: Her rapid attainment of fluency surprised everyone in the language department.
entries.exampleZh: 她迅速达到流利程度让语言系所有人都感到惊讶。

entries.meaning: 尝试,企图,努力；尝试；努力
entries.example: His first attempt at the recipe failed because he forgot the salt.
entries.exampleZh: 他第一次尝试这个食谱失败了，因为他忘了放盐。

entries.meaning: 出席, 参加,照料；出席，参加；照料，看管；专心，注意；陪同
entries.example: Please attend the meeting on Friday and bring your written report.
entries.exampleZh: 请参加周五的会议，并带上你的书面报告。

entries.example: Regular attendance at lectures is required for all first-year students.
entries.exampleZh: 所有一年级学生都必须定期出席讲座。

entries.example: The flight attendant kindly helped the elderly passenger find his seat.
entries.exampleZh: 那位空乘人员热心地帮助老年乘客找到了座位。

entries.meaning: 注意,关心；注意，留心；立正
entries.example: The teacher asked for silence and gave her full attention to the class.
entries.exampleZh: 老师要求大家安静，并把全部注意力放在班上。

entries.meaning: 注意的, 留意的；注意的，专心的；关心的
entries.example: The attentive nurse noticed the patient's slight change in breathing immediately.
entries.exampleZh: 细心的护士立刻注意到病人呼吸的细微变化。

entries.example: Several witnesses can attest that the driver stopped before the crossing.
entries.exampleZh: 几名目击者可以证明司机在十字路口前停了车。

entries.example: We stored the old furniture in the dusty attic above the garage.
entries.exampleZh: 我们把旧家具存放在车库上方布满灰尘的阁楼里。

entries.meaning: 服装；打扮；穿着，服饰；给…穿衣，打扮
entries.example: Her formal attire suited the elegant reception held at the embassy.
entries.exampleZh: 她的正式着装很适合在大使馆举行的优雅招待会。

entries.example: His positive attitude helped the team recover after the early setback.
entries.exampleZh: 他积极的态度帮助球队在早期挫折后恢复过来。

entries.example: The defense attorney questioned the witness about the missing documents.
entries.exampleZh: 辩护律师就缺失的文件询问了证人。

entries.example: Bright flowers attract many insects to the garden each spring.
entries.exampleZh: 每年春天，鲜艳的花朵吸引许多昆虫来到花园。

entries.meaning: 吸引(力)；具有吸引力的事物(或人)
entries.example: The ancient temple remains the main attraction for visitors in this region.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古庙仍是该地区游客的主要景点。

entries.meaning: 吸引人的，有魅力的；引起注意的
entries.example: They made the small shop attractive with warm lights and fresh flowers.
entries.exampleZh: 他们用暖灯和鲜花把小店布置得很吸引人。

entries.example: She arranged the fruit attractively on a large silver plate.
entries.exampleZh: 她把水果摆在一个大银盘上，摆得十分诱人。

entries.example: The attractiveness of the old town draws photographers from across the country.
entries.exampleZh: 这座老城的魅力吸引着全国各地的摄影师。

entries.example: The sudden drop in sales is attributable to weaker consumer demand.
entries.exampleZh: 销售额突然下降可归因于消费者需求减弱。

entries.meaning: 属性,品质,特征；属性，特征；把…归于
entries.example: Patience is an attribute that every good teacher should possess.
entries.exampleZh: 耐心是每位优秀教师都应具备的一种品质。

entries.example: They will auction the rare painting at the city gallery next month.
entries.exampleZh: 他们下个月将在市立画廊拍卖这幅稀有画作。

entries.example: Her whisper was barely audible above the noise of the crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 她的低语在人群的嘈杂声中几乎听不见。

entries.meaning: 听众,观众；听众；观众；读者
entries.example: The speaker paused to let the audience absorb the final point.
entries.exampleZh: 演讲者停顿了一下，让听众消化最后一点内容。

entries.meaning: 音频的,声音的；音频的；声音的
entries.example: The audio quality on that old recording is surprisingly clear.
entries.exampleZh: 那段旧录音的音质出奇地清晰。

entries.example: Students may audit the lecture series without taking the final exam.
entries.exampleZh: 学生可以旁听这一系列讲座，无需参加期末考试。

entries.example: His audition for the leading role impressed everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 他为争取主角的试演让房间里所有人都印象深刻。

entries.meaning: 听众席,观众席,；礼堂；观众席
entries.example: The auditorium filled quickly once the doors were finally opened.
entries.exampleZh: 门终于打开后，礼堂很快就坐满了人。

entries.meaning: 耳的, 听觉的；耳的；听觉的
entries.example: Loud music can damage delicate auditory nerves over many years.
entries.exampleZh: 大声的音乐长年累月会损伤脆弱的听觉神经。

entries.example: The carpenter reached for an auger to bore the hole.
entries.exampleZh: 木匠伸手去拿螺丝钻来钻那个孔。

entries.example: They hired two consultants to augment the small research team.
entries.exampleZh: 他们雇了两名顾问来扩充这个小研究团队。

entries.example: They plan to travel through Italy in August before the crowds arrive.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划在八月游历意大利，赶在人潮到来之前。

entries.example: The exam tests both written and aural comprehension of the language.
entries.exampleZh: 这项考试既考查书面理解，也考查对该语言的听觉理解。

entries.example: Photographers waited all night to capture the aurora above the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 摄影师们整夜守候，想拍下湖面上方的极光。

entries.example: Choosing the first day of spring seemed an auspicious start.
entries.exampleZh: 选在春天的第一天开始，似乎是个吉利的开端。

entries.example: The monastery offered austere rooms and simple meals to visitors.
entries.exampleZh: 这座修道院为访客提供简朴的房间和简单的饭菜。

entries.example: She spent two years studying marine biology across Australia.
entries.exampleZh: 她在澳大利亚各地花了两年时间研究海洋生物学。

entries.example: An Australian friend taught me how to surf last summer.
entries.exampleZh: 一位澳大利亚朋友去年夏天教我冲浪。

entries.meaning: 奥地利人；奥地利的, 奥地利人的
entries.example: The Austrian pianist received a standing ovation after the concert.
entries.exampleZh: 那位奥地利钢琴家在音乐会后赢得了全场起立鼓掌。

entries.meaning: 可信的,真正的；真正的，真实的；逼真的；可靠的
entries.example: The restaurant serves authentic dishes from the owner's native region.
entries.exampleZh: 这家餐厅供应来自老板故乡地区的正宗菜肴。

entries.example: Experts questioned the authenticity of the painting's signature.
entries.exampleZh: 专家们对这幅画签名的真实性提出了质疑。

entries.meaning: 官方的；权威性的，可信的；专断的，命令式的
entries.example: Her book remains the most authoritative guide to local birds.
entries.exampleZh: 她的书至今仍是关于本地鸟类最具权威性的指南。

entries.example: The local authority has approved plans for a new public library.
entries.exampleZh: 当地政府已经批准了建造一座新公共图书馆的计划。

entries.example: You cannot enter the lab without written authorization from the manager.
entries.exampleZh: 没有经理的书面授权，你不能进入实验室。

entries.example: The board will authorize the purchase of new equipment next week.
entries.exampleZh: 董事会将于下周批准购买新设备。

entries.example: She bought a small auto for driving around the narrow city streets.
entries.exampleZh: 她买了一辆小型汽车，用来在狭窄的城市街道上行驶。

entries.example: Her latest novel is largely autobiographical and draws on her childhood.
entries.exampleZh: 她的最新小说在很大程度上是自传性的，取材于她的童年经历。

entries.example: The retired pilot published an autobiography about his years in the air.
entries.exampleZh: 这位退休飞行员出版了一部讲述他飞行岁月的自传。

entries.meaning: 使自动化, 自动操作
entries.example: The factory plans to automate most of its packing lines next year.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂计划明年将其大部分包装线自动化。

entries.meaning: 自动机械 a自动的,机械的；自动的；无意识的；必然的，自然的；自动手枪；自动换挡汽车
entries.example: This washing machine has an automatic setting for delicate fabrics.
entries.exampleZh: 这台洗衣机有适用于精致织物的自动模式。

entries.example: The lights switch on automatically when the sensor detects movement.
entries.exampleZh: 当传感器检测到有人移动时，灯会自动亮起。

entries.example: The museum displays an early automobile built by a local engineer.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了一辆由当地工程师制造的早期汽车。

entries.example: Yoga can help regulate the autonomic functions of the nervous system.
entries.exampleZh: 瑜伽有助于调节神经系统的自主功能。

entries.meaning: 自治的；自治的；独立自主的
entries.example: The region became autonomous after a long and difficult negotiation.
entries.exampleZh: 经过漫长而艰难的谈判，该地区实现了自治。

entries.meaning: 自治；自治，自治权；自主，自主权
entries.example: Teenagers need a certain degree of autonomy to make their own choices.
entries.exampleZh: 青少年需要一定程度的自主权来做出自己的选择。

entries.example: Every autumn the park attracts visitors who come to see the golden leaves.
entries.exampleZh: 每年秋天，这座公园都会吸引前来观赏金色落叶的游客。

entries.meaning: 辅助的, 补助的；辅助的，补助的，补充的；备用的，后备的
entries.example: The hospital relies on auxiliary staff to handle paperwork and cleaning.
entries.exampleZh: 医院依靠辅助人员来处理文书和清洁工作。

entries.meaning: 有益于,有帮助；效用, 利益
entries.example: We tried to avail ourselves of the free training but it was full.
entries.exampleZh: 我们本想利用这次免费培训，但名额已满。

entries.example: Please check the availability of rooms before booking the conference.
entries.exampleZh: 预订会议之前请先查询客房的可用情况。

entries.meaning: 可利用的,可得到的,有空的；可得到的，可找到的；有空的
entries.example: A few good seats are still available for tonight's jazz concert.
entries.exampleZh: 今晚的爵士音乐会还有几个好座位。

entries.example: A sudden avalanche buried the mountain road and blocked all traffic.
entries.exampleZh: 一场突如其来的雪崩掩埋了山路，导致所有交通中断。

entries.example: The young designer is famous for her avant style and bold colors.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻设计师以她的先锋风格和大胆配色而闻名。

entries.example: The old soldier swore to avenge his brother's death before the year ended.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老兵发誓要在年底前为兄弟的死报仇。

entries.meaning: 林荫道,方法；途径，手段；大街
entries.example: Exploring every possible avenue, the team finally found a solution to the crisis.
entries.exampleZh: 探索了每一个可能的途径之后，团队终于找到了解决危机的办法。

entries.meaning: 平均(的)；平均；平均的；一般的；平庸的；平均为；平均水平；平均数
entries.example: The average temperature in this region drops sharply during the winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 这个地区的平均气温在冬季急剧下降。

entries.example: Quick thinking by the pilot helped avert a serious accident on the runway.
entries.exampleZh: 飞行员的敏捷反应帮助避免了一场跑道上的严重事故。

entries.meaning: 航空,飞机制造业；航空，航空学；飞行
entries.example: Modern aviation depends heavily on precise weather forecasts and reliable communication systems.
entries.exampleZh: 现代航空严重依赖精确的天气预报和可靠的通信系统。

entries.example: The young aviator completed her first solo flight across the desert.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻的飞行员完成了她第一次横穿沙漠的单人飞行。

entries.example: An avid reader, she finishes at least two novels every week.
entries.exampleZh: 她是个热切的读者，每周至少读完两部小说。

entries.example: His avocational interest in photography gradually turned into a small business.
entries.exampleZh: 他在摄影方面的业余爱好逐渐变成了一门小生意。

entries.example: Drivers should avoid the city centre during the morning rush hour.
entries.exampleZh: 司机在早高峰时段应避开市中心。

entries.example: Most of these accidents were entirely avoidable with a little extra care.
entries.exampleZh: 这些事故大多数只要多一点小心是完全可以避免的。

entries.example: His constant avoidance of difficult questions annoyed the entire interview panel.
entries.exampleZh: 他一再回避难题，让整个面试小组都很恼火。

entries.example: Thousands of fans await the singer's arrival outside the hotel entrance.
entries.exampleZh: 成千上万的粉丝在酒店入口外等候这位歌手的到来。

entries.meaning: 醒,唤醒 a警觉的, 醒的；唤醒；醒；觉醒，醒悟；醒着的；警觉的
entries.example: The noise from the street kept me awake until almost dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 街上的噪音让我几乎到天亮都醒着。

entries.example: A gentle knock on the door will awaken the sleeping children.
entries.exampleZh: 轻轻的敲门声会吵醒睡着的孩子们。

entries.example: She received a prestigious award for her research on renewable energy.
entries.exampleZh: 她因在可再生能源方面的研究而获得了一项颇具声望的奖项。

entries.meaning: 意识到,知道的；知道的；意识到的
entries.example: Few passengers were aware of the danger until the captain made an announcement.
entries.exampleZh: 在机长发布通知之前，很少有乘客意识到危险。

entries.meaning: 知道, 晓得；知道，意识，察觉
entries.example: The campaign aims to raise public awareness of mental health issues.
entries.exampleZh: 这项运动旨在提高公众对心理健康问题的意识。

entries.example: She walked away without saying a word, leaving everyone at the table stunned.
entries.exampleZh: 她一言不发地走开了，让桌旁所有人都愣住了。

entries.meaning: 可怕的, 表示敬畏的；使人敬畏的；使人恐惧的
entries.example: The view from the mountain top was truly awesome in the morning light.

entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔一直单身，直到他在国外遇到一位善良的老师。

entries.exampleZh: 群山为婚礼照片构成了引人注目的背景。

entries.exampleZh: 他煎了些咸肉和鸡蛋，做了一顿丰盛的周日早餐。

entries.exampleZh: 医生为她喉咙的细菌感染开了抗生素。

entries.example: A single bacterium can multiply into millions within a few hours.
entries.exampleZh: 一个细菌在几小时内就能繁殖成数百万个。

entries.example: Smoking has a bad effect on your lungs and heart.
entries.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的肺和心脏有不良影响。

entries.meaning: 旅行指南, 入门手册

entries.example: My grandmother likes to bake bread every Saturday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我奶奶喜欢每周六早上烤面包。

entries.meaning: 平衡；使平衡；使平衡，使均衡；天平，秤；平衡；差额；余款

entries.exampleZh: 那个秃头男人戴了顶帽子来保护他敏感的头皮。

entries.exampleZh: 她把整个青春都献给了在巴黎学习古典芭蕾。

entries.example: The children let a red balloon float up into the summer sky.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们让一只红气球飘向夏日的天空。

entries.example: The hotel's grand ballroom can hold three hundred guests.
entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店的豪华舞厅可容纳三百位宾客。

entries.example: He peeled a ripe banana and shared half with his sister.
entries.exampleZh: 他剥了一根熟香蕉，把一半分给了妹妹。

entries.exampleZh: 她在大学期间学习了班图语族的语言。

entries.exampleZh: 长途徒步后，她享受了一个加薰衣草油的温水浴。

entries.exampleZh: 士兵们准备在冰封的北方平原上进行一场激烈的战斗。

entries.exampleZh: 去年春天她把卧室刷成了淡蓝色。

entries.example: A single bee buzzed around the flowers on the balcony.
entries.exampleZh: 一只蜜蜂在阳台的花丛中嗡嗡飞舞。

entries.example: The stew contained chunks of beef, carrots and fresh herbs.
entries.exampleZh: 这锅炖菜里有大块牛肉、胡萝卜和新鲜香草。

entries.example: He ordered a cold beer and sat near the window.
entries.exampleZh: 他点了一杯冰啤酒，坐在窗边。

entries.example: A shiny black beetle crawled across the wooden floor.
entries.exampleZh: 一只闪亮的黑甲虫爬过木地板。

entries.example: Such luxurious decorations hardly befit a modest village wedding.
entries.exampleZh: 这样奢华的装饰与一场简朴的乡村婚礼很不相称。

entries.example: She decided to befriend the new student and show him around.
entries.exampleZh: 她决定和新来的同学交朋友，并带他四处看看。

entries.example: The stray dog would beg for food outside the bakery every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 那只流浪狗每天早上都会在面包店外讨食。

entries.example: An old beggar sat on the steps, holding out a wooden bowl.
entries.exampleZh: 一个老乞丐坐在台阶上，伸出一只木碗。

entries.example: She spoke on behalf of the entire team at the ceremony.
entries.exampleZh: 她代表整个团队在仪式上发言。

entries.meaning: 表现,行为, 举止；行为，表现；表现得体，有礼貌；作出反应
entries.example: The children behave remarkably well whenever their grandmother visits.
entries.exampleZh: 每次祖母来访时，孩子们都表现得非常好。

entries.example: Researchers studied the behavioral patterns of monkeys in the wild.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员研究了野生猴子的行为模式。

entries.example: Behaviorism dominated psychology throughout the early twentieth century.
entries.exampleZh: 行为主义在二十世纪初主导了心理学。

entries.meaning: 行为主义者, 行为科学家
entries.example: A strict behaviorist ignores inner feelings and focuses on visible actions.
entries.exampleZh: 严格的行为主义者忽略内心感受，只关注可见的行为。

entries.example: The old bicycle was hidden behind the garden shed.
entries.exampleZh: 那辆旧自行车藏在花园棚子后面。

entries.example: Every living being depends on clean water and fresh air.
entries.exampleZh: 每一个生命都依赖干净的水和新鲜的空气。

entries.meaning: 掩饰；给人以错觉；掩饰；证明…不正确
entries.example: Her calm smile seemed to belie the nervousness she felt inside.
entries.exampleZh: 她平静的微笑似乎掩饰了内心的紧张。

entries.example: His firm belief in justice guided every decision he made.
entries.exampleZh: 他对正义的坚定信念指引着他做出的每一个决定。

entries.example: The witness gave a believable account of that stormy night.
entries.exampleZh: 那位证人对那个暴风雨之夜的描述令人信服。

entries.example: The church bell rang loudly across the quiet village square.
entries.exampleZh: 教堂的钟声在安静的村庄广场上响亮地回荡。

entries.example: She was the belle of the ball in her silver gown.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿着银色长裙，是舞会上最美的姑娘。

entries.example: The angry coach began to bellow instructions across the field.
entries.exampleZh: 愤怒的教练开始隔着球场大声吼叫指令。

entries.example: The blacksmith pumped the bellows until the coals glowed red.
entries.exampleZh: 铁匠鼓动风箱，直到煤炭烧得通红。

entries.example: These old photographs belong to my grandmother's family album.
entries.exampleZh: 这些老照片属于我祖母的家庭相册。

entries.example: Her beloved garden was full of roses and tall sunflowers.
entries.exampleZh: 她心爱的花园里开满了玫瑰和高高的向日葵。

entries.meaning: 带子, 地带；地带，地区；腰带，皮带；带状物
entries.example: He tightened his leather belt before stepping onto the crowded stage.
entries.exampleZh: 他走上拥挤的舞台前系紧了皮带。

entries.meaning: 非常好, 出色的例子
entries.example: Her final performance was a belter that impressed every judge in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 她最后的那场表演非常精彩，令在场的每位评委都印象深刻。

entries.example: A curious beluga swam close to our small boat in the Arctic.
entries.exampleZh: 一头好奇的白鲸在北极靠近了我们的小船。

entries.example: Many residents bemoan the lack of affordable housing in this growing city.
entries.exampleZh: 许多居民哀叹这座不断发展的城市缺乏经济适用房。

entries.meaning: 长椅子,替补队员 vt给…以席位
entries.example: An elderly couple rested on a wooden bench beside the quiet lake.
entries.exampleZh: 一对老年夫妇在宁静的湖边一条木长椅上休息。

entries.example: Please bend your knees slightly while lifting that heavy box.
entries.exampleZh: 搬那个重箱子时请稍微弯曲膝盖。

entries.meaning: 在…下,(地位等)低于；在下方
entries.example: The lost keys lay beneath a pile of old newspapers.
entries.exampleZh: 丢失的钥匙躺在一堆旧报纸下面。

entries.example: The beneficent donor quietly funded a new library for the village.
entries.exampleZh: 这位行善的捐赠者悄悄为村庄资助了一座新图书馆。

entries.meaning: 有利的, 有益的；有益的，有利的
entries.example: Regular exercise is beneficial for both physical health and mental well-being.
entries.exampleZh: 定期锻炼对身体健康和心理健康都有益。

entries.example: The main beneficiary of the new policy is the rural population.
entries.exampleZh: 这项新政策的主要受益者是农村人口。

entries.meaning: 利益；有益于,得益；受益；得益于；益处，好处；恩惠；津贴
entries.example: Small businesses will benefit from the reduced taxes announced yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 小企业将从昨天宣布的减税中受益。

entries.example: The benevolent teacher often paid for her students' meals without seeking praise.
entries.exampleZh: 这位仁慈的老师经常为学生付饭钱，却不求赞扬。

entries.example: Police discovered a hidden field of beng behind the abandoned warehouse.
entries.exampleZh: 警方在废弃仓库后面发现了一块隐藏的大麻田。

entries.meaning: 仁慈的, 温和的, 良性的；良性的；有利的；善良的，和蔼的
entries.example: The doctor assured us that the tumor was benign and required no treatment.
entries.exampleZh: 医生向我们保证肿瘤是良性的，不需要治疗。

entries.example: The old carpenter has a natural bent for repairing delicate wooden chairs.
entries.exampleZh: 这位老木匠天生擅长修理精致的木椅。

entries.example: She chose to bequeath her rare book collection to the university.
entries.exampleZh: 她选择把珍贵的藏书遗赠给这所大学。

entries.example: The unexpected bequest allowed the museum to open a new gallery.
entries.exampleZh: 这笔意外的遗赠使博物馆得以开设一个新展厅。

entries.example: The research vessel carefully navigated around a massive floating berg.
entries.exampleZh: 这艘考察船小心翼翼地绕过一座巨大的浮冰。

entries.example: She placed a silk cushion on the antique bergere near the window.
entries.exampleZh: 她在窗边那把古董围手椅上放了一个丝绸靠垫。

entries.meaning: 白令海和楚可奇海海域
entries.example: Many ancient mammals crossed Beringia when sea levels were much lower.
entries.exampleZh: 许多古代哺乳动物在海平面低得多的时候穿越了白令陆桥。

entries.example: My cousin moved to Berlin last spring to study modern European history.
entries.exampleZh: 我的表亲去年春天搬到了柏林学习现代欧洲历史。

entries.example: The old wooden bench stood beside the river, waiting for tired walkers.
entries.exampleZh: 那张旧木长椅立在河边，等待着疲惫的散步者。

entries.meaning: 除之外；此外, 也；而且，还有；除…之外
entries.example: The weather, besides being cold, made our mountain hike rather unpleasant.
entries.exampleZh: 除了寒冷之外，天气还让我们的登山之行相当不愉快。

entries.meaning: 围困,围攻；包围；使应接不暇
entries.example: Angry fans besiege the stadium gates whenever the team loses.
entries.exampleZh: 每当球队输球，愤怒的球迷就会围攻体育场大门。

entries.meaning: 给予,利用；赠与，授予，献给
entries.example: The university will bestow an honorary degree on the retiring professor.
entries.exampleZh: 大学将授予这位即将退休的教授荣誉学位。

entries.meaning: 赌, 打赌 v赌, 赌钱；打赌；敢说，确信；打赌；赌注
entries.example: I bet the train will arrive before noon despite the snow.
entries.exampleZh: 我敢打赌，尽管下雪，火车也会在中午前到达。

entries.meaning: 出卖, 背叛；出卖，泄露；辜负，对…不忠；流露情感
entries.example: Do not betray your friend's trust by sharing that private story.
entries.exampleZh: 不要通过传播那个私人故事来辜负朋友的信任。

entries.example: The waiter brought a cold beverage and a small plate of snacks.
entries.exampleZh: 服务员端来一杯冷饮和一小盘点心。

entries.meaning: 使迷惑，使难住；使迷惑，使不知所措
entries.example: The complicated instructions might bewilder even experienced users at first.
entries.exampleZh: 这些复杂的说明起初甚至可能让有经验的用户感到困惑。

entries.example: The quiet village lies beyond those hills, far from any noisy road.
entries.exampleZh: 那个安静的村庄位于那些山丘之外，远离任何喧嚣的道路。

entries.example: Our company holds a biannual meeting to review its financial goals.
entries.exampleZh: 我们公司每半年举行一次会议，审查其财务目标。

entries.meaning: 偏见vt使存偏见；偏见，偏心；使有偏见，使偏心
entries.example: The judge promised that personal opinions would not bias her final decision.
entries.exampleZh: 法官承诺个人意见不会使她的最终裁决产生偏见。

entries.meaning: 两院制的，有两个议院的
entries.example: The country adopted a bicameral parliament after the constitutional reform.
entries.exampleZh: 该国在宪法改革后采用了两院制议会。

entries.example: She rode her bicycle along the quiet path beside the river.
entries.exampleZh: 她沿着河边安静的小路骑自行车。

entries.meaning: 出价, 投标；投标,企图
entries.example: Several companies plan to bid for the construction contract next month.
entries.exampleZh: 几家公司计划下个月投标这个建筑合同。

entries.example: My grandfather wears bifocal glasses when he reads the morning newspaper.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖父读晨报时戴着双焦点眼镜。

entries.example: A big brown dog waited patiently outside the bakery every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 一只棕色的大狗每天早上耐心地等在面包店外。

entries.example: He fixed his old bike and rode it to the market.
entries.exampleZh: 他修好了旧自行车，骑着它去了市场。

entries.example: The two nations signed a bilateral agreement to protect shared rivers.
entries.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项保护共享河流的双边协议。

entries.example: Children raised in bilingual homes often switch languages without much effort.
entries.exampleZh: 在双语家庭中长大的孩子常常不费力地切换语言。

entries.example: Researchers in Canada often study bilingualism among children from immigrant families.
entries.exampleZh: 加拿大的研究人员经常研究移民家庭儿童的双语现象。

entries.meaning: 帐单；开帐单；账单；纸币，钞票；议案，法案；节目单；招贴，海报；用招贴宣布；给…开账单
entries.example: The waiter brought the bill before we had finished our dessert.
entries.exampleZh: 服务员在我们还没吃完甜点时就把账单拿来了。

entries.example: A billfish can swim extremely fast through the open ocean.
entries.exampleZh: 长嘴鱼能以极快的速度在开阔的海洋中游动。

entries.example: Scientists estimate that the universe contains more than a billion galaxies.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家估计宇宙中包含超过十亿个星系。

entries.meaning: 二进制的；二元的；由两部分组成的
entries.example: Computers store all data as binary numbers made of zeros and ones.
entries.exampleZh: 计算机将所有数据存储为由零和一组成的二进制数字。

entries.example: Please bind these papers together before you put them in the folder.
entries.exampleZh: 请把这些文件捆在一起，然后再放进文件夹里。

entries.example: After exams, they went on a shopping binge downtown.
entries.exampleZh: 考试结束后，他们去市中心大肆购物了一番。

entries.example: The lab studies biochemical reactions that occur inside living cells.
entries.exampleZh: 该实验室研究活细胞内发生的生化反应。

entries.example: Tropical rainforests support remarkable biodiversity despite facing severe threats.
entries.exampleZh: 热带雨林尽管面临严重威胁，仍维持着惊人的生物多样性。

entries.example: Researchers measured biogeochemical cycles in the lake throughout the year.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员全年测量了该湖的生物地球化学循环。

entries.example: The biographer spent ten years researching her subject's early life.
entries.exampleZh: 这位传记作者花了十年时间研究她传主的早年生活。

entries.example: The novel includes many biographical details about the author's childhood.
entries.exampleZh: 这部小说包含许多关于作者童年的传记性细节。

entries.example: She published a detailed biography of a famous nineteenth-century scientist.
entries.exampleZh: 她出版了一部关于一位著名十九世纪科学家的详细传记。

entries.example: The documentary explores the biological differences between these two species.
entries.exampleZh: 这部纪录片探讨了这两个物种之间的生物学差异。

entries.example: These two groups are biologically distinct but culturally connected.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个群体在生物学上截然不同，但在文化上相互联系。

entries.example: A marine biologist discovered a new species near the coral reef.
entries.exampleZh: 一位海洋生物学家在珊瑚礁附近发现了一个新物种。

entries.example: Students must pass biology before they can apply for medical school.
entries.exampleZh: 学生必须先通过生物学考试才能申请医学院。

entries.example: The desert biome receives very little rainfall throughout the year.
entries.exampleZh: 沙漠生物群系全年降雨量极少。

entries.example: Every ecosystem depends on biotic factors like plants and animals.
entries.exampleZh: 每个生态系统都依赖植物和动物等生物因素。

entries.example: Some dinosaurs were bipedal, while others walked on four legs.
entries.exampleZh: 有些恐龙是两足行走的，而另一些则用四条腿行走。

entries.example: Tall birch trees line the quiet path behind our summer house.
entries.exampleZh: 高高的白桦树排列在我们夏日小屋后面那条安静的小路两旁。

entries.example: Her birdlike movements made the dance look effortless and light.
entries.exampleZh: 她那轻快如鸟的动作让这支舞看起来毫不费力、轻盈飘逸。

entries.example: The birth of her first child changed everything for the young couple.
entries.exampleZh: 第一个孩子的出生改变了这对年轻夫妇的一切。

entries.example: We are planning a surprise birthday party for my grandmother next Saturday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们正计划下周六为我祖母举办一个惊喜生日聚会。

entries.meaning: 生来就有的权利, 长子继承权
entries.example: She felt that a good education was her birthright, not a privilege.
entries.exampleZh: 她觉得良好的教育是她与生俱来的权利，而非一种特权。

entries.example: After the final chord, the crowd shouted bis until the pianist returned.
entries.exampleZh: 最后一个和弦结束后，人群高喊再来一次，直到钢琴家重返舞台。

entries.example: A straight line can bisect the square into two equal halves.
entries.exampleZh: 一条直线可以把正方形平分成两个相等的部分。

entries.example: Huge herds of bison once roamed across the plains of North America.
entries.exampleZh: 成群的美洲野牛曾漫游在北美洲的大平原上。

entries.example: Could you give me a bit of advice about this problem?
entries.exampleZh: 关于这个问题，你能给我一点建议吗？

entries.example: The dog's bite left a small mark on his arm.
entries.exampleZh: 狗咬的那一口在他手臂上留下了一个小印子。

entries.example: That puppy is a playful biter, so watch your fingers.
entries.exampleZh: 那只小狗爱咬着玩，所以小心你的手指。

entries.example: The medicine left a bitter taste in my mouth for hours.
entries.exampleZh: 那药在我嘴里留下了好几个小时的苦味。

entries.example: He spoke about the divorce with obvious bitterness and regret.
entries.exampleZh: 他谈起那场离婚时，明显带着苦涩与悔恨。

entries.example: Workers spread bituminous material across the road before the winter.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们在冬季到来前把沥青材料铺在路面上。

entries.meaning: 奇异的(指态度,容貌,款式等)；奇形怪状的，古怪可笑的，怪诞的
entries.example: Her bizarre outfit attracted curious glances from everyone at the party.
entries.exampleZh: 她那古怪的装扮引来聚会上每个人好奇的目光。

entries.example: A black cat crossed the street and disappeared into the fog.
entries.exampleZh: 一只黑猫穿过街道，消失在雾中。

entries.example: A blackbird sang from the top of the old oak tree.
entries.exampleZh: 一只乌鸫在古老橡树的顶端歌唱。

entries.example: Smoke from the fire began to blacken the kitchen ceiling.
entries.exampleZh: 火产生的烟开始把厨房的天花板熏黑。

entries.example: The storm caused a blackout that lasted almost three hours.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨造成了一次持续近三个小时的停电。

entries.example: The village blacksmith shaped the hot iron with steady hands.
entries.exampleZh: 村里的铁匠用稳健的双手把那块炽热的铁打造成形。

entries.example: The doctor explained that an infection in the bladder often causes mild discomfort.
entries.exampleZh: 医生解释说，膀胱感染常常会引起轻微的不适。

entries.meaning: 刀刃, 刀片；刀刃，刀片；叶片；草叶；桨叶
entries.example: He carefully wiped the blade of the knife before putting it away.
entries.exampleZh: 他把刀刃仔细擦干净后才收起来。

entries.meaning: 责备；谴责，责备；过失，责备；责任
entries.example: The blame for the delay lay entirely with the careless supplier.
entries.exampleZh: 延误的责任完全在于那个粗心的供应商。

entries.meaning: 温和的,乏味的；变得乏味；平淡的，乏味的；清淡的；沉稳的
entries.example: The soup tasted rather bland, so she added a pinch of salt.
entries.exampleZh: 汤的味道相当寡淡，于是她加了一小撮盐。

entries.example: She wrapped the sleeping child in a warm blanket and turned off the light.
entries.exampleZh: 她把熟睡的孩子裹在一条暖和的毯子里，然后关了灯。

entries.meaning: 爆炸；一阵(疾风等) vt炸，炸掉；爆炸；发出尖响；猛烈抨击；一阵；爆炸；冲击波；响声
entries.example: The blast shattered windows across the street and startled everyone nearby.
entries.exampleZh: 爆炸震碎了街对面的窗户，把附近的每个人都吓了一跳。

entries.meaning: 火焰；照耀,激发；燃烧，着火；发光，放光彩；怒视；火焰；光辉，强烈的光；迸发
entries.example: Firefighters worked through the night to control the blaze in the warehouse.
entries.exampleZh: 消防员通宵工作，以控制仓库的大火。

entries.example: She used bleach to remove the stains from the white cotton shirt.
entries.exampleZh: 她用漂白剂去掉了白色棉衬衫上的污渍。

entries.meaning: 寒冷的,荒凉的, 黯淡的；阴冷的；无望的，令人沮丧的；乏味的；荒凉的
entries.example: The future of the small factory looked bleak after the orders were cancelled.
entries.exampleZh: 订单被取消后，这家小工厂的前景显得黯淡无光。

entries.meaning: (使)混和n混合物；混合，混杂；混合；混合物
entries.example: This tea is a blend of black leaves and dried orange peel.
entries.exampleZh: 这种茶是黑茶叶与干橙皮的混合物。

entries.example: May the gods bless this house and all who live within it.
entries.exampleZh: 愿众神保佑这座房子以及住在其中的所有人。

entries.meaning: 眨眼, 闪烁；眨眼睛；闪亮，闪烁；眨眼睛
entries.example: He did not blink once during the entire tense conversation.
entries.exampleZh: 在整场紧张的谈话中，他一次也没有眨眼。

entries.meaning: （在雷达屏幕显示出的）物体光点, 尖音信号
entries.example: A single blip appeared on the radar screen and then vanished.
entries.exampleZh: 雷达屏幕上出现了一个光点，随后就消失了。

entries.meaning: 福佑, 天赐的福；狂喜
entries.example: For her, a quiet morning with a book is pure bliss.
entries.exampleZh: 对她来说，捧一本书度过安静的早晨就是纯粹的幸福。

entries.example: A painful blister formed on his heel after the long hike.

entries.exampleZh: 那只小鸡跟着妈妈穿过农家院子。

entries.example: We roasted a whole chicken with garlic and fresh herbs.
entries.exampleZh: 我们用大蒜和新鲜香草烤了一整只鸡。

entries.meaning: 奇科皮（美国马萨诸塞州西南部城市）
entries.example: Chicopee is a city in southwestern Massachusetts known for scenic river views.
entries.exampleZh: 奇科皮是马萨诸塞州西南部一座以河景闻名的城市。

entries.meaning: 首领；主要的, 首要的；主要的；总的；首席的；首领；酋长，族长
entries.example: The chief explained the new safety rules to every worker.
entries.exampleZh: 主管向每位工人解释了新的安全规则。

entries.example: The region is chiefly known for its tea and beautiful hills.
entries.exampleZh: 该地区主要以其茶叶和美丽的山丘闻名。

entries.meaning: 吉娃娃(一种产于墨西哥的狗)
entries.example: Her tiny Chihuahua slept quietly inside a woven basket.
entries.exampleZh: 她的吉娃娃安静地睡在一个编织篮子里。

entries.example: He spent his childhood in a small village near the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 他在海边的一个小村庄度过了童年。

entries.example: The childless couple adopted two dogs from a local shelter.
entries.exampleZh: 这对无子女的夫妇从当地收容所领养了两只狗。

entries.example: Chile produces some of the world's finest wines and fruits.
entries.exampleZh: 智利出产一些世界上最好的葡萄酒和水果。

entries.meaning: 使变冷(冷冻) n寒冷；寒冷的；变冷，冷却；寒冷，寒意
entries.example: There was a noticeable chill in the air this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上空气中有明显的寒意。

entries.meaning: 寒冷的；寒冷的；冷淡的，不友好的
entries.example: The evening felt chilly, so we lit a warm fire.
entries.exampleZh: 傍晚感觉有点冷，所以我们生了一堆暖和的火。

entries.example: Thick smoke rose from the factory chimney into the grey sky.
entries.exampleZh: 浓烟从工厂烟囱升入灰色的天空。

entries.example: The young chimp played with a stick near its mother.
entries.exampleZh: 那只年幼的黑猩猩在妈妈身边玩一根树枝。

entries.example: A chimpanzee watched us carefully from behind the thick glass.
entries.exampleZh: 一只黑猩猩隔着厚玻璃仔细地看着我们。

entries.example: She keeps her fine china in a locked wooden cabinet.
entries.exampleZh: 她把精美瓷器存放在一个上锁的木柜里。

entries.example: Many Chinese families gather for a special meal during the Spring Festival.
entries.exampleZh: 许多中国家庭在春节期间团聚，吃一顿特别的饭。

entries.meaning: 碎片；削成碎片；削下；碎片；芯片
entries.example: A single chip fell from the old wooden table onto the floor.
entries.exampleZh: 一小块碎片从旧木桌上掉到了地板上。

entries.example: A small chipmunk darted across the forest path and vanished.
entries.exampleZh: 一只小花栗鼠飞快地穿过森林小径，随后消失了。

entries.example: The sculptor used a sharp chisel to shape the marble block.
entries.exampleZh: 雕塑家用一把锋利的凿子塑造那块大理石。

entries.example: The tough shell of the beetle contains chitin and several other materials.
entries.exampleZh: 甲虫坚硬的外壳含有壳质以及几种其他物质。

entries.meaning: 有骑士精神的；彬彬有礼的，殷勤的
entries.example: His chivalrous gesture impressed everyone at the formal dinner party.
entries.exampleZh: 他在正式晚宴上的殷勤举动给每个人都留下了深刻印象。

entries.meaning: 骑士精神, 骑士制度
entries.example: The old stories celebrate chivalry and honor among noble knights.
entries.exampleZh: 古老的故事赞颂高贵骑士之间的骑士精神和荣誉。

entries.example: The laboratory stored the chlorate sample in a tightly sealed container.
entries.exampleZh: 实验室把氯酸盐样本存放在一个密封严实的容器里。

entries.example: Please handle the chloride solution with care during the experiment.
entries.exampleZh: 实验期间请小心处理这种氯化物溶液。

entries.example: The pool smelled strongly of chlorine after the morning cleaning.
entries.exampleZh: 早晨清洁之后，泳池里有一股浓烈的氯味。

entries.example: Leaves use chlorophyll to capture sunlight during the process of photosynthesis.
entries.exampleZh: 叶子在光合作用过程中利用叶绿素捕捉阳光。

entries.example: The farmer noticed chlorosis spreading across the young orange trees.
entries.exampleZh: 农民注意到萎黄病正在幼小的橘子树上蔓延。

entries.example: She melted dark chocolate and poured it over fresh strawberries.
entries.exampleZh: 她融化了黑巧克力，并把它浇在新鲜草莓上。

entries.example: The church choir practiced a new song before Sunday service.
entries.exampleZh: 教堂合唱团在周日礼拜前练习了一首新歌。

entries.example: Regular exercise can help lower cholesterol and improve heart health.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼有助于降低胆固醇并改善心脏健康。

entries.meaning: 大声地咀嚼, 反复咀嚼
entries.example: The hungry horse began to chomp loudly on dry hay.
entries.exampleZh: 那匹饥饿的马开始大声咀嚼干草。

entries.example: The museum displayed a rare chondrite found in the desert.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了一块在沙漠中发现的稀有球粒状陨石。

entries.example: Scientists studied the chondritic meteorite under a powerful microscope.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家在一台高倍显微镜下研究了那块球粒状陨石。

entries.example: Each chondrule in the meteorite formed from molten droplets long ago.
entries.exampleZh: 陨石中的每一颗陨石球粒都是很久以前由熔融液滴形成的。

entries.example: You may choose any seat near the window if you prefer.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你愿意，可以随便选一个靠窗的座位。

entries.example: She is remarkably choosy about the restaurants she recommends to her friends.
entries.exampleZh: 她对推荐给朋友的餐厅格外挑剔。

entries.example: Please chop the onions finely before adding them to the hot pan.
entries.exampleZh: 请把洋葱切碎，然后再放进热锅里。

entries.meaning: （海等）波浪起伏的, (指风)不断改变方向的；波浪起伏的，不平静的；不连贯的，支离破碎的
entries.example: The choppy sea made several passengers on the small ferry feel ill.
entries.exampleZh: 波涛起伏的海面让渡轮上的几位乘客感到不适。

entries.example: That opening chord of the song always gives me a pleasant shiver.
entries.exampleZh: 那首歌开头的和弦总是让我愉悦地一颤。

entries.example: She was asked to choreograph the final scene of the musical.
entries.exampleZh: 有人请她为这部音乐剧的最后一场设计舞蹈动作。

entries.example: The choreographer spent weeks teaching the dancers the new routine.
entries.exampleZh: 这位编舞花了数周时间教舞者这套新动作。

entries.example: Her choreography for the opening ceremony impressed critics around the world.
entries.exampleZh: 她为开幕式设计的舞蹈编排令世界各地的评论家印象深刻。

entries.meaning: 合唱(队)；合唱曲；合唱队；副歌，叠句；齐声，
entries.example: The whole audience joined the chorus for the final verse of the anthem.
entries.exampleZh: 全场观众在圣歌最后一段一起唱起了副歌。

entries.example: My neighbour is a devout Christian who attends church every Sunday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我的邻居是一位虔诚的基督徒，每周日早上都去教堂。

entries.example: A tiny error on one chromosome can cause a serious genetic disorder.
entries.exampleZh: 一条染色体上的微小错误就可能引发严重的遗传疾病。

entries.example: During a total eclipse, the chromosphere appears as a thin red ring.
entries.exampleZh: 在日全食期间，色球层呈现为一圈细细的红色光环。

entries.meaning: 慢性的, 延续很长的
entries.example: Years of heavy lifting left him with chronic pain in his lower back.
entries.exampleZh: 多年的重体力劳动使他的下背部留下了慢性疼痛。

entries.example: Her chronical cough worried the doctors during the long winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 她经久不愈的咳嗽在漫长的冬季里让医生们担忧。

entries.meaning: 编年史；编入编年史；把…载入编年史；编年史，年代记
entries.example: The monks chronicle the events of each year in careful detail.
entries.exampleZh: 修士们把每年发生的大事详细地记载下来。

entries.meaning: [生]时间生物学, 生物钟学
entries.example: Researchers in chronobiology study how our bodies keep track of time.
entries.exampleZh: 时间生物学的研究者研究人体如何记录时间。

entries.meaning: 按年代顺序排列的；按年代顺序排列的，年代学的
entries.example: The report presents the events in strict chronological order without any gaps.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告严格按照时间顺序叙述事件，没有任何遗漏。

entries.example: Please arrange these photographs chronologically so the story becomes easy to follow.
entries.exampleZh: 请按时间顺序整理这些照片，这样故事就更容易理解。

entries.example: The book begins with a brief chronology of the artist's early life.
entries.exampleZh: 这本书开头简述了这位艺术家早年的生平年表。

entries.example: The baby had chubby cheeks and a wide, delighted smile.
entries.exampleZh: 那婴儿有胖嘟嘟的脸颊和灿烂开心的笑容。

entries.example: We watched the little boat chug slowly across the calm harbour.
entries.exampleZh: 我们看着那条小船在平静的港湾上突突地缓缓驶过。

entries.meaning: 大块,相当大的部分（数量）；厚片，大块；相当大的部分；矮胖的人
entries.example: He cut the cheese into a large chunk and shared it.
entries.exampleZh: 他把奶酪切成一大块，然后分给了大家。

entries.example: The old church stands beside the river and attracts many visitors.
entries.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂矗立在河边，吸引了许多游客。

entries.example: Farmers churn fresh milk into butter using a simple wooden tool.
entries.exampleZh: 农民用简单的木制工具把新鲜牛奶搅成黄油。

entries.example: We drank cold cider beside the fireplace while the storm raged outside.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨在外面肆虐时，我们坐在壁炉旁喝冷苹果酒。

entries.example: The elderly man lit a cigar and watched the ships leave the harbor.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老人点燃了一支雪茄，看着船只离开港口。

entries.meaning: 辛辛那提（美国俄亥俄州西南部城市）
entries.example: She accepted a job in Cincinnati and moved there with her family.
entries.exampleZh: 她接受了辛辛那提的一份工作，并和家人搬到了那里。

entries.example: We decided to meet at the cinema before the evening show started.
entries.exampleZh: 我们决定在晚场电影开始前在电影院见面。

entries.example: The agent used an old cipher to hide the message from enemies.
entries.exampleZh: 特工用一种旧密码把信息隐藏起来，不让敌人发现。

entries.meaning: 昼夜节律的,生理节奏的
entries.example: Regular morning light helps reset your circadian rhythm after a long flight.
entries.exampleZh: 规律的晨光有助于你在长途飞行后重置昼夜节律。

entries.example: The children sat in a circle on the floor.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐在地板上，形成一个圆圈。

entries.meaning: 电路,巡回；电路；线路；巡回；环行；环行路线
entries.example: A loose wire interrupted the circuit and caused the lights to fail.
entries.exampleZh: 一根松动的电线中断了电路，导致灯熄灭。

entries.meaning: 圆形的, 循环的；圆形的，环形的；循环的；绕行的
entries.example: The kitchen features a circular table that seats six people comfortably.
entries.exampleZh: 厨房里有一张圆桌，可以舒适地坐六个人。

entries.meaning: (使)循环,传播；循环；流通；传播，流传
entries.example: Rumors began to circulate through the office before the official announcement.
entries.exampleZh: 官方宣布之前，谣言开始在办公室里流传。

entries.example: Poor blood circulation can make your hands and feet feel cold.
entries.exampleZh: 血液循环不良会使你的手脚感到冰冷。

entries.meaning: 循环的, 循环系统的
entries.example: The doctor explained how smoking damages the circulatory system over time.
entries.exampleZh: 医生解释了吸烟如何长期损害循环系统。

entries.meaning: 圆周, 周围；周围，周边；圆周；周长
entries.example: We measured the circumference of the tree trunk with a long rope.
entries.exampleZh: 我们用一根长绳测量了树干的周长。

entries.example: Strict rules circumscribe what employees may post on social media.
entries.exampleZh: 严格的规定限制了员工可以在社交媒体上发布的内容。

entries.meaning: 环境,详情,境况；环境，条件；境况，经济状况
entries.example: Under no circumstance should you leave the laboratory unlocked overnight.
entries.exampleZh: 在任何情况下，你都不应该让实验室整夜不锁。

entries.example: The evidence only circumstantially links the suspect to the crime scene.
entries.exampleZh: 证据只是间接地把嫌疑人与犯罪现场联系起来。

entries.example: Some companies try to circumvent the tax law through complex accounting tricks.
entries.exampleZh: 一些公司试图通过复杂的会计手段规避税法。

entries.meaning: 根据地, 大本营；堡垒，要塞
entries.example: The ancient citadel on the hill still guards the harbor below.
entries.exampleZh: 山上的古老堡垒至今仍守护着下方的港口。

entries.example: The professor added a citation for every source used in the paper.
entries.exampleZh: 教授为论文中使用的每一处资料来源都添加了引用。

entries.meaning: 引用, 引证；引用，引证；传唤，传讯；表彰，嘉奖
entries.example: Please cite the original author when you quote from that study.
entries.exampleZh: 引用那项研究时，请注明原作者。

entries.meaning: 齐特拉琴(古希腊一种类似竖琴的古乐器)
entries.example: A musician in the ancient Greek chorus played the cither softly.
entries.exampleZh: 古希腊合唱队中的一位乐手轻轻弹奏着齐特拉琴。

entries.example: Every citizen has the right to vote in local elections.
entries.exampleZh: 每位公民都有权在地方选举中投票。

entries.example: The whole citizenry gathered to celebrate the town's founding day.
entries.exampleZh: 全体市民聚集起来庆祝小镇的建镇纪念日。

entries.example: She applied for citizenship after living there for five years.
entries.exampleZh: 在那里居住五年后，她申请了公民身份。

entries.example: The civet is a nocturnal mammal known for its unusual diet.
entries.exampleZh: 麝猫是一种夜行性哺乳动物，以其独特的饮食而闻名。

entries.example: The mayor praised the civic pride shown during the cleanup campaign.
entries.exampleZh: 市长赞扬了清理活动中展现出的市民自豪感。

entries.meaning: 公民的,文明的；市民的，公民的，平民的；民事的；国家的，政府的；文明的，有教养的
entries.example: The new law protects civil rights for all residents of the region.
entries.exampleZh: 新法律保障该地区所有居民的公民权利。

entries.example: The soldier helped a wounded civilian reach the nearest medical station.
entries.exampleZh: 那名士兵帮助一位受伤的平民抵达最近的医疗站。

entries.example: He treated his opponents with remarkable civility throughout the heated debate.
entries.exampleZh: 在激烈的辩论中，他对对手始终表现得极为有礼。

entries.example: Ancient Egyptian civilization developed along the fertile banks of the Nile.
entries.exampleZh: 古埃及文明沿着尼罗河肥沃的河岸发展起来。

entries.meaning: 声称,要求；声称，断言；要求；索赔
entries.example: The company denied the claim that its product caused any harm.
entries.exampleZh: 公司否认了其产品造成任何伤害的说法。

entries.meaning: 要求者,申请者, 原告
entries.example: The claimant submitted documents proving his right to the property.
entries.exampleZh: 原告提交了证明其对该房产享有权利的文件。

entries.meaning: 蛤；蛤，蛤肉；〈口〉守口如瓶的人，寡言的人
entries.example: She found a single clam buried in the wet sand.
entries.exampleZh: 她在湿沙里发现了一只蛤。

entries.example: The clamor from the crowd made it hard to hear the speaker.
entries.exampleZh: 人群的喧闹声让人很难听清演讲者的话。

entries.meaning: 氏族,部落；家族，宗族，氏族；帮派
entries.example: The whole clan gathered at the old house every winter.
entries.exampleZh: 整个家族每年冬天都会聚在那栋老房子里。

entries.example: The manager offered a brief clarification of the new company policy.
entries.exampleZh: 经理对新公司政策作了简短澄清。

entries.meaning: 澄清, 阐明；澄清，阐明
entries.example: Could you clarify what you meant by that last remark?
entries.exampleZh: 你能澄清一下你最后那句话的意思吗？

entries.example: The clarity of her explanation helped the confused audience understand the complex issue.
entries.exampleZh: 她解释得清晰明了，帮助困惑的听众理解了这一复杂问题。

entries.meaning: 搭扣，扣环；紧抱；紧握；握紧；抱紧；扣住，扣牢
entries.example: The clasp on her necklace broke, so she held the chain carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 她项链上的搭扣坏了，于是她小心地握住链子。

entries.example: The whole class stayed silent when the teacher asked a difficult question.
entries.exampleZh: 当老师提出一个难题时，全班都保持沉默。

entries.meaning: 最优秀的,标准的 n杰作；经典的；典型的；经典作品；
entries.example: This novel is a classic example of nineteenth-century storytelling at its best.
entries.exampleZh: 这部小说是十九世纪叙事艺术的最佳典范。

entries.meaning: 古典的,正统派的；经典的，古典的
entries.example: She studied classical music for years before joining the orchestra.
entries.exampleZh: 她在加入管弦乐团之前学习古典音乐多年。

entries.example: The museum's collection reflects the strong classicism of eighteenth-century European art.
entries.exampleZh: 这家博物馆的藏品体现了十八世纪欧洲艺术浓厚的古典主义风格。

entries.example: The classification of these plants into groups took the botanists several years.
entries.exampleZh: 把这些植物分类成组花了植物学家们好几年时间。

entries.example: Scientists classify these creatures according to their diet and habitat.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家根据饮食和栖息地来对这些生物进行分类。

entries.example: The classroom was quiet except for the sound of turning pages.
entries.exampleZh: 教室里很安静，只听见翻书页的声音。

entries.example: The contract contains a clause about early termination and its penalties.
entries.exampleZh: 这份合同包含一条关于提前终止及其违约金的条款。

entries.example: An old clavichord stood in the corner of the music room.
entries.exampleZh: 一架古老的翼琴立在音乐室的角落里。

entries.example: The eagle gripped the branch tightly with its powerful claw.
entries.exampleZh: 那只鹰用有力的爪子紧紧抓住树枝。

entries.example: The children shaped wet clay into small animals on the table.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在桌上把湿黏土捏成小动物。

entries.example: The artisans sold clayware and woven baskets at the weekend market.
entries.exampleZh: 工匠们在周末市场上出售黏土制品和编织篮。

entries.example: Please clean the kitchen counter before the guests arrive tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 请在今晚客人到来之前把厨房台面擦干净。

entries.example: The office cleaner empties the bins every evening after work.
entries.exampleZh: 办公室的清洁工每天下班后都会清空垃圾桶。

entries.example: The hospital insists on strict cleanliness in every ward and corridor.
entries.exampleZh: 这家医院要求每个病房和走廊都保持严格清洁。

entries.example: The surgeon cut cleanly through the tissue without damaging nearby nerves.
entries.exampleZh: 外科医生干净利落地切开了组织，没有损伤附近的神经。

entries.example: Heavy rain will clear the dust from the air by morning.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨到早晨会把空气中的灰尘清除掉。

entries.example: Her second draft was much clearer than the first one.
entries.exampleZh: 她的第二稿比第一稿清楚得多。

entries.example: After the storm, a narrow clearing appeared between the tall pines.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，高高的松树之间出现了一片狭窄的空地。

entries.example: The forecast promised clement weather for our coastal walk tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 天气预报说我们明天沿海散步时天气温和。

entries.meaning: 捏紧；紧紧握住；握紧，抓牢；咬紧
entries.example: She had to clench her jaw to keep from laughing aloud.
entries.exampleZh: 她不得不咬紧牙关以免笑出声来。

entries.example: Local clergy gathered to bless the newly restored village chapel.

entries.example: The elderly clergyman offered comfort to every grieving family in town.

entries.example: The hotel clerk handed me a map and a room key.
entries.exampleZh: 酒店职员递给我一张地图和一把房间钥匙。

entries.example: His cleverness impressed everyone during the difficult negotiation.

entries.meaning: 气候；气候区，地带；风气，氛围；思潮

entries.exampleZh: 科学家研究了记录在古老冰芯中的气候变化。

entries.example: The two islands differ climatically despite their close geographic proximity.

entries.example: The film reaches its climax during a tense rooftop confrontation.

entries.example: They plan to climb the mountain before sunrise tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划明天日出前攀登这座山。

entries.example: The drug passed clinical trials and won official approval last year.
entries.exampleZh: 该药物通过了临床试验，并于去年获得正式批准。

entries.meaning: 夹子 vt夹住；夹住，扣住；修剪；剪下；夹子，回形针，别针；弹夹，弹仓；电影片段，剪报

entries.exampleZh: 他用一个回形针把这几页纸夹在一起。

entries.meaning: 大剪刀, 快速帆船修剪者；快速帆船；剪刀

entries.exampleZh: 那艘旧快速帆船在日落前刚好驶入港口。

entries.example: The kitchen clock stopped at midnight, so we missed the morning bus.
entries.exampleZh: 厨房的钟在午夜停了，所以我们错过了早班公共汽车。

entries.example: A skilled clockmaker repaired the antique watch in less than an hour.
entries.exampleZh: 一位熟练的钟表匠不到一小时就修好了那只古董表。

entries.example: Turn the handle clockwise until the lid feels completely tight.
entries.exampleZh: 顺时针转动把手，直到盖子感觉完全拧紧。

entries.example: Dead leaves can clog the drain after a heavy autumn storm.
entries.exampleZh: 一场秋季暴雨过后，落叶会堵塞排水管。

entries.meaning: 克隆动物，无性繁殖动物；复制品，翻版；克隆，以无性繁殖技术复制

entries.exampleZh: 科学家在一个安全的实验室里制造了那只羊的克隆体。

entries.example: Their closeness as sisters grew stronger during the difficult year.
entries.exampleZh: 在那艰难的一年里，她们姐妹间的亲密感变得更强了。

entries.meaning: 壁橱,储藏室；隐蔽的；私下的，秘密的；把…关在房间里；橱，壁橱
entries.example: She hid the gifts in a closet behind the stairs.
entries.exampleZh: 她把礼物藏在楼梯后面的壁橱里。

entries.example: He wiped the table with a soft cloth before dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 晚饭前他用一块软布擦了桌子。

entries.example: The charity hopes to clothe every child before winter arrives.
entries.exampleZh: 这家慈善机构希望在冬天来临前给每个孩子提供衣服。

entries.example: A cloudlike mist drifted across the quiet valley at dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 黎明时分，一片云雾状的薄雾飘过安静的山谷。

entries.example: The sky turned cloudy just before our picnic began.
entries.exampleZh: 就在我们野餐开始前，天空变得多云了。

entries.example: We found a four-leaf clover in the meadow yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 昨天我们在草地上找到了一株四叶草。

entries.meaning: 俱乐部,(扑克牌)梅花；募集

entries.exampleZh: 她加入了当地的国际象棋俱乐部，以便结识新朋友。

entries.example: The detective found a useful clue near the broken window.
entries.exampleZh: 侦探在破窗户附近发现了一条有用的线索。

entries.meaning: (树，草)丛；使成一丛；聚集，成群；以沉重的脚步行走；丛，簇，束；块，团；群，组

entries.exampleZh: 一丛高高的草长在花园门旁。

entries.meaning: 笨拙的；笨拙的；不得体的，冒犯人的；复杂难懂的，难处理的

entries.exampleZh: 他笨拙的道歉尝试让大家都大声笑了。

entries.meaning: 串,丛；成群，成串；丛生；群集；簇，团，串，丛；群
entries.example: A cluster of bright stars appeared above the dark hills.
entries.exampleZh: 一簇明亮的星星出现在黑暗的山丘上方。

entries.meaning: 抓住, 攫住；企图抓住，抓紧；一次所孵的卵；离合器；掌握，控制；把握，抓紧
entries.example: She felt the child clutch her hand during the loud storm.
entries.exampleZh: 在雷声大作的暴风雨中，她感觉到孩子紧紧抓住她的手。

entries.meaning: 教练；长途公共汽车 vt训练，指导
entries.example: The coach praised the team after their surprising victory.
entries.exampleZh: 教练在球队取得出人意料的胜利后表扬了他们。

entries.example: The old train burned coal as it climbed the steep mountain pass.
entries.exampleZh: 那列老火车在爬陡峭的山口时烧着煤。

entries.example: The coalescence of two small firms created a surprisingly strong competitor.
entries.exampleZh: 两家小公司的合并造就了一个出人意料地强大的竞争对手。

entries.example: Several parties formed a fragile coalition after the election produced no clear winner.
entries.exampleZh: 选举未产生明确的赢家后，几个政党组成了一个脆弱的联盟。

entries.example: Water splashed over the coaming and soaked the deck below.
entries.exampleZh: 水溅过舱口栏板，把下面的甲板都浸湿了。

entries.meaning: 粗糙的,粗俗的；粗糙的；粗俗的
entries.example: His coarse jokes made the guests at the formal dinner uncomfortable.
entries.exampleZh: 他粗俗的玩笑让正式晚宴上的客人们感到不自在。

entries.example: We drove along the coast for hours, stopping to admire the view.
entries.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸开了好几个小时车，不时停下来欣赏风景。

entries.example: Rising sea levels threaten several coastal villages along this narrow peninsula.
entries.exampleZh: 海平面上升威胁着这个狭长半岛上的几个沿海村庄。

entries.example: Erosion has slowly reshaped the coastline over the past century.
entries.exampleZh: 过去一个世纪里，侵蚀缓慢地改变了海岸线的形状。

entries.example: She hung her heavy coat on the hook behind the door.
entries.exampleZh: 她把厚重的外套挂在门后的挂钩上。

entries.example: A thin coating of dust covered every shelf in the abandoned house.
entries.exampleZh: 空房子里每个架子上都覆着一层薄薄的灰尘。

entries.example: She tried to coax the frightened cat out from under the bed.
entries.exampleZh: 她试着把那只受惊的猫从床底下哄出来。

entries.example: The artist ground cobalt into a brilliant blue pigment for the sky.
entries.exampleZh: 这位画家把钴研磨成一种鲜艳的蓝色颜料，用来画天空。

entries.example: Every cobble on the old street was worn smooth by centuries of footsteps.
entries.exampleZh: 老街上的每块圆石都被数百年的脚步磨得光滑。

entries.example: He cracked open a fresh coconut and drank the water inside.
entries.exampleZh: 他敲开一个新鲜椰子，喝了里面的椰汁。

entries.meaning: 货到付款 (Cash on Delivery) n鳕鱼

entries.exampleZh: 厨师端上了配着柠檬和新鲜香草的烤鳕鱼。

entries.meaning: 代码 vt把…编码；编纂；把…编码；法典，法规；密码，代码

entries.exampleZh: 软件工程师在代码中发现了一个严重的错误。

entries.meaning: 把…编成法典, 编纂；把…编成法典，使法律成文化；整理，系统化

entries.exampleZh: 委员会希望把这些不成文的规则编纂成正式政策。

entries.exampleZh: 这两个变量之间的相关系数结果呈负值。

entries.exampleZh: 生物课上，学生们在显微镜下观察了一种简单的腔肠动物。

entries.example: No one should coerce a witness into changing their testimony.
entries.exampleZh: 任何人都不应该强迫证人改变证词。

entries.exampleZh: 不同物种可以在同一片森林生态系统中和平共存。

entries.example: Sleep strongly affects human cognition and memory throughout life.
entries.exampleZh: 睡眠在整个生命过程中强烈影响着人类的认知和记忆。

entries.meaning: 认知的，认识能力的；认识的；认知的，有感知的

entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼可能减缓老年人的认知能力衰退。

entries.exampleZh: 婚前同居在许多国家已经变得很常见。

entries.exampleZh: 这篇文章缺乏连贯性，因为各段在话题之间跳来跳去。

entries.exampleZh: 共同的仪式增强了小型乡村社区内部的凝聚力。

entries.exampleZh: 一个有凝聚力的团队在困难的项目中彼此信任。

entries.example: The coach praised the cohesiveness of the young squad.
entries.exampleZh: 教练称赞了这支年轻队伍的凝聚力。

entries.exampleZh: 一卷粗绳子放在木船旁边。

entries.example: He found an old silver coin beneath the garden wall.
entries.exampleZh: 他在花园的墙下发现了一枚旧的银币。

entries.exampleZh: 他们的兴趣一致，这使得合作变得容易。

entries.exampleZh: 这部电影是与当地艺术家密切合作制作的。

entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼可能有助于维持皮肤中健康的胶原质水平。

entries.meaning: 无领的,无马轭(或颈圈)的

entries.exampleZh: 这件无领亚麻衬衫在炎热的夏日里穿起来轻薄舒适。

entries.meaning: 同事, 同僚；同事，同僚

entries.exampleZh: 我的新同事帮助我很快适应了办公室。

entries.exampleZh: 志愿者们每年春天为社区图书馆收集旧书。

entries.meaning: 可收集的, 可代收的

entries.exampleZh: 她把每张可收藏的卡片都放进塑料保护套里。

entries.exampleZh: 他收藏的稀有硬币装满了三个木架。

entries.exampleZh: 她打算明年高中毕业后上大学。

entries.meaning: 碰撞,抵触；碰撞，互撞；冲突，抵触

entries.exampleZh: 碰撞损坏了两辆车，但幸运的是没有人受伤。

entries.exampleZh: 上校在训练演习开始前向军官们作了简报。

entries.meaning: 殖民地的；殖民的；殖民国家的

entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了该地区殖民时期的家具。

entries.exampleZh: 每个殖民者都必须在冬天来临前搭建住所。

entries.meaning: 殖民地化,殖民；殖民地化

entries.exampleZh: 殖民者把新的法律和习俗强加给当地人。

entries.exampleZh: 这个小岛直到二十世纪中叶一直是英国的殖民地。

entries.exampleZh: 雄鸟鲜艳的羽色在春季吸引配偶。

entries.meaning: 华美的, 富有色彩的

entries.exampleZh: 舞者们身着色彩艳丽的服装，参加镇广场上的年度节庆。

entries.exampleZh: 她搬到哥伦比亚，去一所著名大学攻读新闻学。

entries.meaning: 美国的, 美洲的,哥伦布的

entries.exampleZh: 哥伦布大交换改变了美洲与欧洲两岸的农业面貌。

entries.exampleZh: 旧图书馆的入口处立着一根高大的大理石圆柱。

entries.exampleZh: 士兵们在派往海外之前接受了徒手格斗的专门训练。

entries.meaning: 结合,联合,合并；结合，混合；化合；组合

entries.exampleZh: 这位厨师喜欢在菜肴中把酸甜两种味道结合起来。
