entries.example: The government promised to demobilize most troops once the peace treaty was signed.
entries.exampleZh: 政府承诺一旦和平条约签署就遣散大部分军队。

entries.meaning: 民主政治, 民主主义；民主政体，民主制度；民主国家；民主精神
entries.example: A healthy democracy depends on transparent institutions and an informed public.
entries.exampleZh: 一个健康的民主制度依赖于透明的机构和知情的公众。

entries.meaning: 民主主义者,美国民主党人；民主主义者；[D-]民主党人
entries.example: As a lifelong democrat, she opposed any law limiting free speech.
entries.exampleZh: 作为一名终身的民主主义者，她反对任何限制言论自由的法律。

entries.example: The club follows a strictly democratic process when choosing its new leaders.
entries.exampleZh: 该俱乐部在选举新领导人时遵循严格的民主程序。

entries.example: Economic growth often speeds up the democratization of formerly closed societies.
entries.exampleZh: 经济增长常常会加速昔日封闭社会的民主化进程。

entries.example: The survey revealed a sharp demographic shift toward older residents in rural areas.
entries.exampleZh: 这项调查揭示了农村地区居民趋于老龄化的人口结构急剧变化。

entries.meaning: 毁坏, 推翻, 粉碎；拆除；破坏；驳倒，推翻
entries.example: Developers plan to demolish the old theater and build apartments there.
entries.exampleZh: 开发商计划拆除那座旧剧院，并在那里建公寓。

entries.example: The demolition of the historic bridge sparked angry protests across the city.
entries.exampleZh: 那座历史悠久的桥梁被拆除，在全市引发了愤怒的抗议。

entries.meaning: 示范,证明,论证；论证，证明；表现，显露；示范，演示；游行示威
entries.example: The engineer will demonstrate how the new pump works before we install it.
entries.exampleZh: 在我们安装之前，工程师会演示新水泵的工作原理。

entries.example: Her calm reaction to the criticism was a fine demonstration of self-control.
entries.exampleZh: 她对批评的冷静反应很好地示范了自制力。

entries.example: His flat denial of the accusation surprised everyone in the meeting room.
entries.exampleZh: 他对这一指控的断然否认让会议室里的每个人都很吃惊。

entries.example: She spent a semester in Denmark studying wind energy and urban planning.
entries.exampleZh: 她在丹麦度过了一个学期，研究风能与城市规划。

entries.example: The bank teller counted every note regardless of its denomination and condition.
entries.exampleZh: 银行出纳清点了每一张纸币，无论其面额和状况如何。

entries.meaning: 表示，意指；标示，预示，象征
entries.example: In this chart, red squares denote areas at high risk of flooding.
entries.exampleZh: 在这张图表中，红色方块表示洪水风险高的区域。

entries.meaning: 谴责，公开指责，抨击；告发
entries.example: Several nations moved quickly to denounce the attack on the hospital.
entries.exampleZh: 几个国家迅速采取行动，谴责对这家医院的袭击。

entries.example: The forest here is so dense that sunlight rarely reaches the ground.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的森林非常茂密，阳光很少能照到地面。

entries.example: This densely populated district suffers from traffic jams every single morning.
entries.exampleZh: 这个人口稠密的地区每天早上都遭受交通拥堵之苦。

entries.example: Scientists measured the density of the sample before heating it slowly.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家在缓慢加热样品之前测量了它的密度。

entries.meaning: 使凹下；挫伤，损害；缺口，凹痕
entries.example: The mechanic found a small dent in the car door.
entries.exampleZh: 机械师在车门上发现了一个小凹痕。

entries.example: I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow afternoon at three.
entries.exampleZh: 我明天下午三点和牙医有预约。

entries.meaning: 否认, 拒绝；否认；拒绝承认；拒绝给予
entries.example: The company continues to deny any responsibility for the accident.
entries.exampleZh: 该公司继续否认对事故负有任何责任。

entries.example: The train will depart from platform four in ten minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 火车将在十分钟后从四号站台出发。

entries.example: She works in the marketing department of a large company.
entries.exampleZh: 她在一家大公司的市场部工作。

entries.example: Our departure was delayed by two hours due to heavy snow.
entries.exampleZh: 由于大雪，我们的出发推迟了两个小时。

entries.meaning: 依靠,取决于；依靠，依赖；取决于
entries.example: The final result will depend on how carefully we prepare.
entries.exampleZh: 最终结果将取决于我们准备得多么仔细。

entries.example: We need a dependable car for the long journey ahead.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要一辆可靠的汽车来应对前方的长途旅程。

entries.example: The old generator has worked dependably through every winter storm.
entries.exampleZh: 这台旧发电机在每个冬季风暴中都可靠地运转。

entries.example: His dependence on painkillers worried his family and doctor.
entries.exampleZh: 他对止痛药的依赖让家人和医生感到担忧。

entries.example: The young bird is still dependent on its mother for food.
entries.exampleZh: 这只幼鸟仍然依赖母亲获取食物。

entries.meaning: 描述,描写；描写，描述，描绘
entries.example: These photographs depict life in the village before the war.
entries.exampleZh: 这些照片描绘了战前村庄里的生活。

entries.example: The film offers a realistic depiction of life in rural China.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影真实地描绘了中国农村的生活。

entries.meaning: 耗尽, 使衰竭；使枯竭，耗尽
entries.example: Heavy fishing can quickly deplete the fish stocks in this bay.
entries.exampleZh: 过度捕捞会迅速耗尽这个海湾的鱼类资源。

entries.example: Scientists warn that the depletion of ozone poses a serious threat.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家警告说，臭氧的消耗构成了严重威胁。

entries.example: The prisoners were kept in deplorable conditions for many months.
entries.exampleZh: 囚犯们被关在恶劣的条件下好几个月。

entries.example: Many citizens deplore the government's failure to protect public parks.
entries.exampleZh: 许多市民谴责政府未能保护公共公园。

entries.example: The company plans to deploy new software across all its offices.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划在所有办公室部署新软件。

entries.example: The authorities may deport him if he overstays his visa.
entries.exampleZh: 如果他签证逾期，当局可能会将他驱逐出境。

entries.example: The rebels finally managed to depose the unpopular king.
entries.exampleZh: 叛军最终成功废黜了不得人心的国王。

entries.meaning: 沉淀,存放,堆积；存款,堆积物；沉淀；堆积；储蓄；
entries.example: The landlord asked for a deposit before handing over the keys.
entries.exampleZh: 房东在交出钥匙前要求支付押金。

entries.example: The river's slow deposition of sand created a wide fertile delta.
entries.exampleZh: 河流缓慢的沉积作用形成了宽阔而肥沃的三角洲。

entries.example: Each depositor received a printed statement after the bank merged.
entries.exampleZh: 银行合并后，每位存款人都收到了一份打印的对账单。

entries.meaning: 贮藏所, 仓库；库房，仓库；公共汽车站，火车站
entries.example: The old depot now stores buses instead of broken railway cars.
entries.exampleZh: 这座旧车库现在停放公共汽车，而不再存放破损的火车车厢。

entries.example: Many experts deprecate the use of vague promises in public reports.
entries.exampleZh: 许多专家反对在公开报告中使用含糊的承诺。

entries.example: Rapid depreciation of the local currency made imported goods far more expensive.
entries.exampleZh: 本币迅速贬值使进口商品贵得多。

entries.meaning: 掠夺, 破坏痕迹；劫掠，掠夺，破坏
entries.example: The forest suffered serious depredation from illegal logging over the past decade.
entries.exampleZh: 过去十年里，非法伐木使这片森林遭到严重破坏。

entries.meaning: 使沮丧, 使消沉；降低，削弱；使沮丧；使萧条
entries.example: High interest rates depress consumer spending and slow the entire economy.
entries.exampleZh: 高利率抑制消费支出，并拖慢整个经济。

entries.example: Her long depression began after the company closed its local office.
entries.exampleZh: 公司关闭当地办事处后，她长期的抑郁开始了。

entries.example: Sleep deprivation affects memory and mood more than most people realize.
entries.exampleZh: 睡眠不足对记忆和情绪的影响比多数人意识到的更大。

entries.meaning: 剥夺,使丧失；使失去，剥夺
entries.example: Poor lighting can deprive workers of safety and concentration on the job.
entries.exampleZh: 照明不足会使工人在工作中失去安全感和专注力。

entries.example: The divers measured the depth of the icy lake before entering.
entries.exampleZh: 潜水员在进入冰冷湖水前测量了湖的深度。

entries.example: The crowd gave a derisive laugh at his clumsy performance.
entries.exampleZh: 人群对他笨拙的表演发出嘲笑的哄笑。

entries.example: The derivation of this custom remains unclear to modern historians.
entries.exampleZh: 这一习俗的起源对现代历史学家来说仍不清楚。

entries.meaning: 派生的，引出的；无创意的；派生词，衍生词；派生物
entries.example: Critics dismissed the film as a derivative copy of earlier spy thrillers.
entries.exampleZh: 评论家把这部电影斥为早期间谍惊悚片的无创意翻版。

entries.meaning: 获取,得自,起源；取得；起源
entries.example: Many medicines derive from plants found in tropical rainforests.
entries.exampleZh: 许多药物来源于热带雨林中的植物。

entries.meaning: 起重机, (钻井)井口上的铁架塔
entries.example: A tall derrick lifted the heavy steel pipes onto the ship.
entries.exampleZh: 一座高耸的起重机把沉重的钢管吊到船上。

entries.meaning: 减少盐分, 脱盐作用
entries.example: The coastal plant uses solar power for cheap desalination of seawater.
entries.exampleZh: 这家沿海工厂利用太阳能以低成本淡化海水。

entries.meaning: 下来, 下降；遗传；下降；起源；降临，来临
entries.example: Dark clouds descend over the valley before the summer storm arrives.
entries.exampleZh: 夏季暴风雨来临前，乌云笼罩山谷。

entries.example: She is a direct descendant of a famous nineteenth-century sea captain.
entries.exampleZh: 她是一位著名十九世纪船长的直系后裔。

entries.meaning: 下降,下倾；血统，世系；下降
entries.example: The steep descent from the ridge left our legs trembling.
entries.exampleZh: 从山脊下来的那段陡坡让我们双腿发抖。

entries.example: Her detailed description of the market made me want to visit.
entries.exampleZh: 她对那个市场的详细描述让我很想去看看。

entries.meaning: 描述的, 叙述的；描述性的，叙述的
entries.example: The guide's descriptive passages bring the old town vividly to life.
entries.exampleZh: 这本指南中描写性的段落把老城写得栩栩如生。

entries.example: The city voted to desegregate its public schools in the 1960s.
entries.exampleZh: 该市在二十世纪六十年代投票决定废除公立学校的种族隔离。

entries.meaning: 荒废的，空无一人的；被离弃的，被遗弃的
entries.example: We walked through the deserted streets of the old harbour district.
entries.exampleZh: 我们走过老港区空无一人的街道。

entries.example: Overgrazing has accelerated desertification across large parts of the region.
entries.exampleZh: 过度放牧加速了该地区大片土地的沙漠化。

entries.meaning: 应受, 值得；应得，值得
entries.example: After such hard work, you deserve a long holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 这么辛苦之后，你该好好休个长假。

entries.example: Prolonged desiccation of the soil killed most of the young plants.
entries.exampleZh: 土壤长期干燥使大部分幼苗枯死。

entries.meaning: 指明,指定；已任命但尚未就职的；命名；任命；指明，标示
entries.example: The council will designate the area as a protected nature reserve.
entries.exampleZh: 市政会将把这片区域指定为受保护的自然保护区。

entries.meaning: 指示, 指定, 名称
entries.example: Her official designation is senior research fellow in the department.
entries.exampleZh: 她的正式头衔是该系的高级研究员。

entries.example: The designer chose warm colours to make the room feel inviting.
entries.exampleZh: 设计师选用暖色调让房间显得温馨宜人。

entries.example: The desirability of the scheme depends on how much it costs.
entries.exampleZh: 这个方案是否可取取决于它花费多少。

entries.example: A quiet neighbourhood is highly desirable for families with small children.
entries.exampleZh: 安静的社区对有小孩的家庭来说非常理想。

entries.example: She felt a sudden desire to leave the party early.
entries.exampleZh: 她突然很想早点离开聚会。

entries.meaning: 荒凉的, 无人烟的；荒凉的，无人烟的；不幸的，忧伤的；使感到悲惨，使感到凄凉；使荒芜
entries.example: The desolate landscape stretched for miles beyond the ruined village.
entries.exampleZh: 荒凉的景色在废弃村庄之外绵延数英里。

entries.meaning: 不顾一切的, 拚死的, 令人绝望的；绝望的；不顾死活的，拼命的；极度渴望的
entries.example: He was desperate for news about his missing brother.
entries.exampleZh: 他迫切想得到失踪弟弟的消息。

entries.example: I despise people who are cruel to animals.
entries.exampleZh: 我鄙视虐待动物的人。

entries.example: Despite the heavy rain, the match continued without a break.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管雨很大，比赛依然不停地继续进行。

entries.example: It is wrong to despoil such beautiful countryside.
entries.exampleZh: 如此美丽的乡村遭到掠夺是不对的。

entries.meaning: 失望的, 沮丧的；垂头丧气的，沮丧的
entries.example: He grew despondent after failing the exam twice.
entries.exampleZh: 两次考试不及格后，他变得垂头丧气。

entries.example: Our final destination was a quiet village near the northern coast.
entries.exampleZh: 我们最终的目的地是北部海岸附近一个安静的小村庄。

entries.example: They believed the gods could destine a person's future without consent.
entries.exampleZh: 他们相信众神能在未经同意的情况下注定一个人的未来。

entries.example: She always felt destined for a life far beyond her hometown.
entries.exampleZh: 她一直觉得自己注定要过一种远离家乡的生活。

entries.example: The sudden flood could destroy several homes along the river.
entries.exampleZh: 突如其来的洪水可能会摧毁河边的几处房屋。

entries.example: The storm caused widespread destruction across the coastal region last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚风暴在沿海地区造成了大规模破坏。

entries.meaning: 破坏(性)的；破坏性的，毁灭性的
entries.example: Such destructive habits can ruin a promising career over time.
entries.exampleZh: 这类破坏性的习惯会随着时间毁掉一份前途光明的事业。

entries.example: Please detach the coupon and keep the rest of the form.
entries.exampleZh: 请撕下优惠券，并保留表格的其余部分。

entries.example: His calm detachment made it hard for colleagues to read his feelings.
entries.exampleZh: 他冷静的超然态度让同事们很难读懂他的感受。

entries.example: The witness described every detail of the accident to the police.
entries.exampleZh: 目击者向警方描述了事故的每一个细节。

entries.meaning: 察觉,侦查,发现；发现，察觉；探测；查明
entries.example: Modern sensors can detect tiny changes in air pressure and temperature.
entries.exampleZh: 现代传感器能够探测到气压和温度的微小变化。

entries.meaning: 可发现的,可察觉的；可发觉的，可察觉的
entries.example: The leak was not detectable until the pressure dropped sharply.
entries.exampleZh: 直到压力骤降，泄漏才变得可以察觉。

entries.example: Early detection of the disease greatly improves the patient's chances of recovery.
entries.exampleZh: 这种疾病的早期发现大大提高了患者的康复机会。

entries.example: The detective questioned every witness before reviewing the evidence again.
entries.exampleZh: 侦探在再次审查证据之前询问了每一位目击者。

entries.example: Strict penalties may deter some drivers from speeding on busy roads.
entries.exampleZh: 严厉的处罚可能会阻止一些司机在繁忙道路上超速。

entries.example: She poured too much detergent into the washing machine this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上她往洗衣机里倒了太多洗涤剂。

entries.example: Without proper care, his health began to deteriorate quite rapidly.
entries.exampleZh: 由于缺乏适当护理，他的健康状况开始迅速恶化。

entries.example: The old bridge deteriorates quickly when heavy trucks pass daily.
entries.exampleZh: 当重型卡车每天经过时，这座旧桥会迅速损坏。

entries.example: The rapid deterioration of air quality worries local doctors and parents.
entries.exampleZh: 空气质量的迅速恶化令当地医生和家长担忧。

entries.example: Education remains a key determinant of future income in most societies.
entries.exampleZh: 在大多数社会中，教育仍是未来收入的一个关键决定因素。

entries.example: Her determination to finish the race impressed everyone along the route.
entries.exampleZh: 她完成比赛的决心让沿途所有人都印象深刻。

entries.meaning: 查明，确定；决心，决定；支配，影响
entries.example: Scientists must determine the cause of the sudden drop in fish numbers.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家必须查明鱼类数量骤降的原因。

entries.example: She determinedly refused to apologize despite the pressure from her colleagues.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管同事施压，她仍决然地拒绝道歉。

entries.example: Heavy fines serve as a strong deterrent against illegal dumping in the park.
entries.exampleZh: 高额罚款对在公园非法倾倒垃圾起到了强大的威慑作用。

entries.example: I detest the way he interrupts others during meetings.
entries.exampleZh: 我讨厌他在会议上打断别人的样子。

entries.example: A few careless errors should not detract from the quality of her research.
entries.exampleZh: 几个粗心的错误不应减损她研究的价值。

entries.example: Even his harshest detractor admitted that the plan had worked.
entries.exampleZh: 就连他最严厉的诽谤者也承认这个方案奏效了。

entries.example: Thick layers of detritus covered the forest floor after the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，厚厚的碎石覆盖了森林地面。

entries.meaning: 毁坏；破坏，毁坏；令人震惊，使难以承受
entries.example: A single wildfire can devastate thousands of acres within a few hours.
entries.exampleZh: 一场野火能在几小时内毁掉数千英亩土地。

entries.example: The storm left a trail of devastation across the coastal villages.
entries.exampleZh: 这场风暴在沿海村庄留下了一片毁坏的痕迹。

entries.example: The developer promised to build a park beside the new apartments.
entries.exampleZh: 开发商承诺在新公寓旁建一座公园。

entries.example: Doctors monitor each child's developmental progress during the first few years.
entries.exampleZh: 医生在最初几年监测每个孩子的发展进展。

entries.meaning: 不正常的，越出常规的；不正常的人
entries.example: Teachers should not label every curious student as a deviant.
entries.exampleZh: 老师不应把每个好奇的学生都贴上一个越轨者的标签。

entries.example: Please do not deviate from the plan we agreed on yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要偏离我们昨天商定的方案。

entries.example: Any deviation from the standard procedure must be reported at once.
entries.exampleZh: 任何偏离标准程序的做法都必须立即报告。

entries.meaning: 装置,设备；装置，设备；手法，策略
entries.example: This small device measures the humidity in the greenhouse every hour.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小装置每小时测量一次温室里的湿度。

entries.meaning: 设计,发明；设计；发明；想出；策划，图谋
entries.example: Engineers had to devise a cheaper method for filtering the water.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师们不得不设计一种更便宜的滤水方法。

entries.meaning: 全无的, 缺乏的；全无的
entries.example: His speech was devoid of any real emotion or conviction.
entries.exampleZh: 他的演讲缺乏任何真实的情感或信念。

entries.meaning: 投入于, 献身；为…付出；献身于
entries.example: She decided to devote her weekends to helping the local animal shelter.
entries.exampleZh: 她决定把周末用来帮助当地的动物收容所。

entries.example: His devotion to his students earned him great respect in the town.
entries.exampleZh: 他对学生的热爱为他在镇上赢得了极大的尊敬。

entries.meaning: 吞食,吞没；狼吞虎咽地吃，吞食；吞没，吞噬；如饥似渴地读
entries.example: The children devour every book they can find about ancient Egypt.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们如饥似渴地读着每一本能找到的关于古埃及的书。

entries.example: She remained a devout believer despite years of hardship and doubt.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管多年艰辛与怀疑，她仍是一个虔诚的信徒。

entries.example: The morning dew on the grass sparkled brightly in the early sunlight.
entries.exampleZh: 清晨的露水在草地上被初升的阳光照得闪闪发亮。

entries.meaning: 惯用右手的；灵巧的，熟练的
entries.example: Her dexterous fingers quickly tied the complicated knot without any hesitation.
entries.exampleZh: 她灵巧的手指毫不犹豫地迅速系好了这个复杂的结。

entries.example: Doctors used advanced scans to diagnose the rare condition at an early stage.
entries.exampleZh: 医生利用先进的扫描技术在早期诊断了这种罕见病症。

entries.example: The carpenter drew a straight diagonal across the wooden board before cutting it.
entries.exampleZh: 木匠在切割前在木板上画了一条笔直的对角线。

entries.example: The narrow path runs diagonally across the field toward the old stone bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 这条狭窄的小路斜穿过田野，通向那座古老的石桥。

entries.example: The teacher used a simple diagram to explain how the water cycle works.
entries.exampleZh: 老师用一张简单的图表来解释水循环是如何运作的。

entries.example: People in that remote village still speak a dialect their grandparents used daily.
entries.exampleZh: 那个偏远村庄的人们仍然说着他们祖父母日常使用的一种方言。

entries.example: The two leaders finally agreed to begin an honest dialogue about trade.
entries.exampleZh: 两位领导人最终同意就贸易问题开始坦诚对话。

entries.example: The pipe has a diameter of ten centimeters and runs beneath the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 这根管子的直径是十厘米，从花园下面穿过。

entries.example: She wore a tiny diamond ring that sparkled under the chandelier's warm light.
entries.exampleZh: 她戴着一枚小小的钻戒，在吊灯温暖的光线下闪闪发光。

entries.example: The novel explores the dichotomy between public duty and private desire.
entries.exampleZh: 这部小说探讨了公共职责与私人欲望之间的二元对立。

entries.meaning: 录音电话机（商标名称）[商标名] 录音机
entries.example: The secretary placed the dictaphone beside the phone and began typing.
entries.exampleZh: 秘书把录音机放在电话旁边，然后开始打字。

entries.meaning: 口授；命令；规定；决定；口述；支配；命令，规定
entries.example: The manager will dictate a formal letter to his new assistant tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 经理明天将向他的新助理口述一封正式信函。

entries.meaning: 措辞, 用语, 言语；措辞，用语
entries.example: The poet's precise diction gives the simple verses surprising emotional force.
entries.exampleZh: 这位诗人精准的措辞赋予这些简单的诗句惊人的情感力量。

entries.example: Many plants die when they receive too much water and too little sun.
entries.exampleZh: 许多植物在浇水过多且阳光不足时会死亡。

entries.meaning: 通常所吃的食物,会议；节食；饮食，食物；规定饮食
entries.example: Her doctor recommended a balanced diet rich in vegetables and whole grains.
entries.exampleZh: 她的医生建议采用富含蔬菜和全谷物的均衡饮食。

entries.example: The hospital respects all dietary restrictions when preparing meals for its patients.
entries.exampleZh: 医院在为病人准备餐食时尊重所有饮食限制。

entries.example: Our opinions differ sharply on how to solve the city's traffic problem.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在如何解决城市交通问题上意见截然不同。

entries.meaning: 差别的，有区别的；微分的；差别，差异；微分
entries.example: The engineer measured the pressure differential between the two sealed chambers.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师测量了两个密封腔室之间的压力差。

entries.example: Students must differentiate between reliable sources and misleading claims online.
entries.exampleZh: 学生必须区分可靠的来源和网上的误导性说法。

entries.example: A differentiating process turns a function into its derivative at every point.
entries.exampleZh: 微分过程把函数在每一点转化为其导数。

entries.example: Each culture approaches personal space differently, so travelers should observe local habits.
entries.exampleZh: 每种文化对个人空间的处理方式不同，因此旅行者应观察当地习惯。

entries.example: She had difficulty understanding the professor's accent during the first lecture.
entries.exampleZh: 她在第一堂课上很难听懂教授的口音。

entries.meaning: 散播,传播；散播，传播；漫射，扩散；扩散的，漫射的；冗长的
entries.example: The scent began to diffuse through the crowded room within minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 香气几分钟内开始在拥挤的房间里扩散。

entries.example: The illness spread diffusely through the region before doctors recognized its cause.
entries.exampleZh: 医生尚未查明病因前，这种疾病已在该地区广泛传播。

entries.example: Warm light diffuses gently through the curtains each morning.
entries.exampleZh: 每天早晨，暖光透过窗帘柔和地扩散开来。

entries.meaning: 传播，散布；散布，扩散；传播
entries.example: The diffusion of new ideas often depends on trust between communities.
entries.exampleZh: 新思想的传播往往取决于社群之间的信任。

entries.example: Calcium difluoride occurs naturally in fluorite and is used in optical lenses.
entries.exampleZh: 二氟化钙天然存在于萤石中，并用于光学透镜。

entries.example: Workers had to dig carefully around the ancient pipes beneath the street.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们不得不小心翼翼地在街道下方的古老管道周围挖掘。

entries.meaning: 消化,融会贯通；消化，吸收；领悟；摘要，概要
entries.example: Some people cannot digest milk products easily, so they choose alternatives.
entries.exampleZh: 有些人不能轻松消化奶制品，因此他们会选择替代品。

entries.example: Proper digestion requires a balanced diet and enough time to eat slowly.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的消化需要均衡饮食和足够时间慢慢进食。

entries.example: The digestive system breaks food into nutrients that the body can absorb.
entries.exampleZh: 消化系统把食物分解成身体可以吸收的营养物质。

entries.example: They plan to digitize the old records before the library renovation begins.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划在图书馆翻修开始前把这些旧记录数字化。

entries.example: She refused to dignify his rude remark with any kind of response.
entries.exampleZh: 她拒绝以任何回应来抬高他那无礼言论的份量。

entries.meaning: 尊严，庄严；高贵，尊贵；自尊，自重
entries.example: He faced the unfair criticism with quiet dignity and remarkable self-control.
entries.exampleZh: 他以平静的尊严和非凡的自制力面对不公平的批评。

entries.meaning: 离题，扯到枝节上；题外话，枝节内容
entries.example: The professor's long digression about his travels delayed the main lecture.
entries.exampleZh: 教授关于自己旅行的冗长离题话耽误了主要讲座。

entries.example: The old dike protected the village from floods for nearly a century.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古老的堤坝保护村庄免受洪水侵袭近一个世纪。

entries.example: The doctor used drops to dilate her pupils before the eye examination.
entries.exampleZh: 医生在眼科检查前用滴眼液使她的瞳孔扩大。

entries.meaning: 进退两难的局面, 困难的选择；困境，进退两难的局面
entries.example: She faced a moral dilemma when asked to report her friend's mistake.
entries.exampleZh: 当被要求报告朋友的错误时，她面临一个道德困境。

entries.example: Her diligence impressed everyone during the long and difficult research project.
entries.exampleZh: 她在漫长而艰难的研究项目中表现出的勤奋给所有人留下了深刻印象。

entries.example: A diligent student reviews her notes carefully before every important exam.
entries.exampleZh: 勤奋的学生在每次重要考试前都会仔细复习笔记。

entries.meaning: 稀释，冲淡；冲淡的，稀释的；冲淡，稀释；淡化，削弱
entries.example: Please dilute the juice with water before serving it to the children.
entries.exampleZh: 请在给孩子们喝之前用水把果汁稀释一下。

entries.example: The dilution of the syrup made it far too weak for our taste.
entries.exampleZh: 糖浆的稀释使它对我们来说味道太淡了。

entries.meaning: (使)暗淡,(使)模糊；模糊的；暗淡的；朦胧的；不乐观的；变暗淡；变冷漠
entries.example: The sky began to dim as the storm approached the quiet village.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨逼近安静的村庄时，天空开始变暗。

entries.example: He found an old dime beneath the cushion of the sofa.
entries.exampleZh: 他在沙发垫下面发现了一枚旧的一角硬币。

entries.meaning: 尺寸, 尺度；维，元；尺寸；方面；特点；
entries.example: The new dimension of the problem surprised even the experienced engineers.
entries.exampleZh: 问题的新层面甚至让经验丰富的工程师也感到惊讶。

entries.meaning: 维度的, 空间的, 尺寸的；…度空间的
entries.example: Their dimensional analysis revealed a serious flaw in the original design.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的尺寸分析揭示了原设计中的一个严重缺陷。

entries.meaning: (使)减少, (使)变小；降低，贬低；减少，减弱
entries.example: The noise from the street gradually began to diminish after midnight.
entries.exampleZh: 午夜过后，街上的噪音逐渐减弱。

entries.example: A slight diminution in sales worried the manager of the store.
entries.exampleZh: 销量的轻微下降让这家商店的经理感到担忧。

entries.example: The old lamp glowed dimly in the corner of the room.
entries.exampleZh: 那盏旧灯在房间角落里发出昏暗的光。

entries.meaning: 有酒窝的, 有凹处的
entries.example: Her dimply smile made everyone feel welcome at the party.
entries.exampleZh: 她带酒窝的微笑让派对上每个人都感到受欢迎。

entries.example: The family gathered in the dining room for a quiet meal.
entries.exampleZh: 一家人在餐厅里聚在一起，吃了一顿安静的饭。

entries.example: We invited our neighbors to dinner on Saturday evening.
entries.exampleZh: 我们邀请邻居周六晚上来吃晚饭。

entries.example: The museum displayed a huge dinosaur skeleton in the main hall.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆在主大厅里展出了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。

entries.example: Too much carbon dioxide in the air worries many scientists today.
entries.exampleZh: 空气中过多的二氧化碳令许多科学家担忧。

entries.example: The experienced diplomat handled the delicate negotiations with great patience.
entries.exampleZh: 这位经验丰富的外交官以极大的耐心处理了这场微妙的谈判。

entries.meaning: 外交的，从事外交的；有策略的，有手腕的，老练的
entries.example: She gave a diplomatic answer that avoided offending either side.
entries.exampleZh: 她给了一个避免冒犯任何一方的圆滑回答。

entries.example: The village faced dire consequences after the river flooded the fields.
entries.exampleZh: 河水淹没了田地后，村庄面临可怕的后果。

entries.example: The officer will direct traffic at the busy intersection this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上，警官将在繁忙的十字路口指挥交通。

entries.example: The new map includes a directional arrow that helps hikers find the trail.
entries.exampleZh: 新地图上有一个方向箭头，帮助徒步者找到小径。

entries.example: The manager issued a clear directive about safety procedures before the inspection.
entries.exampleZh: 经理在检查前发布了一项明确的安全程序指示。

entries.example: The film director asked the actors to repeat the final scene.
entries.exampleZh: 电影导演让演员们重拍最后一场戏。

entries.meaning: 人名地址录，电话号码簿；目录
entries.example: She found the plumber's number in the local telephone directory.
entries.exampleZh: 她在当地电话簿里找到了水管工的电话号码。

entries.example: Mud and dirt covered the floor after the workers finished the repairs.
entries.exampleZh: 工人完成维修后，泥浆和污垢盖满了地板。

entries.example: Her hearing disability did not stop her from leading the project successfully.
entries.exampleZh: 她的听力残疾并没有阻止她成功领导这个项目。

entries.meaning: 不利,缺点,劣势；缺点，障碍，不利之处
entries.example: One major disadvantage of this plan is its high cost.
entries.exampleZh: 这个计划的一个主要缺点是成本很高。

entries.example: The new tax rules are disadvantageous for small family businesses.
entries.exampleZh: 新税收规定对小家庭企业不利。

entries.example: Growing disaffection among voters worried the party before the election.
entries.exampleZh: 选民中日益增长的不满在选举前令该党担忧。

entries.example: I disagree with your conclusion, although I understand your reasoning.
entries.exampleZh: 我不同意你的结论，尽管我理解你的推理。

entries.example: A minor disagreement about the budget delayed the final decision.
entries.exampleZh: 关于预算的小分歧推迟了最终决定。

entries.example: The morning fog will disappear once the sun rises higher.
entries.exampleZh: 太阳升得更高后，晨雾就会消失。

entries.example: The sudden disappearance of the keys puzzled everyone in the office.
entries.exampleZh: 钥匙突然不见让办公室里的每个人都很困惑。

entries.example: I hope the final result will not disappoint our loyal supporters.
entries.exampleZh: 我希望最终结果不会让我们的忠实支持者失望。

entries.example: Losing the championship was a huge disappointment for the entire team.
entries.exampleZh: 失去冠军对整个球队来说是一个巨大的失望。

entries.example: Her parents expressed strong disapproval of the plan to travel alone.
entries.exampleZh: 她的父母对独自旅行的计划表示强烈不赞成。

entries.meaning: 解除武装；裁军；消除，消解
entries.example: The negotiators hoped to disarm the rebels without further bloodshed.
entries.exampleZh: 谈判者希望在不发生更多流血冲突的情况下解除叛军武装。

entries.example: The flood was a disaster that destroyed hundreds of homes.
entries.exampleZh: 这场洪水是一场摧毁了数百所房屋的灾难。

entries.meaning: 灾难性的, 极糟的；灾难性的
entries.example: The company's disastrous investment left thousands of employees without jobs.
entries.exampleZh: 公司灾难性的投资使数千名员工失去了工作。

entries.example: He inserted the disc into the player and pressed play.
entries.exampleZh: 他把光盘插入播放器，然后按下了播放键。

entries.example: Please discard any documents that are no longer needed for the audit.
entries.exampleZh: 请丢弃任何审计不再需要的文件。

entries.example: It was hard to discern any real difference between the two proposals.
entries.exampleZh: 很难察觉出这两份提案之间有任何真正的差别。

entries.example: After the storm, a faint path was barely discernible through the tall grass.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，一条模糊的小径在高草中几乎难以辨认。

entries.meaning: 释放,排出；释放；放；解雇；清偿；履行；流出物；放电
entries.example: The factory must not discharge waste water into the river without a permit.
entries.exampleZh: 未经许可，工厂不得向河中排放废水。

entries.meaning: 信徒, 弟子；门徒，弟子，追随者
entries.example: Each disciple followed the old master through the mountains for many years.
entries.exampleZh: 每位弟子都跟随这位老师父在山中行走多年。

entries.meaning: 纪律,学科；训练；训练；惩罚；纪律；学科
entries.example: Learning a language demands discipline and patience rather than sudden bursts of effort.
entries.exampleZh: 学习一门语言需要纪律和耐心，而不是一时的猛冲。

entries.example: The website displays a disclaimer stating that its content is for information only.
entries.exampleZh: 该网站展示了一则免责声明，说明其内容仅供参考。

entries.example: The company refused to disclose the full details of the settlement.
entries.exampleZh: 公司拒绝透露和解协议的全部细节。

entries.example: They met at a small disco near the harbour and danced until dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在一个靠近港口的小迪斯科舞厅相遇，一直跳到天亮。

entries.example: Sunlight and damp air will gradually discolor the old wooden floor.
entries.exampleZh: 阳光和潮湿的空气会逐渐使旧木地板变色。

entries.example: A strange discoloration had spread across the ceiling after the heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨过后，天花板上蔓延开一片奇怪的变色。

entries.example: Her sudden silence during the interview began to disconcert the young reporter.
entries.exampleZh: 她在采访中突然的沉默开始让这位年轻记者感到不安。

entries.example: Growing discontent among the workers finally forced the manager to reconsider.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们日益增长的不满最终迫使经理重新考虑。

entries.example: A sharp discontinuity in the data suggested that the sensor had failed.
entries.exampleZh: 数据中明显的间断表明传感器出现了故障。

entries.meaning: 不一致；不和，纷争；不和谐
entries.example: Their disagreement over money caused lasting discord within the family.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在金钱上的分歧在家庭内部造成了持久的纷争。

entries.meaning: 折扣；把…打折扣；不全信，漠视，低估
entries.example: The shop offered a generous discount on all winter coats last weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 上周末，这家店对所有冬季外套提供了大幅折扣。

entries.meaning: 使气馁,阻碍；使泄气，使灰心；阻止，劝阻
entries.example: Heavy rain did not discourage the volunteers from finishing the cleanup.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨并没有让志愿者们放弃完成清理工作。

entries.meaning: 谈话, 演讲；讲述，论述；演讲；论文；话语
entries.example: Her lecture offered a careful discourse on the ethics of artificial intelligence.
entries.exampleZh: 她的讲座就人工智能伦理做了一场严谨的论述。

entries.example: The discoverer of the ancient tomb never published a full account.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古墓的发现者从未发表完整的记述。

entries.example: The discovery of a hidden letter changed how historians understood the case.
entries.exampleZh: 一封隐藏信件的发现改变了历史学家对这案子的理解。

entries.meaning: 怀疑 n丧失名誉；使丧失声誉；使怀疑；名誉丧失
entries.example: The leaked emails could discredit the entire leadership before the election.
entries.exampleZh: 泄露的邮件可能在选举前使整个领导层名誉扫地。

entries.meaning: 不连续的, 离散的；分离的，个别的；离散的
entries.example: The engineers divided the system into discrete modules for easier testing.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师们把系统分成离散模块，以便更容易测试。

entries.meaning: 歧视,区别待遇；区别；歧视
entries.example: Employers must never discriminate against applicants based on their accent or age.
entries.exampleZh: 雇主绝不能因申请人的口音或年龄而歧视他们。

entries.example: The company faces a lawsuit over alleged age discrimination in hiring.
entries.exampleZh: 公司因招聘中涉嫌年龄歧视而面临诉讼。

entries.example: Our discussion about the budget lasted longer than anyone had expected.
entries.exampleZh: 我们关于预算的讨论持续得比任何人预想的都久。

entries.example: She looked at the cheap gift with obvious disdain and said nothing.
entries.exampleZh: 她带着明显的轻蔑看着那份廉价礼物，什么也没说。

entries.example: The rare disease affects the nervous system and requires lifelong treatment.
entries.exampleZh: 这种罕见疾病影响神经系统，需要终身治疗。

entries.meaning: 伪装，掩饰；掩饰；伪装，假装
entries.example: The spy entered the party in disguise and avoided all cameras.
entries.exampleZh: 那名间谍伪装后进入聚会，避开了所有摄像头。

entries.meaning: 厌恶vi令人厌恶，作呕；厌恶，嫌恶
entries.example: His cruel remark filled the audience with disgust and disbelief.
entries.exampleZh: 他冷酷的言论让观众充满厌恶和难以置信。

entries.example: She placed the steaming dish of pasta in the middle of the table.
entries.exampleZh: 她把那盘热气腾腾的意大利面放在桌子中央。

entries.meaning: 使戒除(或放弃)习惯,使不习惯
entries.example: Therapists try to dishabituate patients from relying on constant reassurance.
entries.exampleZh: 治疗师试图使患者戒除依赖持续安慰的习惯。

entries.example: It was dishonest of him to hide the missing funds from us.
entries.exampleZh: 他向我们隐瞒丢失的资金是不诚实的。

entries.example: The scandal may disillusion many young voters who trusted the mayor.
entries.exampleZh: 这起丑闻可能使许多信任市长的年轻选民醒悟。

entries.meaning: 分裂成小片，瓦解；瓦解；碎裂
entries.example: The old paper began to disintegrate as soon as we touched it.
entries.exampleZh: 我们一碰，那张旧纸就开始碎裂。

entries.meaning: 无兴趣, 不关心；无兴趣，冷漠；客观，公正
entries.example: Her apparent disinterest in the offer surprised the negotiating team.
entries.exampleZh: 她对这一提议明显的漠不关心让谈判团队感到惊讶。

entries.meaning: 客观的，无私的，公正的；无兴趣的，不关心的
entries.example: A disinterested judge must review the evidence without favoring either side.
entries.exampleZh: 公正的法官必须在审查证据时不偏袒任何一方。

entries.example: He saved the report on a disk before the computer crashed.

entries.exampleZh: 早期农民经过许多代成功驯化了几种野生禾草。

entries.example: The domestication of horses transformed transport and warfare across ancient Eurasia.
entries.exampleZh: 马的驯化改变了古代欧亚大陆的交通和战争方式。

entries.example: The suspect listed a small coastal village as his permanent domicile.
entries.exampleZh: 嫌疑人将一个小海滨村庄列为其永久住所。

entries.example: The team's dominance in the league lasted for nearly a decade.
entries.exampleZh: 这支球队在联赛中的统治地位持续了将近十年。

entries.meaning: 有统治权的,占优势的；统治的，支配的，占优势的；有统治权的
entries.example: English remains the dominant language in international business and scientific publishing.
entries.exampleZh: 英语仍然是国际商业和科学出版中的主导语言。

entries.meaning: 支配,占优势；支配，统治；控制；盛行
entries.example: Large corporations dominate the global market for agricultural seeds and chemicals.
entries.exampleZh: 大型企业主导着全球农业种子和化学品市场。

entries.example: The Spanish don greeted his guests warmly at the ancient estate.
entries.exampleZh: 那位西班牙绅士在古老的庄园里热情地迎接客人。

entries.example: We decided to donate our old furniture to a local charity.
entries.exampleZh: 我们决定把旧家具捐给当地一家慈善机构。

entries.meaning: 捐赠品, 捐款, 贡献
entries.example: Her generous donation helped the shelter care for dozens of abandoned dogs.
entries.exampleZh: 她慷慨的捐款帮助收容所照顾了几十只被遗弃的狗。

entries.example: During the lecture, he began to doodle strange faces in his notebook.
entries.exampleZh: 讲座期间，他开始在笔记本上乱画奇怪的人脸。

entries.example: Poor planning may doom the project before it even begins.
entries.exampleZh: 糟糕的规划可能会在项目开始前就注定其失败。

entries.example: She closed the heavy wooden door and locked it carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 她关上了沉重的木门并小心地锁好。

entries.example: The brass doorknob felt cold beneath his trembling fingers.
entries.exampleZh: 黄铜门把手在他颤抖的手指下摸起来很凉。

entries.example: A tall figure appeared in the doorway, blocking the fading light.
entries.exampleZh: 一个高大的身影出现在门口，挡住了渐暗的光线。

entries.meaning: 休眠；休眠；催眠状态；隐匿
entries.example: Many seeds survive winter in a state of dormancy until spring warmth arrives.
entries.exampleZh: 许多种子在休眠状态下度过冬天，直到春天的温暖到来。

entries.meaning: 冬眠的；静止的；休眠的；隐匿的
entries.example: The volcano had remained dormant for centuries before its sudden eruption.
entries.exampleZh: 这座火山在突然喷发前已休眠了几个世纪。

entries.example: The university built a new dormitory for international students near the library.
entries.exampleZh: 大学在图书馆附近为国际学生建了一座新宿舍。

entries.meaning: 背的, 脊的；背部的，背脊的
entries.example: The shark's dorsal fin broke the surface just before it dived.
entries.exampleZh: 那条鲨鱼的背鳍在它潜下去之前刚划破水面。

entries.example: Doctors must adjust the dosage carefully for patients with damaged kidneys.
entries.exampleZh: 医生必须为肾脏受损的病人仔细调整剂量。

entries.example: Take one dose of this medicine after dinner, as your doctor advised.
entries.exampleZh: 照医生嘱咐，晚饭后服用一剂这种药。

entries.meaning: 点 vt打点于,点缀；星罗棋布于；打点于；点缀；点，圆点；小数点
entries.example: A tiny red dot marked the exact spot on the old map.
entries.exampleZh: 一个微小的红点标出了旧地图上的确切位置。

entries.example: Some grandparents dote on their grandchildren and spoil them shamelessly.
entries.exampleZh: 有些祖父母溺爱孙辈，毫无节制地宠着他们。

entries.example: The company plans to double its investment in renewable energy next year.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划明年将其在可再生能源上的投资增加一倍。

entries.example: There is little doubt that she will win the competition this time.
entries.exampleZh: 几乎毫无疑问，这次她会赢得比赛。

entries.meaning: 可疑的, 不确的, 疑心的
entries.example: The police remained doubtful about the witness's account of that night.
entries.exampleZh: 警方对那名目击者当晚的陈述仍持怀疑态度。

entries.example: She kneaded the dough for ten minutes before shaping it into rolls.
entries.exampleZh: 她把面团揉了十分钟，然后把它捏成小圆面包。

entries.example: Firefighters must douse the flames quickly before the wind spreads them.
entries.exampleZh: 消防员必须在大风使火势蔓延之前迅速扑灭火焰。

entries.example: After the summit, the cyclists raced downhill at a frightening speed.
entries.exampleZh: 到达山顶后，自行车手们以惊人的速度冲下山坡。

entries.meaning: 缺点，负面；底侧；下降趋势
entries.example: The main downside of this job is the long commute every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 这份工作的主要缺点是每天早上通勤时间很长。

entries.meaning: 在市区；市区的；在市中心；往市中心；市中心的
entries.example: We spent the afternoon exploring downtown before catching the evening train.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在赶晚班火车之前花了一下午逛市中心。

entries.example: The bird plunged downward and disappeared into the thick morning mist.
entries.exampleZh: 那只鸟向下猛冲，消失在浓密的晨雾中。

entries.meaning: 一打, 十二个；一打，十二个
entries.example: She bought a dozen eggs and some fresh bread at the market.
entries.exampleZh: 她在市场上买了一打鸡蛋和一些新鲜面包。

entries.example: The office walls were painted a drab grey that depressed everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 办公室的墙壁被刷成了沉闷的灰色，让每个人都感到压抑。

entries.meaning: 草稿；草拟；供役使的；草图，草稿；汇票；气流；起草；征募，选派
entries.example: I finished the first draft of my report before lunch today.
entries.exampleZh: 今天午饭前我完成了报告的初稿。

entries.meaning: 拖, 拖曳；拖动；缓慢而费力地移动；拖沓地进行，拖延；累赘，障碍；一吸，一抽，一饮
entries.example: We had to drag the heavy sofa up three flights of stairs.
entries.exampleZh: 我们不得不把沉重的沙发拖上三段楼梯。

entries.example: The old legend says a dragon guards the treasure beneath the mountain.
entries.exampleZh: 古老的传说说，一条龙守护着山下的宝藏。

entries.example: A bright blue dragonfly hovered above the pond before landing on a reed.
entries.exampleZh: 一只亮蓝色的蜻蜓在池塘上方盘旋，然后落在一根芦苇上。

entries.meaning: 排水,消耗；流走，流出；使耗尽；下水道，排水沟；排放；消耗
entries.example: The plumber cleared the drain so the sink would empty faster.
entries.exampleZh: 水管工清理了下水道，好让水槽排水更快。

entries.example: Poor drainage in the field caused water to gather after storms.
entries.exampleZh: 田里的排水系统很差，暴雨过后积水成片。

entries.example: A broken drainpipe sent rainwater down the side of the wall.
entries.exampleZh: 一根破裂的排水管让雨水顺着墙面流下来。

entries.example: A drake swam across the pond while the ducks watched quietly.
entries.exampleZh: 一只公鸭游过池塘，母鸭们安静地看着。

entries.meaning: 液量特兰(药衡系统中的容量单位), 少量
entries.example: The old recipe asks for a single dram of bitter medicine.
entries.exampleZh: 这个古老的配方要求加入一特兰的苦药。

entries.example: She studied drama for years before joining a small theatre group.
entries.exampleZh: 她学习戏剧多年，之后加入了一个小剧团。

entries.meaning: 戏剧性的,生动的；戏剧的；引人注目的；突然的，巨大的；戏剧性的
entries.example: The final scene of the play was far too dramatic for me.
entries.exampleZh: 这部戏的最后一幕对我来说太戏剧化了。

entries.example: Prices rose dramatically after the new tax was announced last week.
entries.exampleZh: 上周宣布新税后，价格大幅上涨。

entries.meaning: 编写剧本；改编成戏剧；戏剧化，戏剧性地表现
entries.example: The writer chose to dramatize the events of that difficult winter.
entries.exampleZh: 作家选择把那个艰难冬天的往事改编成戏剧。

entries.example: She pulled the heavy drape aside to let the sunlight in.
entries.exampleZh: 她把厚重的窗帘拉到一边，让阳光照进来。

entries.example: The shop sells fine drapery and cloth for making curtains.
entries.exampleZh: 这家店出售优质布匹和做窗帘的布料。

entries.meaning: 激烈的, 极端的；剧烈的，猛烈的，激烈的
entries.example: The company took drastic steps to cut costs during the crisis.
entries.exampleZh: 危机期间，公司采取了激烈的措施来削减成本。

entries.example: We must drastically reduce the amount of waste we produce.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须大幅减少我们制造的垃圾量。

entries.meaning: 画,拖,移动；吸引，招引；画，描绘；拖，拉；引起，激起；拨出，抽出；提取，支取；推断出；打成平局；平局，和局；抽签
entries.example: She likes to draw small animals in her notebook during breaks.
entries.exampleZh: 她喜欢在休息时在笔记本上画小动物。

entries.meaning: 缺点,障碍；缺点，障碍，不利条件；退款，退税
entries.example: The main drawback of this flat is its tiny kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 这套公寓的主要缺点是厨房太小。

entries.example: Her drawing of the old bridge won a prize at school.
entries.exampleZh: 她画的那座老桥在学校得了奖。

entries.meaning: 恐惧,可怕的人(或物)；惧怕；恐怖的
entries.example: Many students dread speaking in front of the whole class.
entries.exampleZh: 许多学生害怕在全班同学面前讲话。

entries.example: I often dream about flying over quiet mountains and rivers.
entries.exampleZh: 我常常梦见飞越宁静的山川。

entries.example: Workers dredge the harbour every spring to keep ships safe.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们每年春天疏浚港口，以保证船只安全。

entries.example: A sudden storm will drench anyone walking home without a coat.
entries.exampleZh: 突如其来的暴风雨会把任何没穿外套走回家的人淋透。

entries.example: She wore a simple black dress to the award ceremony.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿了一条简单的黑色连衣裙去参加颁奖典礼。

entries.meaning: 漂流；漂流，漂移；漂泊，游荡；漂流；漂泊；大意，主旨；倾向，趋势
entries.example: We watched the small boat drift slowly toward the far shore.
entries.exampleZh: 我们看着小船慢慢漂向远处的岸边。

entries.meaning: 钻子；练习,钻孔；钻，打眼；训练；钻；训练
entries.example: The teacher led a fire drill just before lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 老师就在午饭前组织了一次消防演练。

entries.example: He does not drink alcohol at any family gathering.
entries.exampleZh: 他在任何家庭聚会上都不喝酒。

entries.example: A slow drip from the tap kept me awake all night.
entries.exampleZh: 水龙头缓慢的滴答声让我整夜睡不着。

entries.example: Thick dripstone hung from the ceiling of the cave.
entries.exampleZh: 洞顶悬挂着厚厚的滴水石。

entries.example: The drive to the coast takes about three hours.
entries.exampleZh: 开车去海边大约需要三个小时。

entries.example: The driver stopped the bus beside the narrow bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 司机把公共汽车停在狭窄的桥边。

entries.example: Someone had parked a red car in our driveway.
entries.exampleZh: 有人把一辆红色轿车停在了我们的车道上。

entries.example: Prices may drop sharply after the holiday season ends.
entries.exampleZh: 假期结束后价格可能会急剧下降。

entries.example: A single droplet of rain fell on my hand.
entries.exampleZh: 一滴雨落在我的手上。

entries.example: Geologists found a large dropstone embedded in the sediment.
entries.exampleZh: 地质学家在沉积物中发现了一块巨大的滴石。

entries.example: The long drought ruined most of the crops this year.
entries.exampleZh: 漫长的干旱毁了今年的大部分庄稼。

entries.example: Careless swimmers can drown in these strong currents.
entries.exampleZh: 粗心的游泳者可能会在这些强劲的水流中溺死。

entries.example: The warm medicine made him drowsy within minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 那种温热的药几分钟就让他昏昏欲睡。

entries.example: The doctor prescribed a drug to lower her blood pressure.
entries.exampleZh: 医生开了一种药来降低她的血压。

entries.example: I bought some toothpaste at the corner drugstore.
entries.exampleZh: 我在街角的药房买了些牙膏。

entries.example: Someone played a drum during the whole street parade.
entries.exampleZh: 在整个街头游行中有人一直在敲鼓。

entries.example: Hang the wet towels outside until they dry completely.
entries.exampleZh: 把湿毛巾挂到外面，直到完全晾干。

entries.example: The dryness of the winter air cracked my lips.
entries.exampleZh: 冬季空气的干燥让我的嘴唇裂开了。

entries.meaning: 双的, 二重的；双的，二重的
entries.example: The committee proposed a dual strategy to address both cost and quality concerns.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会提出了一项双重策略，以同时应对成本和质量方面的担忧。

entries.meaning: 可疑的, 不确定的；怀疑的，拿不准的；可疑的，靠不住的
entries.example: Her explanation for the missing funds sounded dubious to the experienced auditor.
entries.exampleZh: 她对失踪资金给出的解释在经验丰富的审计员听来十分可疑。

entries.example: Researchers are seeking better treatments for duchenne, a severe muscle-wasting disease.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员正在寻找更好的方法来治疗杜氏营养不良症，这是一种严重的消耗肌肉的疾病。

entries.example: A wild duck landed quietly on the pond behind our garden.
entries.exampleZh: 一只野鸭悄然落在我们花园后面的池塘上。

entries.meaning: 管道, 导管；用导管输送
entries.example: The maintenance team cleaned the air duct before the summer heat arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 维修团队在夏季高温到来前清理了通风管道。

entries.meaning: 易延展的, 易教导的；有延性的，韧性的；易引导的，易受影响的
entries.example: Gold is so ductile that artisans can shape it into extremely thin sheets.
entries.exampleZh: 黄金延展性极好，工匠能把它加工成极薄的薄片。

entries.example: The surgeon removed a small ductless gland from the patient's neck.
entries.exampleZh: 外科医生从病人颈部取出了一个小的无导管腺体。

entries.meaning: 应有的；应得物；到期的；预期的；应得的；恰当的，适当的；应支付的
entries.example: The final payment is due at the end of this month.
entries.exampleZh: 最后一笔付款在本月底到期。

entries.example: The two sisters performed a lovely duet at the school concert.
entries.exampleZh: 两姐妹在学校的音乐会上表演了一首优美的二重奏。

entries.example: The soldiers waited inside a muddy dugout until the shelling stopped.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们在一个泥泞的防空洞里等待，直到炮击停止。

entries.example: The young duke inherited a vast estate in the north.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻的公爵继承了北方的一大片地产。

entries.example: She played a traditional tune on the dulcimer at the folk festival.
entries.exampleZh: 她在民间音乐节上用洋琴演奏了一首传统曲调。

entries.meaning: 乏味的；阴沉的；乏味的，单调的；迟钝的；无光泽的；萧条的；阴沉的，昏暗的
entries.example: The lecture was so dull that several students struggled to stay awake.
entries.exampleZh: 那场讲座如此乏味，以至于好几个学生都努力保持清醒。

entries.example: The accident left him dumb, unable to speak for several weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 那场事故使他失声，好几周都无法说话。

entries.meaning: 倾倒(垃圾), 倾卸；堆存处；丢弃，倾倒；抛弃；推卸；倾销；垃圾场
entries.example: Residents protested against plans to dump industrial waste near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 居民们反对在河流附近倾倒工业废物的计划。

entries.example: We climbed a steep sand dune to watch the sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 我们爬上一座陡峭的沙丘观看日落。

entries.example: The farmer spread dried dung across the field before planting.
entries.exampleZh: 农民在种植前把干粪撒在田里。

entries.example: Scammers often dupe elderly people into sharing their bank details.
entries.exampleZh: 骗子常常诱骗老年人分享他们的银行信息。

entries.meaning: 复制品 a复制的 vt复制，复印；完全相同的；副本的；复制品；副本；复写；复制；使加倍
entries.example: Please duplicate this key so that each family member has one.
entries.exampleZh: 请复制这把钥匙，以便每个家庭成员都有一把。

entries.example: The durability of these boots makes them worth the high price.
entries.exampleZh: 这些靴子的耐用性使它们值这个高价。

entries.meaning: 持久的,耐用的；持久的，耐用的
entries.example: This durable canvas bag has survived three years of daily use.
entries.exampleZh: 这个耐用的帆布包经受住了三年的日常使用。

entries.example: The duration of the flight depends on the weather over the mountains.
entries.exampleZh: 航班的持续时间取决于山区的天气。

entries.meaning: 尘土,粉末；除尘,撒(粉末等)
entries.example: A thick layer of dust covered the old piano in the corner.
entries.exampleZh: 一层厚厚的灰尘覆盖着角落里那架旧钢琴。

entries.meaning: 满是灰尘的, 粉状的
entries.example: The attic was dusty and full of forgotten boxes and old letters.
entries.exampleZh: 阁楼里满是灰尘，堆满了被遗忘的箱子和旧信件。

entries.example: She bought a Dutch bicycle while studying in Amsterdam last spring.
entries.exampleZh: 去年春天她在阿姆斯特丹学习时买了一辆荷兰自行车。

entries.example: A tall Dutchman offered to help us carry the heavy luggage.
entries.exampleZh: 一位高个子荷兰人主动提出帮我们搬沉重的行李。

entries.example: It is your duty to report any accident to the supervisor immediately.
entries.exampleZh: 你有责任立即向主管报告任何事故。

entries.meaning: 矮子, 侏儒；矮小的；使显得矮小，使相形见绌；侏儒，矮人
entries.example: In the fairy tale, a tiny dwarf guarded a chest of gold.
entries.exampleZh: 在童话里，一个小矮人守护着一箱黄金。

entries.example: Many rare birds dwell in the marshes along this protected coast.
entries.exampleZh: 许多珍稀鸟类栖息在这片受保护的海岸沿线的沼泽中。

entries.example: The city dweller often longs for the peace of the countryside.
entries.exampleZh: 城市居民常常渴望乡间的宁静。

entries.example: Their new dwelling sits on a hill above the fishing village.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的新住处坐落在渔村上方的山坡上。

entries.example: Without fresh funding, the number of volunteers will dwindle rapidly.
entries.exampleZh: 如果没有新的资金，志愿者的数量将迅速减少。

entries.example: Chemists write Dy for the element with atomic number sixty-six.
entries.exampleZh: 化学家把原子序数为六十六的元素写作镝的符号。

entries.meaning: 染料；给…染色；染色；颜料，染料
entries.example: She used berries to dye the wool a deep shade of red.
entries.exampleZh: 她用浆果把羊毛染成深红色。

entries.example: The factory imports natural dyestuff from plants grown in the tropics.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂从热带地区种植的植物中进口天然染料。

entries.example: The city has a dynamic economy driven by technology and young talent.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市拥有由科技和年轻人才驱动的充满活力的经济。

entries.meaning: 动态的；动力的；充满活力的
entries.example: His research focuses on dynamical systems and their long-term behavior.
entries.exampleZh: 他的研究聚焦于动力系统及其长期行为。

entries.example: The Ming dynasty ruled China for nearly three hundred years.
entries.exampleZh: 明朝统治中国近三百年。

entries.meaning: 热心于, 渴望着；渴望的，热切的
entries.example: The children were eager to open their presents on Christmas morning.
entries.exampleZh: 圣诞节早晨，孩子们急切地想打开礼物。

entries.example: She eagerly accepted the invitation to speak at the conference.
entries.exampleZh: 她热切地接受了在会议上发言的邀请。

entries.example: A golden eagle circled high above the valley before diving toward its prey.
entries.exampleZh: 一只金雕在山谷上空高高盘旋，随后朝猎物俯冲而下。

entries.example: The loud music left my right ear ringing well into the night.
entries.exampleZh: 那嘈杂的音乐让我的右耳一直响到深夜。

entries.example: She hopes to earn enough money this summer to travel across Europe.
entries.exampleZh: 她希望今年夏天能挣够钱去欧洲旅行。

entries.example: As the main earner in the family, he works long hours every day.
entries.exampleZh: 作为家里主要的挣钱者，他每天工作时间很长。

entries.meaning: 认真的；真诚的；诚挚；认真
entries.example: Her earnest manner convinced the panel that she truly cared about the job.
entries.exampleZh: 她诚挚的态度让评审小组相信她真心在意这份工作。

entries.example: The earnestness in his voice made everyone in the room fall silent.
entries.exampleZh: 他声音里的那份认真让屋里的每个人都安静了下来。

entries.example: His earning from the small shop barely covers the family's daily needs.
entries.exampleZh: 他开小店挣的钱勉强够一家人日常开销。

entries.example: The villagers stored grain in large earthen pots kept in the cellar.
entries.exampleZh: 村民们把粮食存放在地窖里的大陶罐中。

entries.example: She served the soup in a beautiful earthenware bowl from the market.
entries.exampleZh: 她用从市场买来的漂亮陶碗盛汤。

entries.meaning: 地震, [喻]在震荡, 在变动
entries.example: A powerful earthquake struck the coastal town at dawn, destroying many homes.
entries.exampleZh: 一场强烈的地震在黎明时分袭击了这座沿海小镇，摧毁了许多房屋。

entries.example: The falling leaves drifted earthward slowly in the cool autumn breeze.
entries.exampleZh: 落叶在凉爽的秋风中缓缓飘向地面。

entries.example: After the rain, a long earthworm crawled across the wet garden path.
entries.exampleZh: 雨后，一条长长的蚯蚓爬过湿漉漉的花园小路。

entries.meaning: 安逸；缓和，减轻；不费力，容易；悠闲，自在
entries.example: She solved the difficult puzzle with surprising ease and quiet confidence.
entries.exampleZh: 她以令人惊讶的轻松和沉静的信心解开了那道难题。

entries.example: He easily finished the marathon despite the heat and the steep hills.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管天气炎热、坡道陡峭，他还是轻松跑完了马拉松。

entries.meaning: 东(方，部)a东方(部)的；向东方
entries.example: The sun rises in the east and sets behind those distant mountains.
entries.exampleZh: 太阳从东边升起，落在那片远山之后。

entries.example: Many families gather for a special meal on Easter Sunday each spring.
entries.exampleZh: 每年春天，许多家庭都会在复活节星期日聚餐。

entries.example: A cold wind blew in from the eastern side of the valley.
entries.exampleZh: 一股冷风从山谷东侧吹来。

entries.example: The birds flew eastward as the autumn light began to fade.
entries.exampleZh: 秋日的光线开始消退时，鸟儿们向东飞去。

entries.example: The instructions were easy to follow, even for a complete beginner.
entries.exampleZh: 这些说明很容易照做，即使对完全的新手来说也是如此。

entries.example: We usually eat dinner together as a family around seven o'clock.
entries.exampleZh: 我们一家人通常七点左右一起吃晚饭。

entries.meaning: 古怪的；怪人；古怪的，反常的；古怪的人
entries.example: Our neighbour is an eccentric who collects broken clocks and old maps.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的邻居是个怪人，收集破钟和旧地图。

entries.example: Her eccentricity sometimes shocks colleagues, yet it makes her designs unforgettable.
entries.exampleZh: 她的怪癖有时让同事震惊，却让她的设计令人难忘。

entries.example: His eclectic taste in music ranges from jazz to traditional folk songs.
entries.exampleZh: 他在音乐上的折衷品味涵盖爵士到传统民歌。

entries.example: The gallery's eclecticism reflects a bold mixing of styles and periods.
entries.exampleZh: 这家画廊的折中主义体现了对风格与时期的大胆混合。

entries.meaning: (日、月)食 vt形成(日、月)食；遮住光；使相形见绌；日食，月食
entries.example: A total eclipse will draw thousands of visitors to the coastal town.
entries.exampleZh: 一次全食将吸引数千名游客来到这座海滨小镇。

entries.example: The new dam could cause serious ecological damage to nearby wetlands.
entries.exampleZh: 新水坝可能对附近湿地造成严重的生态破坏。

entries.example: An ecologist warned that the river's fish population is declining rapidly.
entries.exampleZh: 一位生态学家警告说，这条河的鱼类数量正在迅速下降。

entries.meaning: 生态学；生态；生态学；生态环境
entries.example: She studies ecology because she wants to protect mountain forests.
entries.exampleZh: 她研究生态学，因为她想保护山林。

entries.meaning: 经济的；经济上的；经济学的；合算的
entries.example: The country faces serious economic problems after years of poor leadership.
entries.exampleZh: 该国在多年领导不力后面临严重的经济问题。

entries.meaning: 经济的，实惠的；节俭的，节约的；精打细算的
entries.example: This small car is economical and easy to park downtown.
entries.exampleZh: 这辆小车很省油，而且在市中心容易停车。

entries.example: The economist predicted slower growth but no immediate recession this year.
entries.exampleZh: 这位经济学家预测今年增长会放缓，但不会立即衰退。

entries.example: We must economize on fuel during the long winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 在漫长的冬季里，我们必须节省燃料。

entries.example: Pollution threatens the fragile ecosystem of the coral reef.
entries.exampleZh: 污染威胁着珊瑚礁脆弱的生态系统。

entries.example: A lizard is an ectotherm that relies on sunlight to warm itself.
entries.exampleZh: 蜥蜴是一种变温动物，依靠阳光来取暖。

entries.example: Most reptiles are ectothermic, so they seek shade when the desert is hot.
entries.exampleZh: 大多数爬行动物是变温的，所以沙漠炎热时它们会寻找阴凉处。

entries.example: A small eddy formed near the rocks where the river slowed.
entries.exampleZh: 河水变缓的岩石附近形成了一个小漩涡。

entries.meaning: 边(缘)；侧着移动,徐徐移动；徐徐移动；略为增加；给…加边；边，边缘；刀口，刃；优势
entries.example: She stood at the edge of the cliff and watched the sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 她站在悬崖边看日落。

entries.example: Not all wild mushrooms are edible, so please avoid picking unknown ones.
entries.exampleZh: 并非所有野生蘑菇都可食用，所以请不要采摘不认识的。

entries.meaning: 大厦, 大建筑物；大厦，宏伟的建筑物
entries.example: The ancient edifice dominates the square with its tall stone columns.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古老的宏伟建筑以高大的石柱俯视着广场。

entries.example: Please edit the report before sending it to the director.
entries.exampleZh: 请在把报告发给主任之前编辑一下。

entries.example: The first edition of her novel sold out within a week.
entries.exampleZh: 她这部小说的第一版一周之内就卖光了。

entries.example: The editor asked me to shorten the article by two pages.
entries.exampleZh: 编辑要求我把这篇文章缩短两页。

entries.meaning: 社论的；编辑的；社论，重要评论
entries.example: The newspaper published a sharp editorial about the new tax policy.
entries.exampleZh: 这家报纸就新税收政策发表了一篇措辞尖锐的社论。

entries.meaning: 可教育的, 可培养的
entries.example: Not every child is equally educable in a large classroom setting.
entries.exampleZh: 在大班课堂上，并非每个孩子都具有同样的可教性。

entries.example: Schools should educate students to think critically rather than memorize facts.
entries.exampleZh: 学校应当教育学生批判性地思考，而不是死记事实。

entries.example: She is a highly educated woman who speaks four languages fluently.
entries.exampleZh: 她是一位受过良好教育的女性，能流利地说四种语言。

entries.example: Access to quality education remains unequal in many rural areas.
entries.exampleZh: 在许多农村地区，获得优质教育的机会仍不平等。

entries.example: The museum offers educational programs for children of all ages.
entries.exampleZh: 这家博物馆为各年龄段的儿童提供教育项目。

entries.meaning: 教育的, 有关教育的
entries.example: The two schools are educationally quite different despite similar funding.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管经费相近，这两所学校在教育上却大不相同。

entries.example: A good educator inspires curiosity rather than simply demanding correct answers.
entries.exampleZh: 优秀的教育者激发好奇心，而不只是要求正确答案。

entries.example: A slippery eel escaped from the bucket and slid into the river.
entries.exampleZh: 一条滑溜的鳗鱼从桶里逃出，滑进了河里。

entries.meaning: 有效的，生效的；显著的；实际的，事实上的
entries.example: This cream is highly effective against mosquito bites and sunburn.
entries.exampleZh: 这种药膏对蚊虫叮咬和晒伤非常有效。

entries.example: She managed the project effectively despite a very limited budget.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管预算十分有限，她还是有效地管理了这个项目。

entries.example: Researchers question the effectiveness of this drug on young patients.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员质疑这种药对年轻患者的效力。

entries.example: The herbal remedy proved surprisingly efficacious against the stubborn infection.
entries.exampleZh: 这种草药疗法对这种顽固感染竟出奇地有效。

entries.example: Several trials confirmed the efficacy of the new vaccine.
entries.exampleZh: 多项试验证实了这种新疫苗的功效。

entries.meaning: 效率, 功效；效率，功效
entries.example: New software greatly improved the efficiency of our daily workflow.
entries.exampleZh: 新软件大大提高了我们日常工作流程的效率。

entries.meaning: 效率高的,有能力的；有效的，有效率的；有能力的，能胜任的
entries.example: The new heating system is far more efficient than the old one.
entries.exampleZh: 新的供暖系统比旧的效率高得多。

entries.example: The staff handled the sudden rush of customers efficiently and calmly.
entries.exampleZh: 员工们高效而沉着地应对了突然涌来的顾客。

entries.example: The factory was fined for dumping untreated effluent into the river.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂因向河中排放未经处理的废水而被罚款。

entries.example: Her constant effort finally convinced the committee to approve the plan.
entries.exampleZh: 她不懈的努力最终说服了委员会批准这项计划。

entries.meaning: 毫不费力地, 轻易地
entries.example: She solved the difficult puzzle effortlessly, surprising everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 她毫不费力地解开了那道难题，让房间里的每个人都很惊讶。

entries.example: The village slowly developed an egalitarian system for sharing water.
entries.exampleZh: 这个村庄慢慢形成了一套平等主义的用水分配制度。

entries.example: He cracked a single egg into the heated pan.
entries.exampleZh: 他把一个鸡蛋磕进加热的平底锅里。

entries.example: Tiny fragments of eggshell floated on the surface of the bowl.
entries.exampleZh: 细小的蛋壳碎片漂浮在碗的表面上。

entries.example: My cousin spent three weeks travelling across Egypt last summer.
entries.exampleZh: 我表弟去年夏天花了三周时间游历埃及。

entries.example: An Egyptian guide showed us the oldest pyramids in the desert.
entries.exampleZh: 一位埃及向导带我们看了沙漠中最古老的金字塔。

entries.example: Only eight students signed up for the advanced chemistry course.
entries.exampleZh: 只有八名学生报名了高级化学课程。

entries.example: She turned eighteen just before moving to another city.
entries.exampleZh: 她刚满十八岁就搬到了另一座城市。

entries.example: His eighteenth birthday party was held in a small garden.
entries.exampleZh: 他的十八岁生日聚会在一座小花园里举行。

entries.example: Nearly eighty guests arrived before the ceremony officially began.
entries.exampleZh: 将近八十位客人在仪式正式开始前就到了。

entries.example: Ancient farmers cultivated einkorn long before modern wheat appeared.
entries.exampleZh: 古代农民在现代小麦出现之前很久就种植单粒小麦。

entries.example: Either route will take you to the station in ten minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 两条路线中的任意一条都能让你在十分钟内到达车站。

entries.meaning: 逐出,喷射；逐出，驱赶；喷出，喷射；弹出
entries.example: The machine will eject the disc automatically after the film ends.
entries.exampleZh: 电影结束后，机器会自动弹出光盘。

entries.example: Chemists once used the prefix eka to name undiscovered elements.
entries.exampleZh: 化学家们曾用前缀“埃卡”来命名尚未被发现的元素。

entries.example: The family had to eke out a living from poor soil.
entries.exampleZh: 这家人不得不靠贫瘠的土地勉强维持生计。

entries.meaning: 详尽的,复杂的；详述；精心制作的，复杂精美的；详述；详细制订，精心制作
entries.example: Could you elaborate on your proposal before we vote?
entries.exampleZh: 在我们投票之前，你能详细说明一下你的提案吗？

entries.meaning: 苦心经营, 详尽的细节
entries.example: The report offers a detailed elaboration of the new policy.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告对新政策作了详尽的阐述。

entries.example: A full year must elapse before the results are published.
entries.exampleZh: 必须经过整整一年，结果才会公布。

entries.example: The rubber band's elasticity decreased after months of constant use.
entries.exampleZh: 橡皮筋的弹性在数月频繁使用之后下降了。

entries.example: The village elder shared stories with the children every evening.
entries.exampleZh: 村里的长者每天晚上都给孩子们讲故事。

entries.example: Voters will elect a new mayor next spring.
entries.exampleZh: 选民们将在明年春天选出新市长。

entries.example: The election results surprised everyone in the small town.
entries.exampleZh: 选举结果让小镇上的每个人都感到惊讶。

entries.meaning: 选举的,随意选择的；选举的；可选择的；选修的
entries.example: Students may choose an elective course in their final year.
entries.exampleZh: 学生可以在最后一年选择一门选修课。

entries.example: He bought an electric car to reduce his fuel costs.
entries.exampleZh: 他买了一辆电动汽车以减少燃料费用。

entries.example: A qualified technician fixed the electrical fault in our kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 一位合格的技术人员修好了我们厨房里的电路故障。

entries.example: The entire building is electrically heated during the cold months.
entries.exampleZh: 整栋楼在寒冷的月份里都用电取暖。

entries.example: The electrician repaired the broken wiring behind the wall.
entries.exampleZh: 电工修好了墙后那根破损的电线。

entries.example: Solar panels now provide electricity for the entire village.
entries.exampleZh: 太阳能板现在为整个村庄提供电力。

entries.example: The new railway will electrify the remote mountain route.
entries.exampleZh: 这条新铁路将使这条偏远山区的路线电气化。

entries.example: The old printing shop kept every electro in wooden drawers.
entries.exampleZh: 那家老印刷店把每一块电版都存放在木抽屉里。

entries.example: The doctor studied the electrocardiogram carefully before making a diagnosis.
entries.exampleZh: 医生在做出诊断前仔细研究了这张心电图。

entries.example: He replaced the worn electrode inside the welding machine.
entries.exampleZh: 他更换了焊机里那个磨损的电极。

entries.example: The technician recorded an electroencephalogram to examine his brain activity.
entries.exampleZh: 技术人员记录了一份脑电图来检查他的大脑活动。

entries.example: Chemists use electrolysis to separate certain metals from their ores.
entries.exampleZh: 化学家利用电解法从矿石中分离某些金属。

entries.example: The device generates a strong electromagnetic field around the coil.
entries.exampleZh: 该装置在线圈周围产生强大的电磁场。

entries.example: Each electron carries a negative charge in an atom.
entries.exampleZh: 每个电子在原子中都带有一个负电荷。

entries.example: Most electronic devices require a steady power supply.
entries.exampleZh: 大多数电子设备都需要稳定的电源。

entries.meaning: 电子地, 通过电子手段
entries.example: All the documents were signed electronically before noon.
entries.exampleZh: 所有文件都在中午前以电子方式签署了。

entries.example: Her quiet elegance impressed everyone at the formal dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 她在正式晚宴上那种安静的优雅给每个人留下了深刻印象。

entries.meaning: 优雅的, 雅致的；优美的，高雅的；雅致的，精美的；简练的，简洁的
entries.example: She wore an elegant black dress to the ceremony last night.
entries.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条优雅的黑色连衣裙去参加典礼。

entries.example: Trust is a key element of any successful partnership.
entries.exampleZh: 信任是任何成功合作关系的关键要素。

entries.example: The storm released elemental forces that no one could control.
entries.exampleZh: 那场风暴释放了无人能控制的原始自然力量。

entries.meaning: 初级的，基础的；基本的；简单的
entries.example: Children learn elementary mathematics before they study more complex topics.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在学习更复杂的主题之前先学习基础数学。

entries.example: The elephant drank water from the river with its long trunk.
entries.exampleZh: 那头大象用长鼻子在河里喝水。

entries.example: The village lost eletricity during the severe storm last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨夜那场猛烈风暴期间，村庄停电了。

entries.meaning: 举起, 提升的职位；举起，抬高；提升职位；使情绪高昂，使兴高采烈
entries.example: Regular exercise can elevate your mood and improve your overall health.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼可以提升你的情绪并改善整体健康。

entries.example: The sudden elevation of his position surprised all his colleagues.
entries.exampleZh: 他职位的突然提升让所有同事都很惊讶。

entries.example: We took the elevator to the tenth floor of the building.
entries.exampleZh: 我们乘电梯到了大楼的十层。

entries.example: The meeting will begin at eleven in the morning tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 会议将于明天上午十一点开始。

entries.meaning: 得出, 引出, 抽出, 引起；得出，引出；诱出
entries.example: The teacher asked a question to elicit a thoughtful response from us.
entries.exampleZh: 老师问了一个问题，想从我们这里引出一个深思熟虑的回答。

entries.meaning: 有资格的, 合适的；符合条件的，合格的；适合的
entries.example: Only students with valid passes are eligible to enter the lab.
entries.exampleZh: 只有持有有效通行证的学生才有资格进入实验室。

entries.example: The new policy aims to eliminate waste across all departments.
entries.exampleZh: 新政策旨在消除所有部门的浪费。

entries.example: The elimination of unnecessary steps made the process much faster.
entries.exampleZh: 消除不必要的步骤使流程快了很多。

entries.meaning: 精英,精华；卓越的，精锐的；精英
entries.example: The elite athletes trained daily for the international competition.
entries.exampleZh: 这些精英运动员每天为国际比赛训练。

entries.meaning: 炼金药, 不老长寿药
entries.example: The old story describes a magic elixir that grants eternal youth.
entries.exampleZh: 那个古老的故事描述了一种能赐予永恒青春的神奇药剂。

entries.example: We saw a large elk near the frozen lake at dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 黎明时分，我们在结冰的湖边看到一头大麋鹿。

entries.example: Elliot brought his guitar to the party and played several songs.
entries.exampleZh: 埃利奥特带着他的吉他来参加聚会，并弹了好几首歌。

entries.example: The planet moves along an ellipse around the distant star.
entries.exampleZh: 这颗行星沿着椭圆轨道围绕那颗遥远的恒星运行。

entries.meaning: 椭圆的,省略的；椭圆的；隐晦的；省略的，简略的
entries.example: The comet follows an elliptical path through our solar system.
entries.exampleZh: 这颗彗星沿着一条椭圆路径穿过我们的太阳系。

entries.example: A tall elm once shaded the entire village square from the summer sun.
entries.exampleZh: 一棵高大的榆树曾经为整个村庄广场遮挡夏日的阳光。

entries.meaning: 拉长, (使)伸长；伸长的；延长，伸长
entries.example: Designers often elongate the room visually by placing mirrors along the back wall.
entries.exampleZh: 设计师通常会在后墙安装镜子，从视觉上拉长房间。

entries.meaning: 雄辩的, 有口才的；雄辩的；动人的
entries.example: Her eloquent speech moved even the most skeptical members of the audience.
entries.exampleZh: 她雄辩的演讲甚至打动了观众中最持怀疑态度的人。

entries.example: He eloquently defended the proposal despite tough questions from the committee.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管委员会提出了尖锐的问题，他仍雄辩地为该提案辩护。

entries.example: Nothing else could explain why the machine stopped so abruptly.
entries.exampleZh: 没有别的什么能解释机器为何突然停止。

entries.example: If this office is closed, please look for assistance elsewhere in the building.
entries.exampleZh: 如果这间办公室关闭了，请到大楼里的其他地方寻求帮助。

entries.meaning: 难懂的, 难捉摸的；难以理解的，难懂的；难捕捉的；逃避的
entries.example: The exact cause of the illness remains elusive despite years of careful research.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管经过多年仔细研究，这种疾病的确切病因仍然难以捉摸。

entries.meaning: 散发,发出；散发；表现，显示
entries.example: A strange warmth seemed to emanate from the ancient stone in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 一股奇怪的暖意似乎从花园里的古老石头中散发出来。

entries.meaning: 释放, 解放；解放，解除
entries.example: The new law aims to emancipate workers from unfair contracts imposed by powerful employers.
entries.exampleZh: 新法律旨在将工人从强势雇主强加的不公平合同中解放出来。

entries.example: The government imposed a strict embargo on weapons exports to the troubled region.
entries.exampleZh: 政府对向动荡地区出口武器实施了严格禁运。

entries.example: Passengers must embark before sunset or the ship will leave without them.
entries.exampleZh: 乘客必须在日落前登船，否则船会不等他们开走。

entries.meaning: 使困窘, 使局促不安；使尴尬，使困窘；使困惑
entries.example: I did not mean to embarrass you in front of your colleagues.
entries.exampleZh: 我不是有意在你同事面前让你难堪。

entries.meaning: 使插入, 嵌入；把…嵌入；使深留脑中
entries.example: The editor chose to embed the video directly into the online article.
entries.exampleZh: 编辑选择将视频直接嵌入在线文章中。

entries.meaning: 修饰；装饰；对…添枝加叶，渲染
entries.example: Witnesses sometimes embellish their stories to make them more dramatic.
entries.exampleZh: 目击者有时会渲染自己的叙述，使其更具戏剧性。

entries.example: A single ember glowed in the fireplace long after midnight.
entries.exampleZh: 午夜过后很久，壁炉里还有一块余烬在发光。

entries.meaning: 象征, 徽章；用象征表示；徽章；标记，象征
entries.example: The dove serves as a powerful emblem of peace around the world.
entries.exampleZh: 鸽子在世界各地都是和平的有力象征。

entries.meaning: 使具体化；表达，体现；含有
entries.example: These principles embody the values our community has defended for generations.
entries.exampleZh: 这些原则体现了我们社区几代人一直捍卫的价值观。

entries.example: Doctors warned that long flights could increase the risk of an embolism.
entries.exampleZh: 医生警告说，长途飞行可能增加栓塞的风险。

entries.meaning: 饰以浮饰, 使浮雕出来
entries.example: The invitation card will emboss the couple's names in elegant gold letters.
entries.exampleZh: 邀请卡将用优雅的金色字母凸印这对夫妇的名字。

entries.meaning: 拥抱；拥抱；包含；欣然接受
entries.example: Her warm embrace immediately made the frightened child feel safe again.
entries.exampleZh: 她温暖的拥抱立刻让受惊的孩子再次感到安全。

entries.example: She spent the evening teaching her niece how to embroider flowers on linen.
entries.exampleZh: 她花了一整晚教侄女如何在亚麻布上绣花。

entries.example: Traditional embroidery from this region is famous for its delicate floral patterns.
entries.exampleZh: 这个地区的传统刺绣以精致的花卉图案而闻名。

entries.example: The embryo develops rapidly during the first few weeks of pregnancy.
entries.exampleZh: 胚胎在怀孕的最初几周内迅速发育。

entries.example: Their plan is still at an embryonic stage and needs much more work.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的计划仍处于萌芽阶段，需要做的还很多。

entries.example: A large emerald glittered in the center of the antique silver ring.
entries.exampleZh: 一枚硕大的祖母绿在古董银戒指中央闪闪发光。

entries.meaning: 浮现,显露；显露，暴露；出来，现出
entries.example: The sun began to emerge from behind the heavy clouds after the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，太阳开始从厚厚的云层后面露出来。

entries.example: The emergence of new technologies has changed how we communicate daily.
entries.exampleZh: 新技术的出现改变了我们日常交流的方式。

entries.meaning: 紧急情况, 突然事件
entries.example: In an emergency, stay calm and call the number on the wall.
entries.exampleZh: 遇到紧急情况时，要保持冷静并拨打墙上的号码。

entries.meaning: 紧急的；突现的；新兴的；紧急的
entries.example: Emergent industries often attract young workers eager for new opportunities.
entries.exampleZh: 新兴行业常常吸引渴望新机会的年轻工人。

entries.example: The emigrant left his village with only a small suitcase and hope.
entries.exampleZh: 这名移民只带着一个小手提箱和希望离开了村庄。

entries.meaning: 移居, 移民；移民，移居国外
entries.example: Many families chose to emigrate in search of better jobs and schools.
entries.exampleZh: 许多家庭为寻找更好的工作和学校而选择移居国外。

entries.example: Emigration from rural areas has slowed considerably over the past decade.
entries.exampleZh: 在过去十年里，农村地区的向外移民明显放缓。

entries.example: The surgeon achieved worldwide eminence for her pioneering heart operations.
entries.exampleZh: 这位外科医生因其开创性的心脏手术而在世界范围内享有盛名。

entries.meaning: 著名的, 卓越的；显著的，杰出的
entries.example: An eminent scholar will give a lecture on ancient trade routes.
entries.exampleZh: 一位著名学者将就古代贸易路线作一场讲座。

entries.meaning: 散发,发行,排放；散发物，排放物；发射，排放
entries.example: Strict rules now limit the emission of harmful gases from factories.
entries.exampleZh: 严格的规定如今限制了工厂有害气体的排放。

entries.meaning: 发出,放射；发出；放射；排放
entries.example: Some old heaters emit dangerous fumes when they are used indoors.
entries.exampleZh: 一些旧取暖器在室内使用时释放出危险的气体。

entries.example: She spoke about her childhood with deep emotion in her voice.
entries.exampleZh: 她用饱含深情的声音谈起自己的童年。

entries.meaning: 感情的，情绪的；引起情感的；易动感情的
entries.example: His emotional speech moved many people in the audience to tears.
entries.exampleZh: 他充满感情的演讲让许多观众感动得落泪。

entries.example: She was emotionally exhausted after weeks of caring for her father.
entries.exampleZh: 照顾父亲数周之后，她在情感上已疲惫不堪。

entries.meaning: 感情的, 引起强烈感情的
entries.example: For many displaced people, the term homeland is deeply emotive.
entries.exampleZh: 对许多流离失所的人来说，家园这个词极易引起强烈的情感。

entries.example: Her calm empathy helped the frightened child feel safe during the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 她平静的共情让受惊的孩子在暴风雨中感到安全。

entries.example: The young emperor ordered a new palace to be built near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 年轻的皇帝下令在河边建造一座新宫殿。

entries.example: The teacher placed great emphasis on clear pronunciation during every speaking lesson.
entries.exampleZh: 老师在每堂口语课上都非常强调清晰的发音。

entries.example: Managers often emphasize the importance of teamwork during busy periods.
entries.exampleZh: 管理者在繁忙时期常常强调团队合作的重要性。

entries.example: The ancient empire collapsed after years of war and poor leadership.
entries.exampleZh: 这个古老的帝国在多年战争和糟糕的领导之后崩溃了。

entries.example: The study offers empirical evidence that regular exercise improves mental health.
entries.exampleZh: 该研究提供了经验性证据，表明规律运动能改善心理健康。

entries.example: His approach to science relies on empiricism rather than pure theory.
entries.exampleZh: 他的科学方法依赖经验主义而非纯理论。

entries.meaning: 雇用；用，使用；雇用；受雇，雇用
entries.example: Many small firms employ local students during the summer holidays.
entries.exampleZh: 许多小公司在暑假期间雇用当地学生。

entries.example: Every new employee receives a handbook explaining the company's safety rules.
entries.exampleZh: 每位新员工都会收到一本说明公司安全规则的手册。

entries.example: Her search for stable employment lasted almost a full year.
entries.exampleZh: 她寻找稳定工作的过程持续了将近整整一年。

entries.example: Good leaders empower their teams to make important decisions independently.
entries.exampleZh: 优秀的领导者会授权团队独立做出重要决定。

entries.meaning: 皇后, 女皇帝, 皇太后, 极有权力的女人；女皇，皇后
entries.example: The empress greeted foreign visitors in the palace's grand hall.
entries.exampleZh: 皇后在宫殿的大厅里迎接外国来访者。

entries.example: Please empty the rubbish bin before the cleaners arrive tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 请在清洁工明天早上到来之前清空垃圾桶。

entries.example: The chef whisked oil into vinegar to create a stable emulsion.
entries.exampleZh: 厨师把油搅入醋中，制成稳定的乳状液。

entries.example: Regular practice will enable you to speak with greater confidence.
entries.exampleZh: 经常练习将使你能够更自信地说话。

entries.example: Parliament plans to enact stricter laws against online fraud.
entries.exampleZh: 议会计划颁布更严格的法律来打击网络诈骗。

entries.meaning: 设定,制定；制订，颁布；法律，法规
entries.example: The enactment of the new tax law surprised many small business owners.
entries.exampleZh: 新税法的颁布让许多小企业主感到意外。

entries.example: The antique bowl has a bright blue enamel finish.
entries.exampleZh: 这只古董碗有一层亮蓝色的珐琅饰面。

entries.example: These two sentences neatly encapsulate the main argument of the essay.
entries.exampleZh: 这两句话巧妙地概括了这篇文章的主要论点。

entries.example: Workers will encase the cables in thick plastic before burying them.
entries.exampleZh: 工人会在埋设电缆之前把它们包在厚塑料里。

entries.example: Thick stone walls encircle the old town and protect it from strong winds.
entries.exampleZh: 厚厚的石墙环绕着老城，保护它免受强风侵袭。

entries.meaning: 放入封套,围绕；围住；把…装入
entries.example: Please enclose a copy of your passport with the signed application form.
entries.exampleZh: 请将护照复印件连同已签署的申请表一起放入信封。

entries.example: The sheep huddled inside a wooden enclosure during the sudden storm.
entries.exampleZh: 突然的暴风雨来临时，羊群挤在一个木制围栏里。

entries.example: Software can encode your private messages before they travel across the internet.
entries.exampleZh: 软件可以在你的私人信息经由互联网传输之前对其进行编码。

entries.example: The new park will encompass a lake, a playground, and several walking trails.
entries.exampleZh: 新公园将包括一个湖、一个游乐场和几条步道。

entries.meaning: 遭遇,遇到；偶然碰到；遭遇
entries.example: We had a brief encounter with a deer while hiking in the forest.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在森林徒步时与一只鹿有过短暂的相遇。

entries.meaning: 鼓励,促进,支持；鼓励，激励；促进，激发
entries.example: Teachers should encourage students to ask questions and explore their own ideas.
entries.exampleZh: 老师应鼓励学生提问并探索自己的想法。

entries.example: Her constant encouragement gave me the confidence to finish the difficult project.
entries.exampleZh: 她不断的鼓励给了我完成这个艰难项目的信心。

entries.meaning: 侵占,侵犯；侵占；侵蚀，蚕食
entries.example: New buildings should never encroach on protected wetlands or public parks.
entries.exampleZh: 新建筑绝不应侵占受保护的湿地或公共公园。

entries.example: The farmers protested against the gradual encroachment on their traditional grazing land.
entries.exampleZh: 农民们抗议对他们传统放牧地的逐步侵占。

entries.meaning: 在表面形成硬壳，结壳；用…装饰外层
entries.example: Years of salt water will encrust the metal pipes with a white layer.
entries.exampleZh: 多年的海水会在金属管道上结出一层白色的硬壳。

entries.example: She checked the encyclopedia to learn more about ancient Egyptian burial customs.
entries.exampleZh: 她查阅百科全书以了解更多关于古埃及丧葬习俗的知识。

entries.example: Careless disposal of plastic waste can endanger wildlife in rivers and oceans.
entries.exampleZh: 随意丢弃塑料垃圾会危及河流和海洋中的野生动物。

entries.example: The organization works to protect endangered tigers from illegal hunting and habitat loss.
entries.exampleZh: 该组织致力于保护濒危老虎免受非法狩猎和栖息地丧失的威胁。

entries.example: Her warm smile and kind words quickly endear her to every new colleague.
entries.exampleZh: 她温暖的笑容和亲切的话语很快让她赢得每位新同事的喜爱。

entries.meaning: 尽力, 努力；努力，尽力
entries.example: Despite many setbacks, their scientific endeavor eventually produced remarkable and useful results.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管遇到许多挫折，他们的科学努力最终产生了显著而有益的成果。

entries.example: The film's happy ending surprised viewers who expected a tragic conclusion.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影的快乐结局让原以为会以悲剧收场的观众感到意外。

entries.meaning: 无止境的,无穷的；无止境的，无穷尽的
entries.example: The endless traffic made our journey to the airport feel extremely long.
entries.exampleZh: 没完没了的交通让我们的机场之行感觉极其漫长。

entries.example: The doctor specializes in endocrine disorders that affect hormone production and metabolism.
entries.exampleZh: 这位医生专攻影响激素分泌和代谢的内分泌疾病。

entries.example: She studied endocrinology to understand how hormones influence human growth and mood.
entries.exampleZh: 她学习内分泌学，以了解激素如何影响人体生长和情绪。

entries.example: Economists still debate whether technological progress is endogenous to the market system.
entries.exampleZh: 经济学家们仍在争论技术进步对市场体系而言是否是内生的。

entries.meaning: 签名；宣传，代言；签署；赞同，支持
entries.example: Several famous athletes agreed to endorse the new sports drink on television.
entries.exampleZh: 几位著名运动员同意在电视上为这款新运动饮料代言。

entries.meaning: 温血动物, 恒温动物
entries.example: Unlike lizards, endotherms generate their own body heat even in cold weather.
entries.exampleZh: 与蜥蜴不同，恒温动物即使在寒冷天气里也能自行产生体热。

entries.meaning: 捐赠, 赋予；使天生具有，赋予；资助，捐赠
entries.example: A wealthy alumnus decided to endow two scholarships at the small college.
entries.exampleZh: 一位富有的校友决定为这所小型学院捐赠两项奖学金。

entries.example: The university used its largest endowment to fund research on climate change.
entries.exampleZh: 这所大学动用其最大的捐赠基金来资助气候变化研究。

entries.example: Please check the endpoint of the cable before connecting it to the router.
entries.exampleZh: 请先检查电缆的端点，然后再把它接到路由器上。

entries.example: Marathon runners need remarkable endurance to finish the race in summer heat.
entries.exampleZh: 马拉松选手需要非凡的耐力才能在夏日酷热中跑完全程。

entries.meaning: 耐久,忍耐；忍受，忍耐；持久，持续
entries.example: The villagers had to endure freezing nights without electricity for almost a week.
entries.exampleZh: 村民们不得不忍受将近一周没有电的严寒夜晚。

entries.example: He treated every critic as a personal enemy rather than a helpful adviser.
entries.exampleZh: 他把每个批评者都当作私敌，而不是有益的顾问。

entries.meaning: 精力充沛的,积极的；精力充沛的，积极的
entries.example: The children seemed unusually energetic after eating cake at the party.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在聚会上吃完蛋糕后显得异常精力充沛。

entries.meaning: 实施, 执行,加强；实施，生效，执行；强迫，迫使
entries.example: Local police rarely enforce the old rule about parking on this street.
entries.exampleZh: 当地警察很少执行这条关于在这条街上停车的旧规定。

entries.example: The referee acted as a strict enforcer of the tournament's safety rules.
entries.exampleZh: 裁判充当了赛事安全规则的严格执行者。

entries.meaning: 雇佣,从事,参加；从事于，忙于；吸引；订婚；聘用
entries.example: Good teachers engage students with questions instead of simply lecturing them.
entries.exampleZh: 优秀的老师用提问吸引学生参与，而不是单纯讲授。

entries.example: She cancelled a business engagement to attend her sister's wedding.
entries.exampleZh: 她取消了一次商务约会去参加妹妹的婚礼。

entries.example: His engaging manner made even boring meetings feel surprisingly pleasant and short.
entries.exampleZh: 他迷人的举止让最枯燥的会议也变得出人意料地轻松愉快。

entries.example: Careless remarks can engender resentment among colleagues who feel undervalued.
entries.exampleZh: 不慎的言论会在感到被轻视的同事之间滋生怨恨。

entries.example: The mechanic discovered smoke coming from the engine of the old truck.
entries.exampleZh: 机械师发现浓烟从旧卡车的发动机里冒出来。

entries.example: A young engineer designed a bridge that could survive powerful earthquakes.
entries.exampleZh: 一位年轻工程师设计了一座能抵御强烈地震的桥梁。

entries.example: She studied engineering because she wanted to build safer, cleaner transport systems.
entries.exampleZh: 她学工程学是因为她想建造更安全、更清洁的交通系统。

entries.example: They spent a rainy week in the north of England last autumn.
entries.exampleZh: 去年秋天他们在英格兰北部度过了一个多雨的星期。

entries.example: She speaks English fluently and often helps foreign visitors at the museum.
entries.exampleZh: 她英语说得很流利，还经常在博物馆帮助外国游客。

entries.example: They plan to engrave her name on a silver plate for the award.
entries.exampleZh: 他们打算把她的名字刻在一只银盘上作为奖品。

entries.meaning: 雕刻术,雕版；雕刻术，刻版术；版画
entries.example: The museum displayed a rare engraving of the old city market.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了一幅旧城集市的珍稀版画。

entries.example: Dark clouds may engulf the mountain village before the storm arrives.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前，乌云可能会吞没那个山村。

entries.example: Regular exercise can enhance your mood and improve your overall health.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能改善情绪并增进整体健康。

entries.example: The new lighting is a welcome enhancement to the gallery space.
entries.exampleZh: 新的照明对画廊空间是一项受欢迎的改善。
