entries.exampleZh: 那位年轻的僧人成了这位著名导师忠实的追随者。

entries.example: It was sheer folly to spend all his savings on that car.
entries.exampleZh: 把全部积蓄花在那辆车上纯粹是愚蠢之举。

entries.example: The speech was designed to foment unrest among the workers.
entries.exampleZh: 那篇演讲旨在煽动工人中的动乱情绪。

entries.example: She is very fond of hiking in the mountains near her home.
entries.exampleZh: 她非常喜欢在家附近的山里徒步。

entries.example: The village store sells basic foodstuff at fair prices.
entries.exampleZh: 村里的商店以公道的价格出售基本食品。

entries.example: It would be foolish to ignore the doctor's clear advice.
entries.exampleZh: 忽视医生明确的建议会很不明智。

entries.example: He injured his left foot during the long hike.
entries.exampleZh: 他在长途徒步中伤了左脚。

entries.meaning: 山麓小丘, 丘陵地带
entries.example: Their house sits at the foothill of a quiet green mountain.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的房子坐落在一座宁静青翠的山麓。

entries.example: The detective found a muddy footprint near the broken window.
entries.exampleZh: 侦探在破碎的窗户附近发现了一个泥泞的脚印。

entries.meaning: 草料；觅食；搜寻；草料，饲料
entries.example: The soldiers had to forage for food in the abandoned village.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们不得不在废弃的村庄里搜寻食物。

entries.example: The ancient forager gathered nuts and berries along the river.
entries.exampleZh: 古代的觅食者沿着河边采集坚果和浆果。

entries.example: The biologist studied tiny foraminifera under a powerful microscope.
entries.exampleZh: 这位生物学家在高倍显微镜下研究微小的有孔虫。

entries.example: Their first foray into the export business ended in failure.
entries.exampleZh: 他们首次涉足出口生意以失败告终。

entries.example: He showed great forbearance when his neighbors played loud music.
entries.exampleZh: 邻居把音乐放得很大声时，他表现出了极大的忍耐。

entries.meaning: 福布斯（美国著名财经杂志）
entries.example: She read an interview with a young billionaire in Forbes.
entries.exampleZh: 她读了《福布斯》上对一位年轻亿万富翁的采访。

entries.example: Her parents forbid her to stay out late on school nights.
entries.exampleZh: 她父母禁止她在上学的晚上在外面待到很晚。

entries.example: His forceful argument convinced even the most skeptical committee members.
entries.exampleZh: 他有力的论点说服了哪怕最持怀疑态度的委员会成员。

entries.example: The old truck struggled to cross the shallow ford.
entries.exampleZh: 那辆旧卡车吃力地驶过浅浅的浅滩。

entries.example: The sailor moved toward the fore of the small boat.
entries.exampleZh: 水手朝小船的前部走去。

entries.example: His forebear had sailed across the ocean many years ago.
entries.exampleZh: 他的祖先许多年前曾横渡大洋。

entries.meaning: 预见,预测；预报；预测，预料
entries.example: The weather forecast warns of heavy snow across the northern hills tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 天气预报警告说今晚北部丘陵地区将有大雪。

entries.example: The forecaster predicted a mild winter with plenty of rain.
entries.exampleZh: 预报员预测今年冬天温和，雨水充沛。

entries.example: An old portrait of my forefather hangs above the fireplace.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖先的一幅旧画像挂在壁炉上方。

entries.meaning: 最前部, 最前线；最前沿，最前线；中心
entries.example: She has been at the forefront of cancer research for decades.
entries.exampleZh: 几十年来她一直处于癌症研究的最前沿。

entries.example: Learning a foreign language opens doors to entirely new ways of thinking.
entries.exampleZh: 学习一门外语能打开通往全新思维方式的大门。

entries.meaning: 前肢(指四肢或多肢动物的)前脚
entries.example: The injured horse refused to put weight on its left foreleg.
entries.exampleZh: 那匹受伤的马不肯让左前腿承重。

entries.example: Bats use their wings, which are modified forelimb structures, to fly.
entries.exampleZh: 蝙蝠利用翅膀飞行，而翅膀是经过改造的前肢结构。

entries.meaning: 最重要的,最初的；最先的；最著名的，最重要的
entries.example: She is one of the foremost experts on ancient Chinese ceramics.
entries.exampleZh: 她是研究中国古代陶瓷最著名的专家之一。

entries.meaning: 先驱(者)；先驱者，开路人；先兆，预兆
entries.example: This simple machine was a forerunner of the modern computer.
entries.exampleZh: 这台简单的机器是现代计算机的先驱。

entries.example: Nobody could foresee how quickly the situation would change.
entries.exampleZh: 没有人能预见形势会变化得如此之快。

entries.example: Dark clouds on the horizon foreshadow a violent storm tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 地平线上的乌云预示今晚将有一场猛烈的暴风雨。

entries.meaning: 用透视法缩小；缩短，节略
entries.example: From this angle, the camera tends to foreshorten the entire street.
entries.exampleZh: 从这个角度拍摄，相机会把整条街道透视缩短。

entries.example: Buying that land early showed remarkable foresight on their part.
entries.exampleZh: 他们早早买下那块地，显示出非凡的远见。

entries.example: Her foresightedness saved the company from a serious financial crisis.
entries.exampleZh: 她的先见之明使公司免于一场严重的财务危机。

entries.example: We walked through the pine forest for nearly three hours.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在松树林里走了将近三个小时。

entries.meaning: 之前, 先(用先发制人的方法)预防, 阻止；预防，预先阻止；先发制人
entries.example: The manager acted quickly to forestall any further complaints.
entries.exampleZh: 经理迅速采取行动，以防止再出现任何投诉。

entries.example: A local forester explained how the young trees are protected.
entries.exampleZh: 一位当地林务员讲解了这些幼树是如何受到保护的。

entries.example: She promised her brother to keep that secret forever.
entries.exampleZh: 她答应弟弟永远保守那个秘密。

entries.meaning: 被没收，丧失；罚款；没收物
entries.example: If you arrive late again, you will forfeit your deposit.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你再迟到，就会失去押金。

entries.example: Someone tried to forge his signature on the contract.
entries.exampleZh: 有人试图在合同上伪造他的签名。

entries.example: Don't forget to lock the door before you leave the office.
entries.exampleZh: 离开办公室之前别忘了锁门。

entries.example: She asked for forgiveness after the argument, and he accepted it.
entries.exampleZh: 争吵之后她请求原谅，而他接受了。

entries.meaning: 叉, 叉状物 vi分叉
entries.example: He picked up the fork and started eating the salad.
entries.exampleZh: 他拿起叉子，开始吃那份沙拉。

entries.meaning: 正式的,正规的；正规的，正式的；形式的
entries.example: The company requires formal attire at all client meetings.
entries.exampleZh: 公司与客户的所有会议都要求着装正式。

entries.example: The two sides decided to formalize their agreement in writing.
entries.exampleZh: 双方决定以书面形式使他们的协议正式化。

entries.example: The committee formally approved the proposal at yesterday's meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会在昨天的会议上正式批准了该提案。

entries.meaning: 设计,格式；设计，安排；格式，样式；使格式化
entries.example: Please save the file in a format that everyone can open.
entries.exampleZh: 请把文件保存成所有人都能打开的格式。

entries.meaning: 形成,构成,编队；形成，构成；形成物；编队
entries.example: The gradual formation of ice on the wings worried the pilot.
entries.exampleZh: 机翼上逐渐结冰让飞行员很担心。

entries.meaning: 从前的,以前的；从前的；前者
entries.example: The former manager now runs a small bookshop in town.
entries.exampleZh: 这位前任经理现在在城里经营一家小书店。

entries.example: This building was formerly a factory before it became a museum.
entries.exampleZh: 这栋建筑在成为博物馆之前曾是一家工厂。

entries.meaning: 可怕的；难以克服的；难对付的；强大的；令人敬畏的
entries.example: Climbing that mountain in winter is a formidable challenge.
entries.exampleZh: 在冬天攀登那座山是一项艰巨的挑战。

entries.meaning: 公式, 规则；公式，方程式；分子式；配方
entries.example: The scientist explained the formula on the board very slowly.
entries.exampleZh: 那位科学家非常缓慢地讲解了黑板上的公式。

entries.meaning: 构想出，规划；阐明，确切表达；规划，构想；制定
entries.example: We need to formulate a clear plan before the deadline.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要在截止日期之前制定出一个清晰的计划。

entries.example: He promised never to forsake his old friends in hard times.
entries.exampleZh: 他承诺在困难时期绝不抛弃老朋友。

entries.meaning: 堡垒,要塞；要塞，堡垒；营地
entries.example: The soldiers defended the old fort against the attack.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们守住了那座古老的堡垒，抵御了进攻。

entries.example: Her real forte is explaining complex ideas in simple terms.
entries.exampleZh: 她真正的长处是用简单的话解释复杂的想法。

entries.example: The meeting went back and forth for nearly three hours.
entries.exampleZh: 会议来回讨论将近三个小时。

entries.example: The ancient fortification still stands on top of the hill.
entries.exampleZh: 那座古老的防御工事依然矗立在山顶上。

entries.meaning: 增强(体力,结构等)；筑防御工事；支持，给…以勇气；加强，增强；筑防御工事于
entries.example: Eating fresh vegetables can fortify your body against illness.
entries.exampleZh: 吃新鲜蔬菜能增强你的身体抵抗疾病的能力。

entries.meaning: 偶然的, 幸运的；偶然的，意外的
entries.example: Their meeting at the airport was entirely fortuitous and pleasant.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在机场的相遇完全是偶然的，而且令人愉快。

entries.example: The two researchers met fortuitously at a conference and soon began collaborating.
entries.exampleZh: 两位研究人员在一次会议上偶然相遇，很快便开始合作。

entries.example: We were fortunate to find shelter before the storm reached the coast.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在暴风雨抵达海岸前找到了避雨处，真是幸运。

entries.example: The missing documents fortunately turned up before the important meeting began.
entries.exampleZh: 幸运的是，丢失的文件在重要会议开始前被找到了。

entries.example: Her grandfather made a fortune by investing in small local businesses.
entries.exampleZh: 她的祖父通过投资当地小企业发了财。

entries.example: The new library holds about forty thousand books and several quiet reading rooms.
entries.exampleZh: 新图书馆藏有大约四万册书，还有几间安静的阅览室。

entries.meaning: 讨论会, 论坛；论坛；讨论会
entries.example: The online forum allows readers to discuss recent novels in a friendly manner.
entries.exampleZh: 这个在线论坛让读者能以友好的方式讨论近期小说。

entries.meaning: 向前,从今往后；前部的；向前；；发送；转交，转递
entries.example: Please forward this email to the entire team before Friday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 请在周五下午之前把这封邮件转发给整个团队。

entries.meaning: 化石的；陈腐的；化石；老顽固
entries.example: The museum displayed a fossil that had been discovered near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了一块在河边被发现的化石。

entries.example: Rapid fossilization requires specific conditions that rarely occur in ordinary soil.
entries.exampleZh: 快速化石化需要一些在普通土壤中很少出现的特定条件。

entries.example: Under certain conditions, soft tissue can fossilize instead of decaying completely.
entries.exampleZh: 在某些条件下，软组织可以化为化石而不是完全腐烂。

entries.meaning: 收养；培养，促进；鼓励，促进，助长；培养，抚育；领养；代养的
entries.example: Good teachers foster curiosity and encourage students to ask thoughtful questions.
entries.exampleZh: 优秀的教师培养好奇心，并鼓励学生提出有深度的问题。

entries.meaning: 邪恶的,下流的 n犯规 v弄脏；污秽的，肮脏的；充满脏话的，辱骂性的；邪恶的
entries.example: The referee ignored a foul tackle that injured our best midfielder.
entries.exampleZh: 裁判无视了一次导致我们最佳中场受伤的犯规抢截。

entries.example: The artists decided to found a cooperative gallery in the old warehouse.
entries.exampleZh: 艺术家们决定在旧仓库里创办一家合作画廊。

entries.example: A solid foundation in mathematics is essential for advanced engineering courses.
entries.exampleZh: 扎实的数学基础对高级工程课程至关重要。

entries.example: The founding of the university dates back to the early nineteenth century.
entries.exampleZh: 这所大学的创立可以追溯到十九世纪初。

entries.example: The old foundry now produces custom metal parts for local manufacturers.
entries.exampleZh: 这家旧铸造厂现在为当地制造商生产定制金属零件。

entries.meaning: 喷泉；喷泉；丰富来源，源泉
entries.example: Children gathered around the fountain to watch the water rise and fall.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们聚集在喷泉周围，看着水上升又落下。

entries.example: The fourth chapter explains how the author developed her central argument.
entries.exampleZh: 第四章解释了作者如何发展她的核心论点。

entries.example: A red fox slipped quietly through the garden just after sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 日落刚过，一只红狐悄悄穿过花园。

entries.meaning: 小部分, 片断；小部分，一点儿，少许
entries.example: Only a small fraction of the applicants passed the final interview stage.
entries.exampleZh: 只有一小部分申请者通过了最终面试阶段。

entries.meaning: (使)破碎,(使)破裂；断裂，折断；分裂；骨折；断裂；破裂
entries.example: The doctor found a small fracture in his left wrist.
entries.exampleZh: 医生在他左手腕发现了一处小骨折。

entries.meaning: 易碎的,脆的；易碎的；脆弱的；纤巧的；虚弱的
entries.example: Please handle this fragile glass vase with great care.
entries.exampleZh: 请格外小心地拿这个易碎的玻璃花瓶。

entries.example: The fragility of the old bridge worried the local engineers.
entries.exampleZh: 这座老桥的脆弱让当地工程师感到担忧。

entries.meaning: 碎片；(使)成碎片；分裂，成碎片；碎片，断片
entries.example: A sharp fragment of glass cut through his thin glove.
entries.exampleZh: 一块锋利的玻璃碎片划破了他薄薄的手套。

entries.example: The police received only fragmentary details about the missing painting.
entries.exampleZh: 警方只收到了关于那幅失踪画作的零碎细节。

entries.example: A gentle fragrance of roses filled the quiet garden.
entries.exampleZh: 玫瑰的淡淡芬芳弥漫在安静的花园里。

entries.example: The kitchen smelled fragrant after she baked fresh bread.
entries.exampleZh: 她烤完新鲜面包后，厨房里闻起来很香。

entries.example: Her frail grandmother needs help walking up the stairs.
entries.exampleZh: 她体弱的祖母需要人帮忙才能上楼。

entries.meaning: 镜框,构架；镶框,制定；框架；总的思想，体系；设计，构成；给…镶框；表达
entries.example: He put the old photograph in a wooden frame.
entries.exampleZh: 他把那张旧照片放进了一个木相框里。

entries.meaning: 框架, 体系, 结构；框架，构架；原则，准则；机制，结构
entries.example: The new policy provides a clear framework for future research.
entries.exampleZh: 新政策为未来研究提供了清晰的框架。

entries.example: Our train to France leaves early tomorrow from the central station.
entries.exampleZh: 我们明天一早从中央车站坐火车去法国。

entries.meaning: 特权，特许；特许经销权；选举权；赋予特权；赋予选举权
entries.example: The company granted him a franchise to open two cafes.
entries.exampleZh: 公司授予他特许经营权，让他开两家咖啡馆。

entries.example: She gave a frank answer to the reporter's difficult question.
entries.exampleZh: 她对记者提出的难题给出了坦率的回答。

entries.example: The wealthy franklin owned most of the land near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 那位富有的乡绅拥有河流附近的大部分土地。

entries.meaning: 骗子，冒名顶替者；冒牌货；欺骗
entries.example: The court found him guilty of serious fraud last year.
entries.exampleZh: 法庭去年判定他犯有严重欺诈罪。

entries.example: The bank blocked several fraudulent payments from the stolen account.
entries.exampleZh: 银行阻止了来自被盗账户的几笔欺诈性付款。

entries.meaning: 吵架；磨破，恼火；磨损，磨破；烦躁，恼火；争斗
entries.example: A sudden fray broke out among the football fans.
entries.exampleZh: 足球迷之间突然爆发了一场争吵。

entries.meaning: 自由的(地),免费的(地)；解放
entries.example: The museum offers free entry to children under twelve.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆对十二岁以下儿童免费开放。

entries.example: Many people fought hard for freedom during that difficult period.
entries.exampleZh: 在那个艰难时期，许多人为自由而奋力斗争。

entries.example: She freely admitted that the mistake was entirely her own.
entries.exampleZh: 她坦率地承认那个错误完全是她自己的。

entries.example: Please freeze the leftover soup before it goes bad tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 请今晚把剩下的汤冷冻起来，以免它变坏。

entries.example: The freezing wind made everyone hurry back to the heated cabin.
entries.exampleZh: 刺骨的寒风让大家赶紧回到有暖气的木屋。

entries.meaning: 货物；运送；货运；运费；运送，货运；使充满
entries.example: The company ships heavy freight across the ocean every month.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司每个月都运送重型货物横跨大洋。

entries.example: A large freighter entered the harbor just before sunrise.
entries.exampleZh: 一艘大型货船在日出前驶入港口。

entries.example: She bought a french dictionary before her trip to Paris.
entries.exampleZh: 她去巴黎之前买了一本法语词典。

entries.example: The office was frenetic as everyone rushed to meet the deadline.
entries.exampleZh: 办公室一片忙乱，大家都在赶最后期限。

entries.meaning: 狂暴, 狂怒 vt使发狂；狂暴，狂热，疯狂
entries.example: The shoppers worked themselves into a frenzy over the discounted televisions.
entries.exampleZh: 购物者们因为打折电视而陷入疯狂。

entries.example: The radio station changes its frequency during severe storms.
entries.exampleZh: 这家电台在强风暴期间会改变频率。

entries.example: She makes frequent trips to the library for research materials.
entries.exampleZh: 她经常去图书馆查阅研究资料。

entries.meaning: 壁画 vt作壁画于；绘湿壁画于；湿壁画；湿壁画技法
entries.example: The ancient fresco on the wall depicts a lively harvest scene.
entries.exampleZh: 墙上的古老壁画描绘了一幅生动的丰收场景。

entries.example: The bakery sells fresh bread every morning before eight.
entries.exampleZh: 这家面包店每天早上八点前出售新鲜面包。

entries.meaning: 大学一年级新生, 新鲜人
entries.example: As a fresher, he joined several clubs during orientation week.
entries.exampleZh: 作为大一新生，他在迎新周加入了几个社团。

entries.example: She baked the bread and served it freshly sliced with butter.
entries.exampleZh: 她烤好面包，切成片后配上黄油端上桌。

entries.example: The freshness of the vegetables impressed every guest at dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 蔬菜的新鲜程度让晚宴上的每位客人都印象深刻。

entries.example: Many species of fish depend on clean freshwater to survive.
entries.exampleZh: 许多鱼类依靠干净的淡水生存。

entries.example: The critic offered a freudian reading of the novel's strange dreams.
entries.exampleZh: 评论家对小说中奇怪的梦境作出了弗洛伊德式的解读。

entries.meaning: 摩擦,摩擦力；摩擦；摩擦力；矛盾，冲突
entries.example: Rubbing two sticks together creates enough friction to start a fire.
entries.exampleZh: 把两根木棍相互摩擦能产生足够的摩擦力来生火。

entries.meaning: 朋友, 赞助者, 助手
entries.example: My closest friend helped me move into the new apartment.
entries.exampleZh: 我最亲密的朋友帮我搬进了新公寓。

entries.example: Her friendliness made the new students feel welcome at once.
entries.exampleZh: 她的友善让新生立刻感到受欢迎。

entries.example: The staff gave us friendly advice about local restaurants.
entries.exampleZh: 工作人员热情地给我们推荐了当地餐馆。

entries.example: Their friendship grew stronger after they worked together on the difficult project.
entries.exampleZh: 他们一起完成那个困难项目后，他们的友谊变得更牢固。

entries.example: The loud thunder gave the little child a terrible fright at night.
entries.exampleZh: 夜里响亮的雷声让那个小孩非常惊吓。

entries.example: Loud noises often frighten animals that live near busy roads.
entries.exampleZh: 响亮的噪音常常惊吓住在繁忙道路附近的动物。

entries.example: The frigid wind swept across the empty square before dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 黎明前，寒冷的风吹过空荡的广场。

entries.example: A white frill ran along the edge of her simple dress.
entries.exampleZh: 她朴素的连衣裙边缘有一圈白色褶边。

entries.example: Bright lights from the stage lit the fringe of the crowded hall.
entries.exampleZh: 舞台上明亮的灯光照亮了拥挤大厅的边缘。

entries.example: The frisky puppy chased its tail around the garden all morning.
entries.exampleZh: 那只活泼的小狗整个上午在花园里追着自己的尾巴跑。

entries.meaning: 轻薄,轻浮；轻浮；愚蠢的行为
entries.example: Her constant frivolity at work annoyed the serious members of the team.
entries.exampleZh: 她在工作中一贯的轻浮让团队里严肃的成员感到恼火。

entries.meaning: 琐碎的，无关紧要的；愚蠢的，可笑的；无聊的，不严肃的，轻佻的
entries.example: He dismissed the complaint as a frivolous waste of the court's time.
entries.exampleZh: 他驳回了那项投诉，认为它是在浪费法庭时间的无聊之举。

entries.example: A green frog jumped from the wet stone into the quiet pond.
entries.exampleZh: 一只绿色的青蛙从湿石头上跳进了安静的池塘。

entries.example: Please wait at the front of the building until I arrive.
entries.exampleZh: 请在大楼前面等我，直到我到达。

entries.example: The general ordered a frontal attack despite the heavy enemy fire.
entries.exampleZh: 将军不顾猛烈的敌方火力，下令发动正面攻击。

entries.example: The portrait's frontality makes the subject appear directly engaged with viewers.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅肖像的正面描绘使画中人看起来与观者直接交流。

entries.example: They traveled west to settle near the dangerous frontier in the early days.
entries.exampleZh: 早期他们向西旅行，在危险的边疆附近定居。

entries.meaning: 霜；结霜；结霜，蒙上霜；霜；霜冻；严寒
entries.example: A thin layer of frost covered the car before sunrise.
entries.exampleZh: 日出前，一层薄霜覆盖了汽车。

entries.example: Please do not frown when you hear a difficult question.
entries.exampleZh: 听到难题时请不要皱眉。

entries.example: Her frugal habits helped her save enough money for a small house.
entries.exampleZh: 她节俭的习惯帮助她攒够了买一所小房子的钱。

entries.example: She placed a piece of fresh fruit beside each child's plate.
entries.exampleZh: 她在每个孩子的盘子旁边放了一块新鲜水果。

entries.meaning: 果实结得多的, 多产的
entries.example: The meeting was fruitful because everyone shared clear and practical ideas.
entries.exampleZh: 这次会议富有成效，因为每个人都分享了清晰而实用的想法。

entries.example: The fruitfulness of the valley surprised the farmers after the long drought.
entries.exampleZh: 长期干旱之后，这片山谷的丰产让农民们感到惊讶。

entries.example: Their long search for the missing file proved fruitless and wasted time.
entries.exampleZh: 他们长时间寻找那份丢失的文件毫无结果，浪费了时间。

entries.meaning: 挫败, 阻挠；挫败的；使感到灰心，挫败；阻止
entries.example: Unexpected delays frustrate even the most patient members of our team.
entries.exampleZh: 意外的延误甚至会让团队中最有耐心的成员感到沮丧。

entries.example: Her repeated frustration with the software finally led to a formal complaint.
entries.exampleZh: 她对这款软件反复感到的挫败最终导致了一份正式投诉。

entries.example: The rising cost of fuel continues to worry many small business owners.
entries.exampleZh: 燃料成本的不断上涨继续令许多小企业主担忧。

entries.meaning: 履行,实现；履行；实现；符合，具备
entries.example: She hopes to fulfill her promise to visit every national park.
entries.exampleZh: 她希望履行自己游览每一座国家公园的承诺。

entries.example: The jar was full of coins collected during their long journey.
entries.exampleZh: 罐子里装满了他们长途旅行中收集的硬币。

entries.example: The fuller worked carefully with water and clay to clean the cloth.
entries.exampleZh: 漂洗工用水和黏土仔细清洗布料。

entries.example: The fullness of her joy was impossible to describe in words.
entries.exampleZh: 她喜悦的饱满程度无法用言语描述。

entries.example: The team fully understood the risks before signing the final agreement.
entries.exampleZh: 团队在签署最终协议前完全理解了其中的风险。

entries.example: Drivers often fume when traffic blocks the road for hours.
entries.exampleZh: 当交通把道路堵上几个小时时，司机们常常会大为恼火。

entries.meaning: 熏制, 以烟熏消毒；烟熏，香薰
entries.example: Workers will fumigate the warehouse before the new grain arrives.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们将在新谷物到达前对仓库进行熏蒸消毒。

entries.example: The children had great fun building a castle from old boxes.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们用旧箱子搭建城堡，玩得很开心。

entries.meaning: 功能,职务；运行,起作用；运行；起作用；机能，功能，作用；函数
entries.example: The main function of this device is to measure air pressure.
entries.exampleZh: 这个装置的主要功能是测量气压。

entries.example: The old radio remains functional despite its cracked and faded case.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管外壳开裂褪色，这台旧收音机仍能正常使用。

entries.meaning: 功能主义, 机能心理学
entries.example: His lecture on functionalism attracted students from several different departments.
entries.exampleZh: 他关于功能主义的讲座吸引了来自几个不同系的学生。

entries.meaning: 资金；支助,投资；基金，专款；储备，蕴藏；；为…提供资金
entries.example: The charity created a special fund for families affected by the flood.
entries.exampleZh: 该慈善机构设立了一项特别基金，帮助受洪水影响的家庭。

entries.meaning: 基础的,基本的；基础的，基本的，根本的；基本原则；基础
entries.example: Access to clean water is a fundamental right for every person.
entries.exampleZh: 获得清洁水是每个人的基本权利。

entries.example: The two proposals differ fundamentally in how they treat local communities.
entries.exampleZh: 这两项提案在如何对待当地社区方面存在根本差异。

entries.example: The project lost its government funding after the unexpected budget review.
entries.exampleZh: 在意外预算审查之后，该项目失去了政府资助。

entries.example: The doctor treated the fungal infection with a strong cream.
entries.exampleZh: 医生用一种强效药膏治疗了真菌感染。

entries.example: These strange organisms are not plants but fungi that thrive in damp soil.
entries.exampleZh: 这些奇怪的生物不是植物，而是喜欢潮湿土壤的真菌。

entries.example: Farmers often spray a chemical fungicide to protect young grape vines from disease.
entries.exampleZh: 农民经常喷洒一种化学杀真菌剂来保护幼小的葡萄藤免遭病害。

entries.example: A mysterious fungus has spread quickly through the old wooden walls of the house.
entries.exampleZh: 一种神秘的真菌已经迅速蔓延到这座房子的旧木墙里。

entries.example: Pour the oil slowly through the narrow funnel into the clean glass bottle.
entries.exampleZh: 把油慢慢通过这个窄漏斗倒入干净的玻璃瓶中。

entries.example: The thick fur of the Arctic fox keeps it warm during winter.
entries.exampleZh: 北极狐厚厚的毛皮让它在冬季保持温暖。

entries.meaning: 狂怒的，狂暴的；强烈的，猛烈的
entries.example: My father was furious when he discovered the broken window in his car.
entries.exampleZh: 父亲发现他车上的窗户破了时非常愤怒。

entries.meaning: 炉子,熔炉；火炉，熔炉；锅炉
entries.example: The old steel furnace in the basement has not worked for many years.
entries.exampleZh: 地下室里的旧钢炉已经很多年没有运转了。

entries.meaning: 布置, 装备, 提供；提供，供应；布置，为…配备家具
entries.example: They plan to furnish the new apartment with simple wooden desks and shelves.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划用简单的木桌和架子来布置新公寓。

entries.example: The old furnishing in the hall gave the house a warm and elegant look.
entries.exampleZh: 大厅里那件旧家具陈设给房子增添了温暖而优雅的外观。

entries.example: We moved all the furniture out before painting the living room walls.
entries.exampleZh: 在粉刷客厅墙壁之前，我们把所有家具都搬了出去。

entries.meaning: 毛皮似的；盖着毛皮的；生苔的
entries.example: A small furry animal climbed quickly up the tall tree in our garden.
entries.exampleZh: 一只毛茸茸的小动物迅速爬上了我们花园里的那棵高树。

entries.example: We need further information before we can make a final decision about the project.
entries.exampleZh: 在做出关于该项目的最终决定之前，我们需要更多信息。

entries.example: The plan is expensive; furthermore, it may cause serious damage to the local environment.
entries.exampleZh: 这个计划代价高昂；此外，它可能对当地环境造成严重破坏。

entries.meaning: 保险丝 v熔合；融合；熔接；熔化；因保险丝烧断而断电；合并；保险丝；引信；导火线
entries.example: A blown fuse left the entire workshop in darkness for two hours.
entries.exampleZh: 一根烧断的保险丝让整个车间陷入黑暗两个小时。

entries.meaning: 熔化,融合；熔化，熔解；熔合；核聚变；联合，合并
entries.example: The successful fusion of these two teams created a much stronger research group.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个团队的成功融合造就了一个强大得多的研究小组。

entries.meaning: 无效的，无用的，无意义的；琐细的；没出息的
entries.example: Their attempts to repair the old machine proved completely futile after the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，他们修理那台旧机器的尝试完全徒劳。

entries.example: Nobody can predict the future of the company during this difficult economic period.
entries.exampleZh: 在这个困难的经济时期，没有人能预测公司的未来。

entries.example: The new policy may help small farmers gain easier access to foreign markets.
entries.exampleZh: 新政策可能帮助小农户获得更容易进入外国市场的机会。

entries.example: His slow, steady gait suggested that he was still recovering from the injury.
entries.exampleZh: 他缓慢而平稳的步态表明他仍在从伤势中恢复。

entries.meaning: 银河,星系；星系；[G-]银河系，银河；群英
entries.example: Powerful telescopes reveal countless stars and planets within our own galaxy.
entries.exampleZh: 强大的望远镜揭示了银河系内无数的恒星和行星。

entries.meaning: 伽利略的, 加利利的（位于巴基斯坦北部）
entries.example: The ancient galilean boat was discovered near the shore of the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 那艘古老的加利利船只在湖边被发现。

entries.example: We spent the afternoon wandering through a quiet gallery filled with modern art.
entries.exampleZh: 我们花了一下午在一家摆满现代艺术的安静画廊里闲逛。

entries.example: The laboratory stored a small sample of gallium in a sealed glass tube.
entries.exampleZh: 实验室把一个镓的小样本存放在密封的玻璃管中。

entries.example: The old truck burned nearly a gallon of fuel during that short trip.
entries.exampleZh: 那辆旧卡车在那段短途行程中烧掉了将近一加仑燃料。

entries.example: The horse broke into a fast gallop across the open field.
entries.exampleZh: 那匹马在开阔的田野上开始快速飞奔。

entries.example: The coach hoped to galvanize the team before the final match.
entries.exampleZh: 教练希望在决赛前激励全队。

entries.meaning: (打)赌；投机，冒险；投机，冒险；赌博，打赌
entries.example: Buying that old house was a risky gamble for the young couple.
entries.exampleZh: 买下那栋旧房子对这年轻夫妇来说是一场冒险的赌博。

entries.example: The children invented a simple game to pass the rainy afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们发明了一个简单的游戏来打发下雨的下午。

entries.example: Scientists measured a tiny gamma ray burst from a distant galaxy.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家测量了来自遥远星系的一次微弱伽马射线暴。

entries.meaning: (一)伙, (一)群；合伙；一帮，一伙；帮派
entries.example: A noisy gang of teenagers gathered outside the corner shop.
entries.exampleZh: 一群吵闹的青少年聚集在街角商店外面。

entries.example: A single gannet circled above the cliffs before diving into the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 一只塘鹅在悬崖上方盘旋，然后潜入海中。

entries.example: A narrow gap in the fence let the dog slip through.
entries.exampleZh: 篱笆上的一道窄缝让狗钻了过去。

entries.example: The fisherman caught a long gar near the muddy riverbank.
entries.exampleZh: 渔夫在泥泞的河岸边捕到一条长长的雀鳝。

entries.meaning: 服装；装扮；服装，装束；穿着，装扮
entries.example: The dancers wore traditional garb for the opening ceremony.
entries.exampleZh: 舞者们穿着传统服装参加开幕式。

entries.meaning: 垃圾, 废物；垃圾，废物；废话，无聊的东西；垃圾箱
entries.example: Please take the garbage out before the truck arrives tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 请在卡车明天早上到达之前把垃圾拿出去。

entries.example: My grandmother grows tomatoes and roses in her small garden.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖母在她的小花园里种番茄和玫瑰。

entries.example: My mother enjoys gardening on quiet weekend mornings.
entries.exampleZh: 我母亲喜欢在安静的周末早晨从事园艺。

entries.example: She hung a flower garland above the doorway for the festival.
entries.exampleZh: 她为节日在门口上方挂了一个花环。

entries.example: The small garrison defended the fort throughout the cold winter.
entries.exampleZh: 那支小守备队在整个寒冷的冬天保卫着堡垒。

entries.meaning: 气体的,气态的；气体的，气态的
entries.example: The planet has a thick gaseous atmosphere around its rocky core.
entries.exampleZh: 这颗行星在岩石核心周围有一层浓厚的气态大气。

entries.example: The old gaslit street looked mysterious after sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 那条古老的煤气灯照明的街道在日落之后显得很神秘。

entries.example: We stopped at the station to buy gasoline before crossing the desert.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在穿越沙漠之前停在加油站买汽油。

entries.example: The garden gate creaked loudly when the wind pushed it open.
entries.exampleZh: 风吹开花园大门时，那扇门吱吱作响。

entries.example: This small town serves as a gateway to the northern mountains.
entries.exampleZh: 这座小镇是通往北部山区的门户。

entries.example: We need to gather more evidence before making any final decision.
entries.exampleZh: 在做出任何最终决定之前，我们需要收集更多证据。

entries.example: As a hunter and gatherer, he moved with the changing seasons.
entries.exampleZh: 作为狩猎采集者，他随着季节变化而迁徙。

entries.meaning: 标准，规格；测量仪表，计量器；测量，度量
entries.example: The engineer checked the pressure gauge before starting the massive machine.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师在启动那台大型机器前检查了压力表。

entries.example: She continued to gaze at the stars until midnight.
entries.exampleZh: 她一直凝望星空直到午夜。

entries.example: A graceful gazelle leaped across the dusty path and disappeared.
entries.exampleZh: 一只优雅的瞪羚跃过尘土飞扬的小路，消失了。

entries.example: The local gazette published a detailed report about the mayor.
entries.exampleZh: 当地报纸刊登了一篇关于市长的详细报道。

entries.meaning: 齿轮；使适应；齿轮，传动装置；挡；设备；调节，使适应
entries.example: He shifted into a lower gear while driving up the steep hill.
entries.exampleZh: 他在开车上陡坡时换到了低速挡。

entries.example: Apply the cooling gel gently to the sore area twice daily.
entries.exampleZh: 每天两次将清凉凝胶轻轻涂抹在疼痛部位。

entries.meaning: 宝石, 珍宝；宝石，珍品；美丽绝伦的事物
entries.example: She wore a sparkling gem on a thin silver chain.
entries.exampleZh: 她戴着一条细银链，上面镶着一颗闪闪发光的宝石。

entries.example: The museum displayed a rare gemstone found in the southern mountains.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了一颗在南部山区发现的稀有宝石。

entries.meaning: 性别,(语法中的)性；性别；性
entries.example: The survey asked each participant to indicate their age and gender.
entries.exampleZh: 调查要求每位参与者注明年龄和性别。

entries.example: Scientists identified a gene linked to resistance against that disease.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家发现了一个与该疾病抵抗力有关的基因。

entries.example: The general opinion was that the new policy needed revision.
entries.exampleZh: 普遍的看法是新政策需要修改。

entries.example: As a generalist, she can handle many different tasks at work.
entries.exampleZh: 作为一名通才，她在工作中能处理许多不同的任务。

entries.meaning: 一般化, 归纳, 概括；概括，归纳
entries.example: That conclusion is a broad generalization unsupported by the available data.
entries.exampleZh: 那个结论是缺乏现有数据支持的宽泛概括。

entries.meaning: 归纳, 概括；概括，归纳；推广
entries.example: It is risky to generalize from such a small sample.
entries.exampleZh: 根据如此小的样本进行概括是有风险的。

entries.example: People in this region generally prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
entries.exampleZh: 这个地区的人通常早上更喜欢喝茶而不是咖啡。

entries.meaning: 产生,发生；产生；引起，导致
entries.example: The new policy may generate considerable interest among local business owners.
entries.exampleZh: 这项新政策可能会在本地企业主中引起相当大的兴趣。

entries.meaning: 一代人(或产品),产生,发生
entries.example: This generation of students seems more concerned about climate change than before.
entries.exampleZh: 这一代学生似乎比以前更关心气候变化。

entries.example: When the storm cut the power, we started the backup generator immediately.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨导致停电时，我们立刻启动了备用发电机。

entries.meaning: 种类的，类属的；种类的，属的；一般的，普通的
entries.example: The doctor prescribed a generic drug because it was cheaper for the patient.
entries.exampleZh: 医生开了一种仿制药，因为对病人来说更便宜。

entries.example: The report describes the process generically without naming any specific company.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告笼统地描述了这个过程，没有提到任何具体公司。

entries.meaning: 慷慨的,丰富的；慷慨的，大方的；大量的，丰富的；宽厚的，宽宏大量的
entries.example: My neighbor was generous enough to lend me his car for the weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 我的邻居很慷慨，把车借给我用了一个周末。

entries.example: Historians still debate the genesis of the conflict that divided the small nation.
entries.exampleZh: 历史学家仍在争论那场分裂这个小国的冲突的起源。

entries.meaning: 遗传的, 起源的；基因的，遗传的
entries.example: Scientists found a genetic link between the two rare diseases last year.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家去年发现了这两种罕见疾病之间的遗传联系。

entries.example: The two crops are genetically similar but require very different growing conditions.
entries.exampleZh: 这两种作物在基因上相似，但需要非常不同的生长条件。

entries.example: Modern genetics has transformed our understanding of inherited diseases.
entries.exampleZh: 现代遗传学改变了我们对遗传性疾病的理解。

entries.meaning: 亲切的；亲切的，和蔼的；温和的，温暖的
entries.example: Our host welcomed every guest with a genial smile and warm handshake.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的主人用亲切的微笑和热情的握手欢迎每一位客人。

entries.meaning: 天才, 天赋；天才；天赋
entries.example: Her ability to solve complex puzzles suggests she has real genius.
entries.exampleZh: 她解决复杂谜题的能力表明她具有真正的天赋。

entries.example: Researchers compared the genotype of each plant to identify desirable traits.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员比较了每株植物的基因型，以识别理想的性状。

entries.meaning: 类型, 流派；类型；流派
entries.example: Science fiction remains my favorite genre because it explores bold new ideas.
entries.exampleZh: 科幻小说仍然是我最喜欢的类型，因为它探索大胆的新思想。

entries.meaning: 文雅, 出身高贵, 有教养；有教养，文雅
entries.example: The old mansion still suggests the gentility of the family who built it.
entries.exampleZh: 这座老宅仍然显示出建造它的那个家族的文雅气质。

entries.example: A gentle breeze carried the scent of flowers across the quiet garden.
entries.exampleZh: 一阵柔和的微风把花香吹过安静的花园。

entries.example: The elderly gentleman offered his seat to a pregnant woman on the train.
entries.exampleZh: 那位年长的先生在火车上把座位让给了一位孕妇。

entries.example: His gentlemanly behavior impressed everyone at the formal dinner last night.
entries.exampleZh: 他彬彬有礼的举止给昨晚正式晚宴上的每个人都留下了深刻印象。

entries.example: She closed the door gently so as not to wake the baby.
entries.exampleZh: 她轻轻地关上门，以免吵醒婴儿。

entries.example: The surgeon examined the patient's genu before ordering a detailed scan of the joint.
entries.exampleZh: 外科医生在安排关节详细扫描前检查了患者的膝。

entries.meaning: 真实的, 真正的, 诚恳的；真的，非人造的；真诚的，诚实的
entries.example: Her apology sounded genuine, and I accepted it without further hesitation.
entries.exampleZh: 她的道歉听起来很真诚，我没有再犹豫就接受了。

entries.example: I genuinely appreciate the effort you put into this difficult project.
entries.exampleZh: 我由衷感谢你为这个困难项目付出的努力。

entries.example: The team measured geochemical changes in the soil near the abandoned mine.
entries.exampleZh: 团队测量了废弃矿井附近土壤中的地球化学变化。

entries.example: A skilled geographer can explain how rivers shape the surrounding landscape over time.
entries.exampleZh: 一位熟练的地理学者能解释河流如何随时间塑造周围景观。

entries.example: The report describes the geographic features of the region in surprising detail.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告令人惊讶地详细描述了该地区的地理特征。

entries.example: Climate and geographical conditions strongly influence where people choose to build homes.
entries.exampleZh: 气候和地理条件强烈影响人们选择在哪里建房。

entries.example: She studied geography at university and later worked for a mapping agency.
entries.exampleZh: 她在大学学习地理，后来为一家地图绘制机构工作。

entries.example: The canyon reveals a remarkable geologic record spanning millions of years.
entries.exampleZh: 这条峡谷展现了跨越数百万年的非凡地质记录。

entries.example: Experts studied the geological structure before approving the tunnel's final design.
entries.exampleZh: 专家们在批准隧道的最终设计前研究了其地质结构。

entries.example: These islands are geologically young and still changing after every severe storm.
entries.exampleZh: 这些岛屿在地质学上很年轻，每次强烈风暴后仍在变化。

entries.example: The geologist collected rock samples from the cliff beside the river.
entries.exampleZh: 地质学家从河边的悬崖采集了岩石样本。

entries.meaning: 地质学,地质概况；地质学；地质概况
entries.example: Her interest in geology began during a family trip to the mountains.
entries.exampleZh: 她对地质学的兴趣始于一次全家山间旅行。

entries.example: A sudden geomagnetic storm disrupted satellite signals across the northern hemisphere.
entries.exampleZh: 一场突如其来的地磁暴扰乱了北半球的卫星信号。

entries.meaning: 几何(学)的；几何的，几何学的
entries.example: The artist arranged the tiles in a precise geometric pattern.
entries.exampleZh: 艺术家把瓷砖排列成精确的几何图案。

entries.example: The garden's geometrical layout reflects classical ideas about balance and order.
entries.exampleZh: 花园的几何布局体现了关于平衡与秩序的古典理念。

entries.example: The buildings are arranged geometrically around a large central square.
entries.exampleZh: 这些建筑围绕一个大型中央广场按几何方式排列。

entries.example: Students often find geometry easier when teachers use diagrams and physical models.
entries.exampleZh: 当老师使用图表和实物模型时，学生常觉得几何更容易。

entries.example: The survey used geophysical methods to locate underground water before drilling began.
entries.exampleZh: 勘测在开始钻探前使用地球物理方法寻找地下水。

entries.example: Atlanta is the largest city in Georgia and a major transportation hub.
entries.exampleZh: 亚特兰大是佐治亚州最大的城市，也是重要的交通枢纽。

entries.example: Iceland heats many homes using geothermal energy from deep underground.
entries.exampleZh: 冰岛利用深层地下的地热能为许多家庭供暖。

entries.example: The building is heated geothermally, so its energy costs stay low.
entries.exampleZh: 这栋建筑采用地热供暖，因此能源费用很低。

entries.meaning: 微生物, 细菌；微生物，细菌；萌芽
entries.example: Washing your hands properly helps stop every germ from spreading.
entries.exampleZh: 正确洗手有助于阻止每一种细菌传播。

entries.example: My German neighbour bakes excellent bread every Sunday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我的德国邻居每个周日早上都烤很棒的面包。

entries.example: This lens contains germanium, a rare element used in infrared cameras.
entries.exampleZh: 这片镜头含有锗，一种用于红外相机的稀有元素。

entries.example: She moved to Germany last spring to study engineering.
entries.exampleZh: 她去年春天搬到德国学习工程学。

entries.meaning: 发芽,使生长；发芽，萌芽；发展
entries.example: These seeds will germinate quickly if you keep the soil warm.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你保持土壤温暖，这些种子会很快发芽。

entries.example: Warmth and moisture are essential for the germination of most seeds.
entries.exampleZh: 温暖和水分对大多数种子的发芽至关重要。

entries.meaning: (雕刻、绘画用的)石膏, 石膏粉
entries.example: The artist covered the board with gesso before painting.
entries.exampleZh: 画家在作画前用石膏粉涂满了画板。

entries.example: He made a small gesture to show that he agreed.
entries.exampleZh: 他做了个小手势表示同意。

entries.example: I hope to get a reply from the company soon.
entries.exampleZh: 我希望很快能收到公司的回复。

entries.example: A geyser shot hot water high into the cold air.
entries.exampleZh: 一眼间歇泉把热水高高喷向寒冷的空中。

entries.example: A pale ghost appeared at the end of the corridor.
entries.exampleZh: 一个苍白的幽灵出现在走廊尽头。

entries.example: A ghostly figure drifted silently across the empty hall.
entries.exampleZh: 一个幽灵般的身影无声地飘过空荡的大厅。

entries.meaning: 巨人,天才；巨大的；超群的；巨大的动物；才智超群的人
entries.example: A giant statue stands in the middle of the square.
entries.exampleZh: 一座巨大的雕像矗立在广场中央。

entries.example: A gibbon swung from branch to branch above our heads.
entries.exampleZh: 一只长臂猿在我们头顶的树枝间荡来荡去。

entries.meaning: 嘲笑,讥笑；嘲笑；嘲弄，讥笑
entries.example: His cruel gibe hurt her more than he realised.
entries.exampleZh: 他那刻薄的嘲讽对她的伤害超出他的想象。

entries.example: We sailed through the Strait of Gibraltar on a calm night.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在一个平静的夜晚航行穿过直布罗陀海峡。

entries.example: She gave me a small gift before leaving for London.
entries.exampleZh: 她去伦敦之前送了我一件小礼物。

entries.example: A gigantic wave crashed over the harbour wall at dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 黎明时分，一个巨浪越过港口的防波堤。

entries.example: Skilled artisans gild the cathedral's dome with thin layers of gold leaf.
entries.exampleZh: 技艺娴熟的工匠用薄薄的金箔为教堂的圆顶镀金。

entries.meaning: 镀金；贴金层，镀金层；金色涂层
entries.example: The gilding on the antique mirror has faded badly over the years.
entries.exampleZh: 这面古董镜子上的镀金层多年来已经褪色得很厉害。

entries.example: Each gill of the trout filters oxygen from the cold stream water.
entries.exampleZh: 鳟鱼的每个鳃都从冰冷的溪水中过滤氧气。

entries.meaning: 杜松烧酒 v开始；杜松子酒；弹棉机，
entries.example: He poured a splash of gin into the tall glass of tonic.
entries.exampleZh: 他往装满汤力水的高杯里倒了一点杜松子酒。

entries.example: She wore a red gingham dress and a straw hat to the picnic.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿着红色条纹棉布连衣裙、戴着草帽去野餐。

entries.example: The giraffe stretched its long neck to reach the highest leaves.
entries.exampleZh: 长颈鹿伸长脖子去够最高处的叶子。

entries.example: A massive steel girder supports the roof of the old warehouse.
entries.exampleZh: 一根巨大的钢梁支撑着这座旧仓库的屋顶。

entries.example: The girl beside me solved the puzzle in under a minute.
entries.exampleZh: 我身边的女孩不到一分钟就解开了这道谜题。

entries.meaning: 要点, 要旨；主旨，要点，大意
entries.example: I missed the meeting, so please tell me the gist of it.
entries.exampleZh: 我错过了会议，所以请告诉我会议的要点。

entries.meaning: 规定的，特定的；假定的；考虑到，鉴于
entries.example: Given the heavy traffic, we should leave for the airport now.
entries.exampleZh: 考虑到交通拥堵，我们现在就该出发去机场。

entries.meaning: 冰川(期)的,非常冷的；冰川期的，冰河时代的；寒冷的，冰冷的；冷若冰霜的
entries.example: The water in the lake felt glacial even in the middle of August.
entries.exampleZh: 即使在八月中旬，这个湖里的水也冰冷刺骨。

entries.meaning: 使结冰, 以冰(或冰河)覆盖
entries.example: Over thousands of years, the advancing ice will glaciate the entire valley.
entries.exampleZh: 在数千年间，不断推进的冰层将使整个山谷被冰覆盖。

entries.example: The last glaciation carved deep valleys into the mountain range.
entries.exampleZh: 最近一次冰期在山脉中刻出了深深的谷地。

entries.example: The glacier has retreated nearly a kilometre since the survey began.
entries.exampleZh: 自那次勘测开始以来，这条冰川已经退缩了将近一公里。

entries.meaning: 富有魅力的, 迷人的；富有魅力的，迷人的
entries.example: She looked glamorous in a black gown at the film awards.
entries.exampleZh: 她身穿黑色礼服出席电影颁奖礼，看上去光彩照人。

entries.example: A quick glance at the map told us which road to take.
entries.exampleZh: 匆匆看一眼地图就告诉了我们该走哪条路。

entries.example: The thyroid gland regulates how quickly the body uses energy.
entries.exampleZh: 甲状腺调节身体消耗能量的速度。

entries.example: Glandular tissue lines the inner surface of the digestive tract.
entries.exampleZh: 腺状组织衬在消化道的内表面。

entries.meaning: 闪耀光, 刺眼 v发眩光, 瞪视；怒目而视；发出刺眼的光；耀眼的光；怒视，瞪眼
entries.example: The glare of the headlights made it hard to see the road.
entries.exampleZh: 车头灯的强光让人很难看清道路。

entries.example: He poured the milk into a tall glass and drank it slowly.
entries.exampleZh: 他把牛奶倒进一个高玻璃杯里，慢慢地喝着。

entries.example: The frozen pond had a smooth, glasslike surface after the cold night.
entries.exampleZh: 寒冷的夜晚过后，结冰的池塘表面光滑如玻璃。

entries.example: The skilled glassmaker shaped the hot material into a delicate vase.
entries.exampleZh: 技艺娴熟的玻璃工匠把炽热的材料塑造成一只精致的花瓶。

entries.meaning: 玻璃(或玻璃器皿等)制造(术)
entries.example: Traditional glassmaking requires intense heat and carefully controlled timing.
entries.exampleZh: 传统玻璃制造需要高温和精心控制的时间安排。

entries.example: She stored the fragile glassware in a padded cabinet.
entries.exampleZh: 她把易碎的玻璃器具存放在一个有衬垫的柜子里。

entries.meaning: 玻璃制品；制成玻璃状的
entries.example: The museum displays delicate glasswork from the eighteenth century.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出十八世纪的精致玻璃制品。

entries.example: His glassy eyes suggested that he had not slept well.
entries.exampleZh: 他玻璃般呆滞的眼神表明他没睡好。

entries.meaning: 变呆滞；上釉；釉(料)；上釉；给…装玻璃；釉料；糖浆
entries.example: The potter applied a blue glaze to the finished bowl.
entries.exampleZh: 陶艺家在成品碗上涂了一层蓝色釉料。

entries.meaning: 闪光，闪烁；流露出；微光；一丝，一线；表露
entries.example: A faint gleam of light appeared beneath the closed door.
entries.exampleZh: 门缝下出现了一丝微弱的光。

entries.meaning: 拾落穗, 收集；点滴搜集，四处收集
entries.example: Researchers hope to glean useful information from the survey results.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员希望从调查结果中收集有用的信息。

entries.example: A narrow path winds through the quiet glen behind the village.
entries.exampleZh: 一条狭窄的小路蜿蜒穿过村庄后面安静的溪谷。

entries.example: The study focused on glial cells and their role in brain health.
entries.exampleZh: 这项研究关注神经胶质细胞及其在大脑健康中的作用。

entries.example: The dancers glide across the stage with remarkable grace and balance.
entries.exampleZh: 舞者们以非凡的优雅和平衡感滑过舞台。

entries.example: The small glider landed softly on the grassy field.
entries.exampleZh: 那架小型滑翔机轻轻降落在草地上。

entries.meaning: 发微光；隐约出现；闪烁的微光；隐约的迹象；一丝，一线
entries.example: A glimmer of hope appeared when the rescue team arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 救援队到达时，出现了一线希望。

entries.meaning: 一瞥v瞥见；一看，一瞥；瞥见
entries.example: She caught a brief glimpse of the singer through the crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 她透过人群短暂地瞥见了那位歌手。

entries.example: The wet leaves glisten under the morning sun after the rain.
entries.exampleZh: 雨后，湿润的叶子在晨光下闪闪发亮。

entries.meaning: 闪烁，闪耀；灿烂的光辉；诱惑力，魅力
entries.example: The decorations glitter brightly across the hall during the celebration.
entries.exampleZh: 庆祝活动期间，装饰品在大厅里闪闪发光。

entries.example: Climate change is a global issue requiring cooperation among many nations.
entries.exampleZh: 气候变化是一个需要许多国家合作的全球性问题。

entries.example: The company now sells its products globally through several online platforms.
entries.exampleZh: 该公司现在通过几个在线平台在全球销售产品。

entries.example: The teacher pointed to several countries on the classroom globe.
entries.exampleZh: 老师指着教室里的地球仪上的几个国家。

entries.meaning: 忧郁的，令人沮丧的；昏暗的，阴暗的，阴沉的
entries.example: The gloomy weather made everyone feel tired and rather quiet.
entries.exampleZh: 阴沉的天气让每个人都感到疲惫而相当安静。

entries.example: Some films glorify dangerous behavior without showing its real consequences.
entries.exampleZh: 有些电影美化危险行为，却不展示其真实后果。

entries.meaning: 壮丽的，辉煌的；光荣的；令人愉快的，极好的
entries.example: We enjoyed a glorious view from the top of the hill.
entries.exampleZh: 我们从山顶欣赏到了壮丽的景色。

entries.example: The old soldier spoke about honor, duty, and glory.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老兵谈到了荣誉、责任和光荣。

entries.meaning: 光泽，注解；有光泽；光泽，色泽；亮光漆；注解
entries.example: The magazine's cover has a shiny gloss that catches the light.
entries.exampleZh: 这本杂志的封面有一种闪亮的光泽，能反光。

entries.meaning: 平滑的, 有光泽的；光滑的；光彩夺目的；浮华的
entries.example: Her glossy hair shone brightly under the warm evening lights.
entries.exampleZh: 她的光滑头发在温暖的夜灯下闪闪发亮。

entries.meaning: 发光, 发热；发光；发红，发热；洋溢；暗淡的光；容光焕发；喜悦
entries.example: A soft glow came from the candles on the table.
entries.exampleZh: 桌上蜡烛散发出柔和的光。

entries.meaning: 胶(水) vt胶合；胶合，黏合；紧附于；胶，胶水
entries.example: Please use glue to attach the picture to the cardboard.
entries.exampleZh: 请用胶水把图片粘到纸板上。

entries.example: This glycoprotein helps cells recognize each other during early development.
entries.exampleZh: 这种糖蛋白帮助细胞在早期发育过程中相互识别。

entries.example: The plant contains a glycoside that may affect heart function.
entries.exampleZh: 这种植物含有一种可能影响心脏功能的糖苷。

entries.example: The puppy likes to gnaw on an old wooden stick.
entries.exampleZh: 这只小狗喜欢啃一根旧木棍。

entries.example: We should go home before the storm arrives.
entries.exampleZh: 我们最好在暴风雨来临前回家。

entries.example: Her main goal is to finish the report by Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 她的主要目标是在周五前完成报告。

entries.example: The farmer kept a goat beside the small stone barn.
entries.exampleZh: 农夫把一只山羊养在小石仓旁边。

entries.example: The vast gobi stretches for miles beyond the lonely road.
entries.exampleZh: 广阔的戈壁在孤独的道路外延伸数英里。

entries.example: The ancient statue represents a god of the harvest.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古老的雕像代表一位丰收之神。

entries.example: The ring is made of pure gold and looks quite elegant.
entries.exampleZh: 这枚戒指由纯金制成，看起来相当优雅。

entries.example: The golden leaves covered the path in the autumn sunshine.
entries.exampleZh: 金黄的树叶覆盖了秋日阳光下的小路。

entries.example: My little sister feeds her goldfish twice every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早晨给她的金鱼喂两次食。

entries.example: The skilled goldsmith repaired the antique necklace with great care.
entries.exampleZh: 这位技艺娴熟的金匠非常小心地修复了那条古董项链。

entries.meaning: 高尔夫球 vi打高尔夫球
entries.example: My uncle plays golf every Sunday morning at the local club.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔每个星期天早上都在当地俱乐部打高尔夫球。

entries.example: Gondwanaland was an ancient supercontinent that drifted apart millions of years ago.
entries.exampleZh: 冈瓦纳大陆是一块古老的超大陆，在数百万年前分裂漂移开来。

entries.example: The goods were delivered to the warehouse earlier this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 这批货物今天上午早些时候已送到仓库。

entries.example: A wild goose landed on the frozen pond near our house.
entries.exampleZh: 一只野鹅落在我们家附近结冰的池塘上。

entries.example: The hikers paused at the edge of the narrow gorge.
entries.exampleZh: 徒步旅行者在狭窄峡谷的边缘停了下来。

entries.meaning: 华丽的, 灿烂的；漂亮的；令人愉快的；华丽的，灿烂的
entries.example: She wore a gorgeous silk dress to the autumn wedding.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿了一条华丽的丝绸连衣裙去参加那场秋季婚礼。

entries.example: The gorilla sat quietly and watched the visitors at the zoo.
entries.exampleZh: 那只大猩猩安静地坐着，看着动物园里的游客。

entries.example: A tiny gosling followed its mother across the wet grass.
entries.exampleZh: 一只小小的幼鹅跟着妈妈穿过湿漉漉的草地。

entries.meaning: 〈圣经·新约〉福音书；准则，信条；绝对真理；[G-]福音；福音音乐；训示
entries.example: He treated her advice as gospel and never questioned it.
entries.exampleZh: 他把她的建议当作绝对真理，从不质疑。

entries.meaning: 蛛丝，薄纱 a轻而薄的
entries.example: Thin gossamer threads floated through the warm autumn air.
entries.exampleZh: 细细的蛛丝飘浮在温暖的秋日空气中。

entries.meaning: 闲话, 闲谈；传播流言飞语，说长道短；闲话，流言飞语；爱说长道短的人
entries.example: Office gossip spreads faster than any official announcement.
entries.exampleZh: 办公室里的闲话比任何正式通知传得都快。

entries.meaning: 哥特式；哥特式的,野蛮的；哥特式的，哥特风格的；哥特式建筑

entries.meaning: 习惯,习性；习惯；习性，脾性

entries.meaning: 栖息地,住处；自然环境，栖息地

entries.exampleZh: 反复接触使实验室动物产生了适应。

entries.exampleZh: 她在线上会议开始前迅速梳理了头发。

entries.example: He got a short haircut before starting his new job.
entries.exampleZh: 他在开始新工作前理了个短发。

entries.example: Her new hairdo attracted compliments at the office party last Friday.

entries.example: The microscope revealed hairlike cracks across the surface of the ancient stone.

entries.example: Despite his age, my grandfather remains remarkably hale and active.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管年纪大了，我的祖父依然非常强壮且活跃。

entries.example: She ate half the cake before anyone else arrived at the party.
entries.exampleZh: 在其他人到达聚会之前，她吃掉了半个蛋糕。

entries.example: We stopped halfway through the hike to admire the valley below.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在徒步途中停下来欣赏下方的山谷。

entries.example: Geologists found thick layers of halite beneath the dry desert basin.
entries.exampleZh: 地质学家在干燥的沙漠盆地下面发现了厚厚的岩盐层。

entries.example: The graduation ceremony will take place in the main hall tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 毕业典礼将于明天上午在大礼堂举行。

entries.example: Careful attention to detail is a hallmark of her finest work.
entries.exampleZh: 对细节的细心关注是她最优秀作品的一个特点。

entries.meaning: 停止,暂停；停止,使立定；停住，停下；停止，阻止；暂停

entries.exampleZh: 突如其来的暴风雨使建筑工程完全停了下来。

entries.example: The company plans to halve its carbon emissions within the next decade.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划在未来十年内将碳排放量减半。

entries.example: Mr. Hamlin accepted the award on behalf of his entire research team.
entries.exampleZh: 哈姆林先生代表整个研究团队接受了该奖项。

entries.meaning: 槌,锤子 v锤击；锤打；锤，槌；锤子

entries.exampleZh: 他用一把重锤把木桩敲进地里。

entries.meaning: 锤头 a锤头状的, 鲁钝的

entries.exampleZh: 昨天潜水员看到一条锤头鲨在珊瑚礁附近游动。

entries.meaning: 妨碍, 牵制；妨碍，阻挠；大篮子

entries.exampleZh: 交通拥堵可能会妨碍我们按时到达机场。

entries.meaning: 汉普郡(英国南部之一郡)

entries.exampleZh: 他们花了一个安静的周末探索汉普郡乡间的村庄。

entries.example: The new employee read the safety handbook before starting work on Monday.
entries.exampleZh: 新员工在周一开始工作前阅读了安全手册。

entries.example: The market sells traditional handcraft made by women in nearby villages.
entries.exampleZh: 这个市场出售附近村庄妇女制作的传统手工艺品。

entries.example: Researchers studied the children's handedness before testing their coordination skills.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员在测试协调能力之前研究了这些儿童惯用左手还是右手。

entries.example: The worker replaced the damaged hander on the drill press.
entries.exampleZh: 工人在钻床上更换了损坏的夹头。

entries.meaning: 一把, 少数；一把；少数人
entries.example: Only a handful of guests attended the reception after the ceremony.
entries.exampleZh: 只有少数客人参加了仪式后的招待会。

entries.example: His shyness proved a serious handicap when he began teaching.
entries.exampleZh: 他开始教书时，害羞成了严重的障碍。

entries.example: The village is famous for its traditional handicraft and woven baskets.
entries.exampleZh: 这个村庄以其传统手工艺和编织篮子而闻名。

entries.meaning: 处理,操作；处理；对待；操纵；触，摸；柄，把手，拉手
entries.example: She struggled to handle the pressure during the final examination week.
entries.exampleZh: 她在期末考试周期间难以应对压力。

entries.example: The artisan sold handmade leather bags at the weekend market.
entries.exampleZh: 这位工匠在周末市场上出售手工皮包。

entries.example: He looked handsome in the dark suit he wore to the ceremony.
entries.exampleZh: 他穿着去参加典礼的深色西装看起来很英俊。

entries.example: The company rewarded its most loyal employees handsomely last winter.
entries.exampleZh: 公司去年冬天慷慨地奖励了最忠诚的员工。

entries.meaning: 可用的；易使用的，便利的；手巧的
entries.example: A small flashlight is handy during unexpected power cuts at night.
entries.exampleZh: 夜间意外停电时，小手电筒很方便。

entries.example: Please hang your wet coat on the hook by the door.
entries.exampleZh: 请把湿外套挂在门边的钩子上。

entries.example: Many city workers hanker for a quieter life in the countryside.
entries.exampleZh: 许多城市上班族渴望乡村更安静的生活。

entries.meaning: 偶然的，任意的；无计划的，无秩序的
entries.example: Their haphazard filing system made important documents difficult to find.
entries.exampleZh: 他们杂乱无章的文件系统使重要文件难以找到。

entries.example: Books and papers were piled haphazardly across the entire office floor.
entries.exampleZh: 书本和文件随意地堆放在整个办公室地板上。

entries.example: Nobody knows what will happen after the manager announces the new policy.
entries.exampleZh: 没有人知道经理宣布新政策后会发生什么。

entries.example: The children played happily in the garden until the sun went down.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在花园里愉快地玩耍，直到太阳落山。

entries.example: True happiness often comes from close friendships rather than expensive possessions.
entries.exampleZh: 真正的幸福往往来自亲密的友谊，而不是昂贵的财产。

entries.example: She felt happy when her old friend called from abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 当老朋友从国外打来电话时，她感到高兴。

entries.example: Several fishing boats returned to the harbor before the storm arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 几艘渔船在暴风雨来临前返回了港口。

entries.meaning: 硬的,困难的；努力地,强烈地
entries.example: The exam was hard, but every student finished before the bell rang.
entries.exampleZh: 考试很难，但每个学生都在铃响前完成了。

entries.example: Repeated failures can harden a young person against future risks.
entries.exampleZh: 反复的失败会使年轻人面对未来风险时变得坚强。

entries.meaning: 几乎不,刚刚；几乎不，简直不；刚刚，仅仅
entries.example: I could hardly hear the speaker at the back of the hall.
entries.exampleZh: 在礼堂后排，我几乎听不见演讲者的声音。

entries.example: The hardness of the diamond surprised even the experienced jeweler.
entries.exampleZh: 这颗钻石的硬度甚至让经验丰富的珠宝商都感到惊讶。

entries.example: Many families faced great hardship during the long winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 许多家庭在漫长的冬季里经历了巨大的困苦。

entries.meaning: 五金器具；五金制品，金属制品；硬件
entries.example: The store sells tools, paint and other hardware for home repairs.
entries.exampleZh: 这家商店出售工具、油漆和其他家庭维修用的五金制品。

entries.example: Oak is a sturdy hardwood often used for making fine furniture.
entries.exampleZh: 橡木是一种结实的硬木，常用于制作精美的家具。

entries.meaning: 努力工作的, 勤奋的
entries.example: She is a hardworking student who rarely misses a single class.
entries.exampleZh: 她是个勤奋的学生，很少缺一节课。

entries.meaning: 能吃苦耐劳的，坚强的；强壮的；耐寒的；能吃苦耐劳的
entries.example: These hardy plants survive the cold winters without any special care.
entries.exampleZh: 这些耐寒的植物无需任何特别照料就能熬过寒冷的冬天。

entries.example: A hare dashed across the field and vanished into the tall grass.
entries.exampleZh: 一只野兔掠过田野，消失在深草丛中。

entries.meaning: （伊斯兰教教徒之）闺房, 为一个雄性动物所控制的许多雌性动物
entries.example: The painting shows a quiet courtyard inside an ancient harem.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅画描绘了一座古老后宫里的安静庭院。

entries.example: Many famous jazz musicians began their careers in Harlem clubs.
entries.exampleZh: 许多著名的爵士音乐家都是在哈莱姆的俱乐部里开始他们的职业生涯的。

entries.example: Loud music can harm your hearing if you listen too long.
entries.exampleZh: 如果听的时间太长，大声的音乐会损害你的听力。

entries.example: Smoking is harmful to your health, doctors warn again and again.
entries.exampleZh: 医生一再警告，吸烟有害健康。

entries.example: The chemicals were harmfully dumped into the river by the factory.
entries.exampleZh: 那些化学品被那家工厂有害地倾倒进了河里。

entries.example: Most spiders in this region are completely harmless to humans.
entries.exampleZh: 这个地区的大多数蜘蛛对人类完全无害。

entries.example: The violin's harmonic rang softly above the orchestra's final chord.
entries.exampleZh: 小提琴的泛音在乐队最后的和弦上方轻轻回荡。

entries.meaning: 和谐的, 和睦的；和谐的，协调的；和睦的，融洽的
entries.example: Their harmonious teamwork made the difficult project a genuine success.
entries.exampleZh: 他们和谐的合作使这个艰难的项目取得了真正的成功。

entries.meaning: 协调,融洽；和声；和谐，融洽，协调；相符，一致
entries.example: The choir sang in perfect harmony throughout the entire evening concert.
entries.exampleZh: 合唱团整场晚间音乐会都唱得和谐完美。

entries.meaning: 马具；治理，束以马具；利用…产生动力；给上挽具

entries.exampleZh: 农民利用风能把井水抽上来。

entries.example: The old harper played a gentle tune by the fireplace.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老竖琴师在壁炉旁弹奏着一支轻柔的曲子。

entries.example: She practiced a baroque piece on the harpsichord every afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 她每天下午都用大键琴练习一首巴洛克乐曲。

entries.meaning: 粗糙的,严厉的；恶劣的，严酷的；刺耳的；粗糙的，毛糙的

entries.exampleZh: 法官严厉的言辞让法庭上的每个人都感到惊讶。

entries.example: The manager spoke harshly to the staff who arrived late again.
entries.exampleZh: 经理严厉地训斥了那些又迟到的员工。

entries.exampleZh: 冬天的严酷让新来的定居者感到意外。

entries.exampleZh: 一头雄赤鹿从薄雾中走出，静静地站着。

entries.exampleZh: 她在哈佛学习法律，之后加入了波士顿的一家律师事务所。

entries.example: Farmers expect a rich harvest after the long rainy season.
entries.exampleZh: 农民们预计在漫长的雨季之后会有一个丰收。

entries.example: The large harvester moved slowly across the golden field.
entries.exampleZh: 那台大型收割机缓缓驶过金黄色的田野。

entries.meaning: 匆忙, 急忙；赶快，匆忙；急忙，急速，匆忙

entries.exampleZh: 她匆忙之中忘了锁办公室的门。

entries.example: He wore a straw hat while working in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 他在花园里干活时戴着一顶草帽。

entries.meaning: 孵化 vt孵出, 策划；孵化，孵出；开口；舱门

entries.exampleZh: 这些蛋大约经过三周的温暖就会孵化。

entries.example: The hatchery releases thousands of young fish into the river.
entries.exampleZh: 这家孵卵所把成千上万条幼鱼放流到河里。

entries.example: He split the small logs with a rusty hatchet.
entries.exampleZh: 他用一把生锈的短柄斧劈开了那些小木柴。

entries.example: The tiny hatchling stayed close to its mother all day.
entries.exampleZh: 那只小小的幼雏整天紧挨着母亲。

entries.exampleZh: 他们不得不把沉重的船拖上沙滩。

entries.exampleZh: 那个夏天的旧日回忆至今仍在夜里萦绕着她。

entries.exampleZh: 这个小海湾成了渔船的安全避风港。

entries.exampleZh: 这场风暴在该国北部造成了巨大的破坏。

entries.example: They spent two weeks in Hawaii learning to surf.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在夏威夷待了两周学习冲浪。

entries.meaning: 鹰；鹰，隼；主战分子；叫卖，兜售
entries.example: A hawk circled above the field, searching for small animals.
entries.exampleZh: 一只鹰在田野上空盘旋，寻找小动物。

entries.example: The farmer stored dry hay in the barn for winter.
entries.exampleZh: 农民把干草储存在谷仓里以备过冬。

entries.meaning: 危险 vt冒…风险；危险；风险；尝试着做；冒…风险，使处于危险

entries.exampleZh: 海岸附近的大雾对小船来说是严重的危险。

entries.example: Working with old asbestos can be hazardous to your lungs.
entries.exampleZh: 处理旧石棉可能对你的肺有害。

entries.example: Her eyes were a striking hazel that drew attention across the room.
entries.exampleZh: 她的眼睛是引人注目的绿褐色，在房间里格外吸引目光。

entries.example: He turned his head slowly to follow the sound of footsteps.
entries.exampleZh: 他慢慢转过头，跟随脚步声的方向。

entries.example: The report's main heading was printed in large bold letters.
entries.exampleZh: 报告的主标题用大号粗体字印出。

entries.example: The company plans to headquarter its new division in Singapore.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划将其新部门总部设在新加坡。

entries.example: Time and rest can heal minor wounds more effectively than worry.
entries.exampleZh: 时间和休息比担忧更能有效治愈小伤口。

entries.example: The village healer used herbs and warm compresses to treat patients.
entries.exampleZh: 村里的医治者用草药和温热敷布治疗病人。

entries.meaning: 有治疗功用的；康复，治疗；复原
entries.example: The healing process took several weeks after the serious injury.
entries.exampleZh: 严重受伤后，康复过程花了几个星期。

entries.example: Regular exercise and enough sleep are essential for good health.
entries.exampleZh: 规律锻炼和充足睡眠对良好健康至关重要。

entries.example: A healthful diet includes fresh vegetables, whole grains, and clean water.
entries.exampleZh: 有益健康的饮食包括新鲜蔬菜、全谷物和干净的水。

entries.example: She stays healthy by walking daily and avoiding too much sugar.
entries.exampleZh: 她每天散步并避免摄入过多糖分，从而保持健康。

entries.example: I can hear the distant train from my bedroom window.
entries.exampleZh: 我能从卧室窗户听到远处的火车声。

entries.example: The court ignored the hearsay and focused on the physical evidence.
entries.exampleZh: 法庭忽略了传闻，专注于物证。

entries.example: Her heart raced as she stepped onto the stage.
entries.exampleZh: 她走上舞台时心跳加速。

entries.example: The doctor listened to the baby's heartbeat with great care.
entries.exampleZh: 医生非常仔细地听了婴儿的心跳。

entries.example: The sudden loss brought heartbreak to the entire small community.
entries.exampleZh: 突然的失去给整个小社区带来了心碎。

entries.meaning: 壁炉地面, 家庭（生活）
entries.example: They sat by the warm hearth and shared stories late at night.
entries.exampleZh: 他们坐在温暖的壁炉边，深夜分享故事。

entries.example: The small heater kept the drafty room warm during winter.
entries.exampleZh: 冬天，小加热器让漏风的房间保持温暖。

entries.example: With a mighty heave, they pushed the heavy box onto the truck.
entries.exampleZh: 他们用力一抬，把沉重的箱子推上了卡车。

entries.example: The heavy rain forced the organizers to postpone the outdoor concert until next weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨迫使组织者把户外音乐会推迟到下一个周末。

entries.example: The farmer plans to plant wheat across every hectare of his newly purchased land.
entries.exampleZh: 这位农民计划在他新购置的每一公顷土地上种小麦。

entries.meaning: 用篱笆围；避免直接回答；树篱；防止损失的措施；防备
entries.example: They planted a thick hedge along the driveway to block the view from the road.
entries.exampleZh: 他们沿车道种了一道厚树篱，以挡住路上的视线。

entries.example: The hikers failed to heed the warning about sudden storms in the valley.
entries.exampleZh: 徒步者没有留意关于山谷中突发暴雨的警告。

entries.example: She felt a sharp pain in her heel after running the long race.
entries.exampleZh: 跑完那场长跑后，她感到脚后跟一阵剧痛。

entries.example: The tower's impressive height makes it visible from several neighboring towns.
entries.exampleZh: 这座塔令人印象深刻的高度使它从几个邻近城镇都能看见。

entries.example: The new security measures may heighten tensions between the two communities.
entries.exampleZh: 新的安全措施可能会加剧两个社区之间的紧张关系。

entries.example: A rescue helicopter arrived within minutes and lifted the injured climber to safety.
entries.exampleZh: 一架救援直升机几分钟内赶到，把受伤的登山者吊运到安全处。

entries.example: Scientists used liquid helium to cool the sensitive instruments inside the experimental chamber.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家用液氦冷却实验舱内的精密仪器。

entries.example: A volunteer helper guided the elderly visitors through the crowded exhibition hall.
entries.exampleZh: 一名志愿者助手引导老年参观者穿过拥挤的展厅。

entries.example: Her helpful advice saved me hours of confusion during the application process.
entries.exampleZh: 她的有益建议在申请过程中为我省去了数小时的困惑。

entries.example: Without proper tools, the stranded sailors felt completely helpless against the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 没有合适的工具，被困的水手面对风暴感到完全无助。

entries.example: She watched helplessly as the rising floodwater swallowed the family's small vegetable garden.
entries.exampleZh: 她无助地看着上涨的洪水吞没了家里的小菜园。

entries.example: A deep sense of helplessness washed over him as the deadline approached.
entries.exampleZh: 随着截止日期临近，一种深深的无助感涌上他的心头。

entries.example: She sewed a neat hem along the bottom of the old curtains.
entries.exampleZh: 她沿着旧窗帘的底部缝了一道整齐的边。

entries.example: The northern hemisphere receives more sunlight during its summer months.
entries.exampleZh: 北半球在夏季获得更多阳光。

entries.example: The hikers avoided the tall hemlock because its sap can be poisonous.
entries.exampleZh: 徒步者避开了那棵高大的铁杉，因为它的汁液可能有毒。

entries.meaning: 大麻；由大麻制成的麻醉药
entries.example: The factory uses hemp fibers to produce strong, sustainable ropes and fabrics.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂用大麻纤维生产结实的可持续绳索和织物。

entries.example: The bridge was closed for repairs; hence, all traffic must take a longer route.
entries.exampleZh: 这座桥因维修而关闭；因此，所有车辆必须走更长的路线。

entries.meaning: 今后,自此以后；从此以后
entries.example: All staff must, henceforth, wear identification badges inside every company building.
entries.exampleZh: 今后，所有员工在每栋公司大楼内都必须佩戴身份徽章。

entries.example: Henderson will take over the department when the manager retires next month.
entries.exampleZh: 亨德森将在经理下个月退休后接管这个部门。

entries.meaning: 使者；预报, 标志；预示；宣布，宣告；信使；预示，预兆
entries.example: The herald announced the king's arrival at the castle gates.
entries.exampleZh: 传令官在城堡大门前宣布了国王的到来。

entries.meaning: 药草, 香草；药草，香草；草本植物
entries.example: Add a little fresh herb to the sauce before serving it.
entries.exampleZh: 上菜前在酱汁里加一点新鲜的香草。

entries.example: The garden is filled with herbaceous plants that bloom in early summer.
entries.exampleZh: 花园里长满了在初夏开花的草本植物。

entries.example: Farmers here avoid using herbicide near the river to protect the fish.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的农民避免在河边使用除草剂，以保护鱼类。

entries.example: A deer is a herbivore that feeds mainly on grass and leaves.
entries.exampleZh: 鹿是食草动物，主要以草和树叶为食。

entries.meaning: 极困难的,需要大力气的
entries.example: Moving the piano upstairs alone was a herculean effort for him.
entries.exampleZh: 独自把钢琴搬上楼对他来说是一项极其艰巨的体力活。

entries.meaning: 兽群；使集中，把…赶在一起；放牧；成群，聚集；牧群，兽群；人群，芸芸众生
entries.example: The farmer drove the herd of cattle across the narrow bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 农夫赶着牛群穿过那座窄桥。

entries.example: Please leave your wet umbrella here by the door.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的湿雨伞放在这里的门边。

entries.meaning: 世袭的,遗传的；遗传的；可继承的，世袭的
entries.example: The disease is hereditary and affects several members of his family.
entries.exampleZh: 这种疾病是遗传性的，影响了他家好几位成员。

entries.example: Scientists studied heredity to explain why the trait appeared so often.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家研究遗传，以解释这种特征为何如此频繁出现。

entries.example: The terms described herein apply to all users of this service.
entries.exampleZh: 此处所述的条款适用于本服务的所有使用者。

entries.meaning: 遗产, 继承权；遗产；传统
entries.example: The old temple is part of our national heritage and must be preserved.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古庙是我们民族遗产的一部分，必须加以保护。

entries.meaning: 密封的, 与外界隔绝的
entries.example: The samples were kept in a hermetic container to prevent contamination.
entries.exampleZh: 样品被保存在密封容器中以防污染。

entries.example: An old hermit lived alone in a cave above the quiet village.
entries.exampleZh: 一位年老的隐士独自住在安静村庄上方的洞穴里。

entries.example: The young firefighter became a local hero after the rescue.
entries.exampleZh: 那位年轻的消防员在救援之后成了当地的英雄。

entries.example: She made a heroic attempt to save the drowning child.
entries.exampleZh: 她英勇地尝试救起那名溺水的孩子。

entries.meaning: 英雄品质, 英雄主义
entries.example: His quiet heroism during the crisis impressed everyone at the hospital.
entries.exampleZh: 他在危机期间默默无闻的英雄气概让医院里的每个人都很敬佩。

entries.example: Smoked herring is a traditional breakfast dish in some countries.
entries.exampleZh: 熏鲱鱼在一些国家是一种传统的早餐菜肴。

entries.example: She taught herself to play the guitar during the long winter.
entries.exampleZh: 她在漫长的冬天里自学弹吉他。

entries.meaning: 迟疑的, 犹豫不定的；犹豫的，吞吞吐吐的，犹豫不定的
entries.example: She remained hesitant about signing the contract until the final details were clarified.
entries.exampleZh: 在最终细节澄清之前，她对签署合同仍犹豫不决。

entries.example: Please do not hesitate to ask if you need further assistance with the form.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你需要有关这份表格的进一步帮助，请不要犹豫，尽管提问。

entries.example: The conference attracted a heterogeneous group of experts from several unrelated industries.
entries.exampleZh: 这次会议吸引了一群来自几个互不相关行业的多元化专家。

entries.example: Each tile in the mosaic was shaped like a small blue hexagon.
entries.exampleZh: 马赛克中的每块瓷砖都呈一个小蓝色六边形。

entries.example: The beekeeper carefully examined the hexagonal cells inside the wooden frame.
entries.exampleZh: 养蜂人仔细检查了木框内的六角形巢房。

entries.example: In its heyday, the factory employed nearly two thousand local workers.
entries.exampleZh: 在全盛时期，这家工厂雇用了近两千名当地工人。

entries.example: Some mountain bears hibernate in caves throughout the coldest winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 一些山熊会在最寒冷的冬季几个月里在洞穴中冬眠。

entries.meaning: 过冬, 冬眠, 避寒；冬眠；休眠，蛰伏
entries.example: Long hibernation allows certain animals to survive seasons with very little food.
entries.exampleZh: 长时间的冬眠使某些动物能够在食物极少的季节中存活。

entries.example: A sudden hiccup interrupted his speech and made the audience laugh.
entries.exampleZh: 一个突然的打嗝打断了他的演讲，引得观众发笑。

entries.meaning: 躲藏,隐瞒；躲藏；掩藏；掩盖；兽皮
entries.example: The children tried to hide behind the sofa when their father came home.
entries.exampleZh: 父亲回家时，孩子们试图躲到沙发后面。

entries.meaning: 等级制度；统治集团；等级制度；阶层
entries.example: The company's rigid hierarchy often prevents junior staff from sharing new ideas.
entries.exampleZh: 公司僵化的等级制度常常使初级员工无法分享新想法。

entries.meaning: 僧侣的, 僧侣用的；僧侣的；
entries.example: The museum displayed several hieratic scripts written by ancient Egyptian priests.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了几份由古埃及祭司书写的僧侣体文字。

entries.meaning: 象形文字, 图画文字；象形文字，象形符号
entries.example: One carved hieroglyph on the stone wall remains a complete mystery to scholars.
entries.exampleZh: 石墙上刻着的一个象形文字对学者们来说仍是一个未解之谜。

entries.example: The linguist spent years deciphering a single hieroglyphic on the temple wall.
entries.exampleZh: 这位语言学家花了数年时间破译神庙墙上的一个象形文字。

entries.example: The highland offers cool air and stunning views during the summer season.
entries.exampleZh: 这片高地在夏季提供凉爽的空气和迷人的景色。

entries.meaning: 强调，突出；以强烈光线照射；最精彩部分
entries.example: The highlight of the trip was watching the sunrise over the calm sea.
entries.exampleZh: 这次旅行最精彩的部分是在平静的海面上观看日出。

entries.example: A long highway connects the remote village to the nearest coastal city.
entries.exampleZh: 一条长长的公路将偏远村庄与最近的海滨城市连接起来。

entries.meaning: 徒步旅行；徒步旅行，远足
entries.example: We plan to hike through the forest before the weather turns cold.
entries.exampleZh: 我们计划在天气转冷之前徒步穿过森林。

entries.example: A small stone house stands on the hill above the quiet village.
entries.exampleZh: 一座小石屋坐落在安静村庄上方的小山上。

entries.meaning: 山地内部的贫农,乡下人
entries.example: The novel portrays a proud hillbilly who refuses to leave his mountain home.
entries.exampleZh: 这部小说描绘了一个拒绝离开山间家园的骄傲乡下人。

entries.example: A small stone cottage stood on the sunny hillside above the valley.
entries.exampleZh: 一座小石屋坐落在山谷上方阳光充足的山坡上。

entries.example: The hilly countryside made cycling far more tiring than we expected.
entries.exampleZh: 多坡的乡野让骑车比我们预想的累得多。

entries.example: I handed him the keys and quietly left the room.
entries.exampleZh: 我把钥匙递给他，然后悄悄地离开了房间。

entries.example: Snow covers the highest peaks of the Himalaya throughout the year.
entries.exampleZh: 积雪终年覆盖着喜马拉雅山脉最高的几座山峰。

entries.example: He repaired the old bicycle himself without any help.
entries.exampleZh: 他没有任何人帮忙，自己修好了那辆旧自行车。

entries.meaning: 后边的,后面的；后面的，在后的
entries.example: The horse injured one hind leg while jumping over the fence.
entries.exampleZh: 那匹马在跳过栅栏时伤了一条后腿。

entries.meaning: 阻碍, 打扰；阻碍，妨碍
entries.example: Heavy rain may hinder our progress along the mountain trail.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨可能会妨碍我们沿山间小径前行。

entries.example: One rusty hinge on the gate squeaked loudly every time it opened.
entries.exampleZh: 门上有一个生锈的铰链，每次打开都会吱吱作响。

entries.meaning: 暗示, 线索；暗示，示意；暗示，提示；
entries.example: She gave no hint about what she planned to say.
entries.exampleZh: 她丝毫没有暗示自己打算说些什么。

entries.meaning: 内地, 穷乡僻壤；内地，腹地；内地贸易区
entries.example: Few tourists ever travel deep into the hinterland of that country.
entries.exampleZh: 很少有游客深入那个国家的内地旅行。

entries.example: A hippopotamus floated quietly in the muddy river beside our camp.
entries.exampleZh: 一只河马静静地浮在我们营地旁浑浊的河水里。

entries.example: They decided to hire a small boat for the afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 他们决定租一条小船用一个下午。

entries.example: The museum displays Hispanic art from several centuries ago.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了几个世纪前的西班牙艺术。

entries.meaning: 嘶嘶作声, 用嘘声表示
entries.example: The snake began to hiss loudly when we approached its cage.
entries.exampleZh: 当我们靠近笼子时，那条蛇开始大声发出嘶嘶声。

entries.example: A local historian explained the origins of the ruined abbey.
entries.exampleZh: 一位当地历史学家讲解了这座废弃修道院的由来。

entries.meaning: 有历史意义的, 历史的
entries.example: Their historic victory was celebrated across the entire nation.
entries.exampleZh: 他们具有历史意义的胜利在全国各地受到庆祝。

entries.example: This region was historically famous for its salt and wool trade.
entries.exampleZh: 这个地区在历史上以盐和羊毛贸易闻名。

entries.example: The ball hit the window and shattered the glass instantly.
entries.exampleZh: 球撞到窗户上，立刻把玻璃打碎了。

entries.meaning: 搭便车；提起，拉起；拴住；故障，障碍
entries.example: A technical hitch delayed the launch of the new system.
entries.exampleZh: 一个小小的技术故障推迟了新系统的启用。

entries.example: The treaty has hitherto been respected by both neighboring countries.
entries.exampleZh: 迄今为止，两个邻国都遵守了这项条约。

entries.meaning: 蜂房；(使)入蜂箱, 群居；入蜂箱；群居；蜂箱，蜂房；闹市，忙碌之地
entries.example: A loud buzz came from the hive hidden behind the old barn.
entries.exampleZh: 一阵响亮的嗡嗡声从旧谷仓后面的蜂箱里传来。

entries.example: Some people hoard old newspapers for reasons they cannot explain.
entries.exampleZh: 有些人囤积旧报纸，原因他们自己也说不清。

entries.example: Photography became a serious hobby for her after she retired last spring.
entries.exampleZh: 摄影在她去年春天退休后成了她的一项严肃爱好。

entries.example: The children played hockey on the frozen pond until darkness fell.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在结冰的池塘上打曲棍球，直到天黑。

entries.example: The gardener left a rusty hoe beside the fence after sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 园丁在日落之后把一把生锈的锄头留在栅栏旁。

entries.example: Archaeologists found hohokam pottery near the dry riverbed last summer.
entries.exampleZh: 考古学家去年夏天在干涸的河床附近发现了霍霍坎文化的陶器。

entries.example: The current holder of the trophy will speak at tonight's ceremony.
entries.exampleZh: 当前奖杯持有者将在今晚的仪式上发言。

entries.example: The company reported a small holding in the local bank.
entries.exampleZh: 该公司报告称其持有当地银行的一小部分股份。

entries.example: A small hole in the roof let rainwater into the attic.
entries.exampleZh: 屋顶上的一个小洞让雨水漏进了阁楼。

entries.example: They spent their holiday exploring quiet villages along the southern coast.
entries.exampleZh: 他们假期里沿着南部海岸探索安静的村庄。

entries.meaning: 整体的，全面的；功能整体性的
entries.example: The doctor recommended a holistic approach to managing stress and sleep.
entries.exampleZh: 医生建议采用整体方法来管理压力和睡眠。

entries.example: The cheese imported from holland arrived in wooden crates yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 从荷兰进口的奶酪昨天用木箱运到了。

entries.meaning: 洞, 窟窿；挖空,弄凹；空心的，中空的；凹陷的；空洞的，虚伪的；沉闷的，；挖空，凿空
entries.example: The old tree sounded hollow when we knocked on its trunk.
entries.exampleZh: 我们敲那棵老树的树干时，它听起来是空心的。

entries.example: Many tourists visit hollywood hoping to see a famous actor.
entries.exampleZh: 许多游客前往好莱坞，希望能见到一位著名演员。

entries.example: A lonely holm rose from the calm lake near our cabin.
entries.exampleZh: 一座孤零零的小岛从我们小屋附近的平静湖面升起。

entries.example: Scientists studied holocene sediments to understand ancient climate changes in the region.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家研究了全新世的沉积物，以了解该地区古代的气候变化。

entries.example: Pilgrims walked barefoot toward the holy shrine at dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 朝圣者赤脚走向黎明时分的神圣神龛。

entries.example: The film pays warm homage to silent comedies of the past.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影向过去的无声喜剧致以温暖的敬意。

entries.example: Their new home stands beside a quiet park near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的新家坐落在河边一个安静的公园旁。

entries.example: She returned to her homeland after twenty years abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 她在国外生活二十年后回到了祖国。

entries.meaning: 无家的, 无家可归的
entries.example: The storm left many families homeless and in urgent need of shelter.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨使许多家庭无家可归，急需住所。

entries.example: Her homely cooking makes the plainest ingredients taste warm and generous.
entries.exampleZh: 她家常的饭菜让最普通的食材也变得温暖而丰盛。

entries.example: As a full-time homemaker, she manages the household with remarkable patience and skill.
entries.exampleZh: 作为全职主妇，她以非凡的耐心和娴熟的技巧打理着这个家。

entries.example: The magazine offers practical advice on homemaking for young couples.
entries.exampleZh: 这本杂志为年轻夫妇提供实用的家政建议。

entries.example: Unlike a lizard, a homeotherm maintains a steady body temperature in cold weather.
entries.exampleZh: 与蜥蜴不同，恒温动物在寒冷天气中也能保持稳定的体温。

entries.example: Rising prices have made homeownership an impossible dream for many young workers.
entries.exampleZh: 不断上涨的房价让许多年轻劳动者觉得拥有住房成了不可能实现的梦想。

entries.example: After three weeks abroad, she grew homesick for her mother's cooking.
entries.exampleZh: 在国外待了三周后，她开始想念母亲做的饭菜。

entries.example: She wore a warm coat made of coarse homespun from the village.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿着一件用村里粗糙的手织物做成的暖和外衣。

entries.meaning: 家宅，宅基；家宅，农庄；宅地
entries.example: Their family homestead has stood on this prairie for four generations.
entries.exampleZh: 他们家的农庄已经在这片草原上矗立了四代。

entries.meaning: 农场所有权人, 自耕农
entries.example: The homesteader built a small cabin before the first winter arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 那位自耕农在第一个冬天到来之前盖起了一间小屋。

entries.example: He returned to his hometown after twenty years in the city.
entries.exampleZh: 在城里生活二十年后，他回到了故乡。

entries.example: She finished her maths homework before dinner and then watched television.
entries.exampleZh: 她在晚饭前完成了数学作业，然后看了电视。

entries.example: Scientists studied the homing instinct that guides pigeons across vast distances.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家研究了引导鸽子跨越遥远距离的归巢本能。

entries.meaning: 原始人类；灵长目的；原始人类；人科动物
entries.example: This hominid skull suggests our ancestors walked upright three million years ago.
entries.exampleZh: 这块原始人类头骨表明，我们的祖先三百万年前就已直立行走。

entries.example: In classical Latin, homo referred to any human being, regardless of gender.
entries.exampleZh: 在古典拉丁语中，该词泛指任何人类个体，不分性别。

entries.meaning: 同质的,相似的；同类的，相似的，同质的
entries.example: The mixture must remain homogeneous before it is poured into the mold.
entries.exampleZh: 混合物在倒入模具之前必须保持均匀。

entries.example: The novel explores homosexuality with unusual tenderness and honesty.
entries.exampleZh: 这部小说以不同寻常的温柔与诚实探讨了同性恋。

entries.example: The barber kept a smooth hone beside his leather strop.
entries.exampleZh: 理发师在他那条磨刀皮带旁放着一块光滑的磨刀石。

entries.example: Please give me an honest answer, even if it hurts.
entries.exampleZh: 请给我一个诚实的回答，哪怕它让人难受。

entries.example: She spread thick honey on warm bread and poured some tea.
entries.exampleZh: 她把厚厚的蜂蜜抹在温热的面包上，又倒了点茶。

entries.example: A single honeybee can visit hundreds of flowers in one busy day.
entries.exampleZh: 一只蜜蜂在忙碌的一天里可以拜访数百朵花。

entries.example: The beekeeper lifted a golden honeycomb from the wooden frame.
entries.exampleZh: 养蜂人从木框里提起一块金黄色的蜂巢。

entries.example: It was a great honor to introduce the guest speaker.
entries.exampleZh: 介绍这位嘉宾演讲者是我极大的荣幸。

entries.example: Volunteering at the shelter was an honorable way to spend her free time.
entries.exampleZh: 在收容所做志愿者是她度过空闲时间的一种光荣方式。

entries.example: The blacksmith carefully examined the injured hoof of the farm horse.
entries.exampleZh: 铁匠仔细检查了农场那匹马受伤的蹄子。

entries.meaning: 钩；钩住；连接到无线电设备；勾住；钩，吊钩；钩状物
entries.example: He hung his wet coat on a metal hook by the door.
entries.exampleZh: 他把湿外套挂在门边的一个金属钩上。

entries.meaning: 跳跃, 单脚跳；单足跳行；齐足跳行；跳上；蹦跳；短程旅行
entries.example: The rabbit took a quick hop and disappeared behind the tall grass.
entries.exampleZh: 兔子迅速跳了一下，消失在高高的草丛后面。

entries.example: We still hope the weather will improve before the picnic begins.
entries.exampleZh: 我们仍然希望天气在野餐开始前会好转。

entries.example: After hours of searching, they felt hopeless about finding the missing keys.
entries.exampleZh: 找了几个小时后，他们对找到丢失的钥匙感到绝望。

entries.example: The Hopewell people built large mounds in the Ohio Valley.
entries.exampleZh: 霍普韦尔人在俄亥俄谷地建造了大型土丘。

entries.example: The young hopper balanced carefully on one leg during the race.
entries.exampleZh: 那个年轻的单足跳者在比赛中小心地用一条腿保持平衡。

entries.meaning: 游牧部落；一大群人；游牧部落
entries.example: A horde of tourists crowded the narrow street during the festival.
entries.exampleZh: 节日期间，一大群游客挤满了狭窄的街道。

entries.example: The sun sank slowly below the horizon, painting the sky orange.
entries.exampleZh: 太阳缓缓沉入地平线以下，把天空染成橙色。

entries.meaning: 地平线的, 水平的；水平的；与地面平行的
entries.example: Draw a horizontal line across the page before writing your name.
entries.exampleZh: 写名字之前，先在页面上画一条水平线。

entries.example: The doctor explained that hormonal changes can affect mood and sleep.
entries.exampleZh: 医生解释说，激素变化会影响情绪和睡眠。

entries.meaning: 荷尔蒙,激素；激素，荷尔蒙
entries.example: This gland produces a hormone that controls growth during childhood.
entries.exampleZh: 这个腺体产生一种在童年时期控制生长的激素。

entries.meaning: 触角；强行介入；角；号角，喇叭
entries.example: The driver sounded the horn twice before entering the tunnel.
entries.exampleZh: 司机在进入隧道前按了两次喇叭。

entries.example: The rider guided the horse gently along the sandy path.
entries.exampleZh: 骑手轻轻地引导马沿着沙路前行。

entries.meaning: 马背, 隆起的条状地带
entries.example: She explored the mountain trails on horseback with a local guide.
entries.exampleZh: 她在当地向导的陪同下骑马探索山间小径。

entries.example: A large horsefly buzzed around the stable and startled the mare.
entries.exampleZh: 一只大马蝇在马厩周围嗡嗡飞，把母马吓了一跳。

entries.example: This old tractor still delivers enough horsepower to pull heavy loads uphill.
entries.exampleZh: 这台旧拖拉机仍然能提供足够的马力把重物拉上坡。

entries.example: A rusty horseshoe above the doorway is said to bring good luck.
entries.exampleZh: 据说门道上方的生锈马蹄铁能带来好运。

entries.example: The town hosts a large horticultural show every summer in the park.
entries.exampleZh: 这个镇每年夏天都在公园举办大型园艺展览。

entries.example: My aunt, a skilled horticulturalist, grows rare roses in her garden.
entries.exampleZh: 我的姑妈是一位技艺娴熟的园艺家，在花园里种植珍稀玫瑰。

entries.example: She studied horticulture for years before starting her own small nursery.
entries.exampleZh: 她在创办自己的小型苗圃之前学习了多年园艺。

entries.meaning: 好客的, 宜人的；宜人的；好客的，殷勤的；开通的
entries.example: Our neighbors were incredibly hospitable and invited us to dinner immediately.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的邻居非常热情好客，立刻邀请我们共进晚餐。

entries.example: The nearest hospital is about twenty minutes away by car.
entries.exampleZh: 最近的医院开车大约二十分钟。

entries.example: Doctors may hospitalize patients with severe symptoms for closer observation.
entries.exampleZh: 医生可能会让症状严重的病人住院以便更密切观察。

entries.example: Our host greeted every guest warmly at the front door.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的主人在前门热情地迎接每一位客人。

entries.meaning: 敌对的；不友好的，敌意的；敌方的
entries.example: The crowd grew hostile when the referee ignored the obvious foul.
entries.exampleZh: 当裁判无视明显的犯规时，人群变得充满敌意。
